fdroid:com.github.digitallyrefined.andro.name: Android IP Camera
fdroid:com.github.digitallyrefined.andro.summary: Turn your Android device into a remote security IP camera
fdroid:com.github.digitallyrefined.andro.description:
Features
 🌎 Built in server, just open the video stream in a web browser, video app or even set it as a camera for Frigate or a Home Assistant MJPEG IP Camera (using `https://[ip_address]:4444/video/mjpeg`)
 📴 Option to turn the display off while streaming
 📡 Optional RTSP stream (H.264 video + AAC audio) for mpv, Frigate/go2rtc, NVRs and other RTSP clients (using `rtsps://[ip_address]:8554/live`, plus a lighter sub stream at `/live/sub`)
 🛰️ Optional ONVIF camera mode with WS-Discovery, snapshots and motion events for UniFi Protect, Home Assistant and other NVRs
 🤳 Switch between the main or selfie camera
 🎛️ Remote web interface with controls for camera section, image rotation, video recording, audio/video sync, flash light toggle, resolution, zoom, exposure and contrast
 ☁️ Optionally connect your device to a hosted or self-hosted cloud OpenTunnel server for remote access when you're not on your home/work network
 🖼️ Choose between different image quality settings and frame rates (to help reduce phone over heating)
 🛂 Username and password protection
 🔐 Automatic TLS certificate support to protect stream and login details via HTTPS/RTSPS
 🥾 Optional start on boot
 Warning
 If you are planning to run this 24/7, please make sure that your phone does not stay at 100% charge. Doing so may damage the battery and cause it to swell up, which could cause it to explode.
 Some models include an option to only charge to 80%, make sure this is enabled where possible.
 Note: running at a higher image quality may cause some phones to over heat, which can also damage the battery.
 For more details/usage see: Android IP Camera GitHub Readme
fdroid:com.github.digitallyrefined.andro.category: Camera, Connectivity, Multimedia, Remote Access, Remote Controller

fdroid:com.kitsumed.shizucallrecorder.name: ShizuCallRecorder
fdroid:com.kitsumed.shizucallrecorder.summary: Empowers ADB through Shizuku to record phone calls on non-rooted device!
fdroid:com.kitsumed.shizucallrecorder.description:
ShizuCallRecorder is the first non-root FOSS call recorder app for Android 11+ .
 This app main focus are Cellular/VoLTE calls, however, we do attempt to support Wifi-Calling and VoIP when possible . Third-party app support is not guaranteed , they may work provided they use Android Telecom.
 Features 
 Records both sides of phone calls (incoming and outgoing) Should work even when using Bluetooth or a remote headset
 Separate uplink and downlink audio inside a stereo recording
 Security toggles to manage Shizuku on/off state An attempt to reduce the potential attack surface introduced by Shizuku
 Helps with apps that detect / yells at you when USB Debugging or Shizuku is enabled
 Automatic call recording option with basic exclusion rules : Ignore anonymous calls
 Ignore specific contacts
 Ignore all contacts
 Multiple codecs available: Opus , AAC , HE-AAC-v1 , and more!
 The app runs only on phone event changes, no persistent background process and notifications
 Requirements 
 Android 11 or newer
 See the Android Tested Versions table on GitHub for more information on limitations
 Shizuku (recommended fork: thedjchi )
 Installation 
Please follow the installation instructions in the SUPPORT documentation , under Installation & Configuration .
 Please note that the official release source is GitHub. 
 Support the Project 
 If you find ShizuCallRecorder useful and want to support its development, you can contribute in several ways:
 Contribute to the project on GitHub: Contributing Guide 
 Support ongoing development via GitHub Sponsors: Sponsor kitsumed 
 Disclaimer 
 Recording phone calls may be subject to complex and varying laws in different countries and jurisdictions. 
 For example, you may need to ensure you have consent from all parties before recording conversations.The developers and contributors are not responsible for any misuse or legal consequences arising from the use of this application.
 You can learn more on Wikipedia at : Telephone call recording laws .
 If you are legally required to inform or ask someone for consent before recording , please note that the application DOES NOT handle this for you . In some cases, certain features, like automatic call recording, may not be legally allowed. It is your responsibility to ensure compliance with applicable laws. This is not legal advice . Please consult a legal professional for guidance regarding your specific situation.

fdroid:com.secuso.privacyFriendlyCodeSca.name: QR Scanner (PFA)
fdroid:com.secuso.privacyFriendlyCodeSca.summary: (SECUSO) Privacy Friendly QR-Scanner with minimal permissions
fdroid:com.secuso.privacyFriendlyCodeSca.description:
QR Codes become more and more important. In some areas they have even replaced the traditional barcode. A QR Code is able to store up to seven thousand characters and therefore is qualified for more complex content, e.g. vCards. Hence nowadays QR Codes can nowadays be found on nearly every advertisement poster and animate the user to scan it with his smartphone. Thus, it is no longer necessary take a hand written note, it is enough to scan the QR Code. Correspondingly, there are already many QR Code scanner apps available in the Google Play Store. It belongs to the Privacy Friendly Apps group developed by the research group SECUSO at Technische Universität Darmstadt. More information can be found an secuso.org/pfa
Our Privacy Friendly QR Scanner App differs with respect to two aspects:
1. The Privacy Friendly QR Scanner App only requires the minimum amount of permissions, namely:
Most of the QR Code scanner apps available in the Google Play Store need several permissions on top of the ones needed: e.g. reading contacts or your call log and retrieving data from the Internet. Most of these requirements are not necessary for the functionality they actually are supposed to provide.
2. The Privacy Friendly QR Scanner App supports its users in detecting malicious links: QR Codes provide new possibilities for an attacker, as QR Codes can contain malicious links, i.e. links to phishing webpages or webpages from which malware would automatically be downloaded. Therefore it is important to carefully check the link before accessing the corresponding webpage. Since it is difficult for the user to spot malicious links, the Privacy friendly QR Scanner App supports the user by highlighting the domain (e.g. in that case for https://www.secuso.org, secuso.org would be highlighted). To avoid not checking the link and in particular the highlighted domain carefully, the app provides information about possible fraud and its users need to confirm that they checked the link and it is trustworthy. Note, the information shown after scanning an URL based QR Code is not customized for every URL. Hence, it should be considered as an advice for the user how to behave in general.
The Privacy Friendly QR Scanner App supports most of the usual qr code types. Bar codes and other widely used codes are also supported.
The app belongs to the group of privacy friendly apps, that are developed by the SECUSO research group. More information can be found at https://secuso.org/pfa
You can reach us via
BlueSky - https://bsky.app/profile/secusoresearch.bsky.social
Mastodon - @SECUSO_Research@bawü.social https://xn--baw-joa.social/@SECUSO_Research/
Job opening - https://secuso.aifb.kit.edu/english/Job_Offers.php

fdroid:com.trevornk.ramblr.name: Ramblr
fdroid:com.trevornk.ramblr.summary: Tap, ramble, tap. Clean dictated text lands wherever your cursor is.
fdroid:com.trevornk.ramblr.description:
No keyboard swap, no separate app to paste out of. Ramblr floats a single button over whatever you're already doing — Slack, Discord, a code editor, an email — and inserts your words directly into the focused field the moment you're done talking.
 Tap, ramble, tap. One button, everywhere. No mode switching, no separate transcript to copy-paste.
 Fully offline if you want it. On-device transcription and on-device cleanup — nothing ever has to touch the network.
 Or route it through the best cloud models. OpenAI and Gemini for transcription; OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini for cleanup — chained in whatever fallback order you configure, your own API keys, no relay server in between.
 Fastest of both worlds. Instant on-device transcription, cloud-grade cleanup — dictation feels instant and still reads like you actually meant to write it.
 Cleanup styles that match how you actually talk. Formal, Casual, Notes and lists, Email, Concise — or write your own. Ramblr strips the "ums," collapses your self-corrections, and keeps your meaning, not just your words.
 It learns your vocabulary. Feed it your project names and jargon once; cleanup stops mangling them forever.
Ramblr uses Android's Accessibility Service for one narrow reason: to insert dictated text into the currently focused text field across apps. It does not replace your keyboard. It does not run background automation. It only acts after you explicitly tap the overlay button.
 Five ways to start dictating: the floating icon (default), the optional Ramblr Voice keyboard, Android's system accessibility button or a volume-key hold, a Quick Settings tile, or by selecting existing text in any app and tapping "Ramblr" to clean it up. Two of those — the voice keyboard and the select-text integration — work with the Accessibility Service turned off entirely. Ramblr Voice is a voice-only input method, not a full replacement keyboard: it has no letter, number, or symbol rows.
 Network connections: Ramblr makes no network connection on its own. Every connection it can make is listed here:
 Speech and cleanup model downloads (on request). On-device transcription needs a speech model, which is downloaded only when you pick one — from github.com (the sherpa-onnx project's release files) or huggingface.co. Optional on-device cleanup and optional silence auto-stop download their models the same way, only when you turn those features on. Nothing is downloaded until you ask for it, and models are verified against a known SHA-256 before being installed.
 Optional cloud transcription and cleanup (off by default). Only if you enable it and supply your own API key. Requests go straight from your phone to the provider you chose (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoint you point it at) — there is no Ramblr server in between.
 Cloud model list (only while setting up a cloud provider). When you open the cloud provider setup screen, Ramblr refreshes its list of available cloud models — which models each provider offers and their prices — from a public file on gist.githubusercontent.com, at most once a day. This exists so a newly released cloud model can be offered without shipping an app update. It is never fetched if you don't use cloud providers, it carries no identifying information, and a bundled list is used if the fetch fails.
There is no analytics, no telemetry, no crash reporting, and no advertising of any kind. This F-Droid build also contains no update checker: it never contacts GitHub to look for new versions, and updates come from F-Droid like any other app.
 Privacy: combine local transcription with local cleanup and nothing ever leaves the device. There is no backend for this app — in every cloud mode, requests go straight from your phone to the provider using your own API key, with no relay server in the middle. Cl

fdroid:de.pritcloud.scalelauncher.name: ScaleLauncher
fdroid:de.pritcloud.scalelauncher.summary: Use Xiaomi S400 locally via Bluetooth with openScale and Health Connect
fdroid:de.pritcloud.scalelauncher.description:
ScaleLauncher connects Android devices directly to the Xiaomi Body Composition Scale S400 over Bluetooth and processes measurements locally.
The app authenticates using the scale login token, receives complete measurement data and assigns measurements to the appropriate user based on configurable weight ranges. Results can be stored directly in openScale. Selected values can optionally also be written to Health Connect.
Multiple paired ScaleLauncher devices can exchange household profiles and measurement decisions over encrypted Bluetooth. This allows measurements to be assigned to a user whose profile belongs to another paired device.
ScaleLauncher does not require Xiaomi Cloud for normal operation and has no Internet permission.
Features:
• direct Bluetooth connection to the Xiaomi S400
• local body-composition calculation
• automatic and manual user assignment
• openScale integration
• optional Health Connect integration
• encrypted communication between paired ScaleLauncher devices
• no advertising or tracking
ScaleLauncher is free and open-source software licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0 only.

Mixbook. Wirecutter named it the best photo book service after testing 23 books, Digital Camera World named it the best photo book app, and it holds a 4.8-star App Store rating.

flathub:dev.diegovsky.Riff.name: Riff
flathub:dev.diegovsky.Riff.description:
Riff is a Spotify client that puts your music library front and center. It features a clean, minimal design that lets you listen distraction-free.
 Note: Riff requires a Spotify Premium account. Some accounts may not work due to Spotify's new PlayPlay DRM, which is proprietary and cannot be implemented externally. 
 Features:
 Modern GTK4 and libadwaita interface with light/dark themes and a responsive layout
 Play, pause, skip, seek, shuffle, and repeat with gapless playback
 Like tracks and follow artists, albums, and playlists
 Browse your saved albums, playlists, liked tracks, and followed artists
 Create and edit your own playlists and add tracks to them
 Search for albums, artists, tracks, and playlists
 Share and open Spotify links with your friends using automatic link detection
 Fine-tune your sound with a built-in DSP engine featuring a 10-band equalizer, stereo pan, and pitch shift
 Advanced desktop integration: media keys (MPRIS), inhibits session suspend while playing, and secure credential storage
 Keyboard shortcuts and touch gestures

flathub:io.github.CardiJey.schulrechner.name: Schulrechner
flathub:io.github.CardiJey.schulrechner.summary: The calculator you know from school
flathub:io.github.CardiJey.schulrechner.description:
This is a very early version in development. Unlabeled buttons will be implemented in the future, and bugs may be frequent. If you experience issues or have feature requests, please file an issue (link below). 
 Frustrated by the lack of free, open-source scientific calculators that feel like the ones I am used to, I decided to reverse-engineer my old calculator from school.
 With features like:
 input of complex equations,
 output as fractions as well as decimals,
 result storage and reuse,
 selection and editing of equations from input history,
 and support for implicit multiplication (like 5π instead of 5*π),
 this calculator produces math that looks like the math on your paper. That makes it much more suitable for higher-level math in school and university—especially if you've grown accustomed to this kind of interface from a young age and just forgot your calculator at home.
 Some additional features include:
 A well-established open-source math.js library as the math engine—so you're not relying on some sketchy, hand-rolled math logic (just my sketchy hand-rolled input method 😛)
 A familiar, intuitive design
 100% offline usability and fully open source
 Written entirely in HTML, JS, and CSS, which means it is inherently cross-platform, ...
 easy for other web developers to contribute and ...
 admittedly a bit heavy for a calculator. If you're interested in helping make a lighter version (Flutter, Kotlin, etc.), you're very welcome!

flathub:io.github.mmarco94.tambourine.name: Tambourine
flathub:io.github.mmarco94.tambourine.description:
A simple and straight-to-the point music player for your local library.
 Features:
 Browse your music collection
 Play songs
 That's it really (well... there is a bit more: lyrics, waveform, gapless playback, filter/sort, etc.)
 Tenets:
 Linux first
 Local only: no internet connection will ever be established
 Read-only: your music will be accessed only in read mode
 Stateless: no cache/database/whatever will be created. The metadata in your songs are the database
 Imperfect: there will be use-cases that are not solved by this software, and that's fine

flathub:org.mozilla.firefox.name: Firefox
flathub:org.mozilla.firefox.description: When it comes to your life online, you have a choice: accept the factory settings or put your privacy first. When you choose Firefox as your default browser, you’re choosing to protect your data while supporting an independent tech company. Firefox is also the only major browser backed by a non-profit fighting to give you more openness, transparency and control of your life online. Join hundreds of millions of people who choose to protect what's important by choosing Firefox - a web browser designed to be fast, easy to use, customizable and private.

flathub:org.raspberrypi.rpi-imager.name: Raspberry Pi Imager
flathub:org.raspberrypi.rpi-imager.description:
Raspberry Pi Imager downloads a .JSON file from the Raspberry Pi
 website with a list of all current download options, ensuring you are
 always installing the most up-to-date version.
 Once you've selected an operating system from the available options,
 the utility reads the relevant file directly from the Raspberry Pi
 website and writes it straight to the SD card. This speeds up the
 process quite considerably compared to the standard process of reading
 it from the website, writing it to a file on your hard drive, and then,
 as a separate step, reading it back from the hard drive and writing it
 to the SD card.
 During this process, Raspberry Pi Imager also caches the downloaded
 operating system image – that is to say, it saves a local copy on your
 computer, so you can program additional SD cards without having to
 download the file again.

flathub:org.supertuxproject.SuperTux.name: SuperTux
flathub:org.supertuxproject.SuperTux.summary: A jump-and-run game starring Tux the Penguin
flathub:org.supertuxproject.SuperTux.description:
Run and jump through multiple worlds, fight off enemies by jumping on them, bumping them from
 below or tossing objects at them, grabbing power-ups and other stuff on the way.
 In addition to the Story Mode, there is a large amount of community contributed levels available
 as add-ons or in the forums. Everyone can contribute such content by using the integrated level
 editor.
 The Story: Penny Gets Captured!
 Tux and Penny were out having a nice picnic on the ice fields of Antarctica. Suddenly, everything
 was a blur as Tux was knocked out!
 When Tux wakes up, he finds that Penny is missing. Where she lay before now lies a letter. “Tux,
 my arch enemy!” says the letter. “I have captured your beautiful Penny and have taken her to my
 fortress. The path to my fortress is littered with my minions. Give up on the thought of trying
 to reclaim her, you haven’t got a chance! -Nolok”
 Tux looks and sees Nolok’s fortress in the distance. Determined to save his beloved Penny, he
 begins his journey through the Icy Island and beyond.

flathub:se.sjoerd.lockpicker.name: Lockpicker
flathub:se.sjoerd.lockpicker.description:
Lockpicker is a password recovery tool based on hashcat. It enabled you to recover a password straight from its hash from a GNOME-native interface, without having to deal
 with the hassle of a hashcat syntax. 
 Lockpicker is meant for academic purposes, and is an ideal tool to start learning about password recovery or to work with CTF (capture the flag) assignments.
 Note that Lockpicker ships with vanilla hashcat, and does not provide any functionality that is not available from hashcat itself by design. You can however import your own
 wordlists, rule files, hashcat modules or kernels into Lockpicker straight from the GUI.

firefox-addons:2960397.name: fhosts
firefox-addons:2960397.summary: Override DNS resolution for specific domains on a per-tab basis for local development or staging environments - test your app with production hostnames without editing system files.
firefox-addons:2960397.description:
fhosts lets you override hostname-to-IP resolution for any domain, directly in Firefox, on a per-tab basis. Perfect for staging or local web development when you need to test with production hostnames.
 Why use fhosts? 
When developing, you often need production hostnames to work correctly - for cookies, CORS policies, OAuth callbacks, or SSL certificates. Instead of editing your system hosts file (which affects your entire computer), fhosts lets you:
• Map any hostname to any IP address (e.g., myapp.com → 127.0.0.1)
 • Enable overrides per-tab - test local and production side-by-side
 • Keep your system hosts file clean
 How it works 
 Add hostname mappings (e.g., example.com → 127.0.0.1)
 Click the toggle to enable overrides for the current tab
 Navigate to your mapped domain - requests route to your specified IP
The toolbar icon turns cyan when overrides are active for the active tab.
 Requirements 
This extension requires a companion proxy helper to perform the actual IP substitution. Download the installer from the GitHub releases page: https://github.com/amalg/fhosts/releases 
 HTTPS Note 
When accessing HTTPS sites, you'll see certificate warnings since the certificate won't match the IP. For local development, use tools like mkcert for local SSL certificates.
 Open Source 
fhosts is open source under the MIT license. View the code, report issues, or contribute at: https://github.com/amalg/fhosts

firefox-addons:5890.name: Tree Style Tab
firefox-addons:5890.description:
This extension provides the ability to work with tabs as "trees".
New tabs opened from the current tab are automatically organized as "children" of the current tab.
Such "branches" are easily folded (collapsed) by clicking on the arrow shown in the "parent" tab, so you no longer need to suffer from too many visible tabs.
If you want, you can restructure the tree via drag and drop.
 Such a tree of tabs will behave like a visual browsing history for you. For example, if you see a list of search results for a topic, each search result link will open in new child tab.
 New tabs opened from these "child" tabs will appear as descendants of their originating tabs.
 You'll easily dig and dig deeply, without losing your browsing trail - if you want to go back to the original search result, you just have to switch to the "root" tab.
 Moreover, each tree will reflect a group of tabs on a similar topic.
Please enjoy as you like!
 Tips: 
 "F1" key toggles the TST sidebar.
 "Tree Style Tab" toolbar button also toggles the sidebar. If it's unnecessary, you can remove it from the toolbar.
 Permissions: 
This extension needs following permissions to work as expected:
 Required: Access browser tabs: to list both active and non-active tabs in the UI.
 Access recently closed tabs (access to the session information): to save tree information of tabs (structure, collapsed/expanded state, etc.) to tabs' session information and ask to Firefox to manage them as bundled.
 Display notifications to you: to present information and navigate users without blocking.
 Read and modify browser settings: to know the activation status of the native vertical tabs and apply suitable color matching to the browser's theme to the toolbar icon placed on the navigation toolbar.
 Optional: Read and modify bookmarks: to simulate bookmark related commands in the tab context menu. / to detect tabs whether they were opened from bookmarks or not.
 Get data from the clipboard: to simulate commands like "Share > Copy Links" in the tab context menu and others. / to simulate opening a new tab with the URL in the clipboard with middle click on the tab bar.
 Access your data for all websites (run scripts on webpages) / Access local files on your computer: to detect the Ctrl key is pressed/released and prevent needless expansion of collapsed trees while tab switching with Ctrl-Tab/Ctrl-Shift-Tab. / to render simulated preview panel and tab groups context menu on the content area.
 Hide and show browser tabs: just for automated tests, not required on regular use.
 Extensions extend TST: 
TST provides APIs for other extensions .
Some extensions extend the behavior of TST's sidebar panel:
 Multiple Tab Handler allows you to select multiple tabs with long-press on tabs. It also allows you to close multiple tabs with long-press on the closebox on tabs.
 TST Active Tab in Collapsed Tree shows a small tab on a collapsed tree as an alias for the last active tab under the tree .
 TST Auto Group Tabs provides ability to group newly opened tabs automatically in various conditions.
 TST Auto Sticky Tabs provides ability to stick some state tabs to tab bar edges automatically.
 TST Bookmarks Subpanel allows you to show a small "Bookmarks" sidebar panel below tabs in the TST's sidebar.
 TST Indent Line provides indent lines like Visual Studio Code's one.
 TST Lock Tree Collapsed allows you to lock arbitrary trees as collapsed. (This was a built-in feature on TST 3.3.0-3.3.6, and now separated.)
And there are more helper extensions .

firefox-addons:3106360.description:
You didn't need it. You almost bought it anyway.
CoolingOff puts a "Cool off" button right next to Buy and Add to cart on major shopping sites. One click freezes the purchase for 24 hours, 72 hours or 7 days (30 minutes or 1 hour on food delivery sites). When time is up, you decide: buy it, or bury it. No shame, no budgeting lectures.

2. The item waits in your list with a countdown. You get a notification when time is up.
3. Choose Buy It or Bury It. Every item you bury adds to your "Money Kept" total.
PRIVACY
- No account, no tracking, no analytics
- Your list is stored only in your browser and never sent anywhere

Generate strong random passwords with a custom length and character set. You can include uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers and special characters depending on the requirements of the account or server. Password · Passphrase · PIN
Key features:
- Password Length: 1–128
- Number of passwords: 1–100

2. Password Length · Number of passwords · Options
3. Generate a new result using the selected settings.
4. Copy · Copy all · Download
Export:
- Copy · Copy all
- Download: TXT / JSON / CSV
- CSV prefixes formula-like values with an apostrophe. TXT and JSON preserve exact values.
Context menu:

firefox-addons:2683779.description:
Not all page transitions can be blocked. This mainly blocks page transitions when a link is clicked with the mouse. This add-on does not work on special pages such as addons.mozilla.org and about:* . Automatic page transitions by JavaScript may not be blocked.
When a browser's back, forward, or reload button is clicked or a tab is about to be closed, a dialog box can be displayed on the web page asking the user to confirm whether or not to leave the page. However, this feature also displays a dialog box when you try to quit the browser. Also, for this to work, you have to do something with the page after it's displayed. For example, click once on the page with the mouse. If no operation is performed, the dialog box will not be displayed. If this function is disabled, the navigation to about:* with the browser's back and forward buttons cannot be blocked.

Features
• Allows you to take on-demand blood oxygen measurements.

bluejetty:00034117:ios.name: Moon Poker: Daily Tournaments
bluejetty:00034117:ios.summary: Moon Poker is revolutionizing mobile poker with daily free poker tournaments, where players can compete in hyper-turbo poker to win money fast!—with no purchase necessary! This innovative app redefines gaming, offering a thrilling, risk-fre
bluejetty:00034117:ios.description:
Moon Poker is revolutionizing mobile poker with daily free poker tournaments, where players can compete in hyper-turbo poker to win money fast!—with no purchase necessary! This innovative app redefines gaming, offering a thrilling, risk-free experience that sets it apart from traditional poker apps.
Hyper-Turbo Tournaments:
Moon Poker's appeal lies in its daily free poker tournaments. These hyper-turbo poker games are designed to fit seamlessly into busy lives, offering the excitement of quick poker games in a condensed format. Each fast poker tournament lasts between 20-30 minutes, making it easy for players to join in without a significant time commitment. Whether you're a seasoned player or a beginner, Moon Poker's hyper-turbo poker tournaments provide an exhilarating experience.
Win Real Cash Prizes:
Moon Poker offers the opportunity to win real cash. Unlike many other gaming apps that require purchases to enter tournaments or win prizes, Moon Poker offers this chance completely free of charge. By participating in daily poker tournaments, players can win real money, adding a real-world incentive to the virtual gaming experience. 
Earned Stars and Fair Play:
Players use stars to enter and re-enter tournaments, ensuring everyone has a fair chance to compete. Stars can be earned through achievements, watching advertisements, and more. This flexible approach allows players to engage with the game in a way that suits their preferences, ensuring Moon Poker remains accessible to everyone. 
Advertisements and In-App Purchases:
Moon Poker is a free poker app that also offers optional ads and in-app purchases to enhance the gaming experience by allowing the player to re-enter once they have been knocked out. Watching ads allows players to earn extra stars, providing a quick way to boost their star count without spending money. In-app purchases are available for those who prefer a more direct approach, enabling players to acquire avatars that come with bonus stars.
Non-Gambling Solution:
For video game and poker enthusiasts, Moon Poker is the premier non-gambling solution in the mobile gaming market. While traditional poker apps often require financial investment and carry the risks of gambling, Moon Poker offers a safe, risk-free alternative. Players can enjoy the excitement of poker and the potential for real cash rewards without any gambling downside

bluejetty:00078216:ios.description:
Transform your time with God using the First 5 app, developed by Proverbs 31 Ministries. First 5 is specifically designed to greet you with a short teaching in God’s Word daily before you get distracted by social media and everything else competing for your attention. It’s our hope you create a daily habit of reading God’s Word through your time spent in the First 5 app. 
Features
• New Teaching Every Day: We unpack books of the Bible, focusing on passages of Scripture each day and seeing how they apply to our lives. 
• Highlight, Save and Share: You can highlight any portion of our daily teachings to bookmark, share or add a personal note. Review your notes and activity through your profile and use the export feature to save them to your device.
• Reminder Functionality: Set up a reminder in the app to go off at any time you choose. This way, you can read each teaching at a time that works best in your schedule. 
• Bible: Don't have your Bible handy? Use this feature for your daily Bible reading. You can search any passage of Scripture and even bookmark, highlight and create a graphic to share with a friend.
* Community: Find community among our First 5 friends in private and public groups.

bluejetty:00016482:ios.summary:

Find what to watch next
Browse movies and TV episodes fr
bluejetty:00016482:ios.description:
The Google TV app, previously Play Movies & TV, makes it easy to find and enjoy the entertainment you love from across your apps, all in one place. With Google TV, you'll be able to:
Find what to watch next
Browse movies and TV episodes from across your streaming apps, all in one place and organized into topics and genres. Discover new things with recommendations based on what you love and what’s trending across the services you already have access to. Search for titles to see which apps are streaming them.
Create a list for all your discoveries
Add interesting shows and movies to your Watchlist to keep track of your new discoveries and view them later. The Watchlist is shared across your devices, so you can even add to your Watchlist from your TV or phone and laptop through Search on any browser.
Take your favorites on-the-go
Your recommendations, Library and Watchlist go with you wherever you go, whether it is out the front door or just to the other room. Start streaming right on your mobile device, or download your previously purchased entertainment from your Library to watch when you're not connected.
Use your phone as your Google TV / Android TV remote
With a remote built right into the app, you can find something great to watch even when the couch has eaten your remote. And you can use your phone’s keyboard to quickly type complicated passwords, movie names or search terms on your Google TV or other Android TV OS device
Learn more about Google TV: https://tv.google

--- Looking for an easy and affordable way to separate your personal and professional life?
With DUOLINE, you can instantly add a second phone number to your device without the hassle of changing SIM cards. Make unlimited calls over the Internet to mobile and landline numbers, send SMS, MMS, and more — all while enjoying global connectivity at incredibly low rates.
--- Why Choose DUOLINE?
Easily switch between your primary number and an additional line that protects your privacy in any situation. Perfect for business professionals, freelancers, online sellers, travelers, and anyone seeking extra privacy. Whether you’re meeting new clients, managing side projects, or staying in touch with family and friends abroad, DUOLINE keeps your real number safe and secure.
--- Stay Connected and in Control!
Choose a local area code to establish a local presence, use spam blocking to avoid unwanted calls, and never miss a message with built-in voicemail. This app lets you separate work and personal communication, save on international calls, and stay connected — all in one place.
Take control of your communication with convenience and security. Download DUOLINE today and experience true flexibility in managing calls and texts!
--- Key Features ---

bluejetty:00175167:ios.name: Planes Live - Flight Tracker
bluejetty:00175167:ios.summary: Planes Live Free is a simple yet powerful flight tracking tool that lets you watch the planes online all over the world and get up-to-date information on flights instantly! Track the flights of your family members or beloved ones as if you
bluejetty:00175167:ios.description:
Planes Live Free is a simple yet powerful flight tracking tool that lets you watch the planes online all over the world and get up-to-date information on flights instantly! Track the flights of your family members or beloved ones as if you were traveling with them and find the best time to pick them up at the airport. 
Whether you are a professional pilot or an aviation enthusiast, you'll definitely appreciate our flight tracker - the simple, clean and informative interface coupled with powerful functionality!
FEATURES
* Track planes and biplanes online all over the world
* Get notified about the flight schedule changes with handy alerts: be aware of the flight status, canceled flights, new departure and arrival time and more
* Search for particular flights, airports, and locations
* Get detailed information on flights: from aircraft characteristics and picture to its route and schedule
* Find up-to-date airport information that covers accurate departures and arrivals schedule, airport timezone and local time, its location and weather forecast
* Add airports and locations to "My Places" to access them instantly!
* Check weather forecast for a particular location or airport
* Spot planes and airports near you: select the desirable distance and enjoy the show!
* Apply smart filters to track a particular airplane model or an airline company, watch the planes of selected altitude, speed or airport.
PREMIUM FEATURES
* Weather Overlays
* Unlimited number of alerts
* 2x faster data update
* Terminal, Check In, Gate and Baggage info
* No Ads
* Subscriptions will automatically renew and payment will be charged to your Apple account unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. 
Subscription payments will be charged to your App Store account at confirmation of your purchase. Subscriptions will automatically renew and you will be charged unless auto-renew is turned off or unless you cancel at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription or trial period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period. The cost of renewal depends on the Subscription Plan you choose. 
Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings after purchase or by contacting Customer Support.
Сoverage zone:
- Europe: up to 95% of the continent.
- South America: up to 90% of ADS-B coverage for airplanes.
- North America: close to 100% coverage of transmitter-enabled airplanes; 100% of data delivered with a delay of up to 5 minutes.
- Africa: major coverage of South Africa; partial coverage of the rest of the continent.
- Australia: 100% coverage.
- Asia: coverage of mainly densely populated areas.
- Oceania: 100% coverage.
Together with our partners, we are constantly working on improving the coverage.
Important Notice:
The airline tracker app uses data from several providers, which is collected from aircraft, equipped with ADS-B transmitters. ADS-B is not used by all airlines or aircraft. Due to technical limitations on how flight data is collected, it might be incomplete in some cases. We are working to improve this situation.
Privacy Policy: https://support.bendingspoons.com/privacy.html?app=1097815000
Terms: https://support.bendingspoons.com/tos.html?app=1097815000
Contact us: support@planeslive.com

bluejetty:00159112:ios.description:
Experience a whole new way to draw and paint with AR Drawing, an app that harnesses augmented reality to help you create artwork on any surface. Whether you’re refining your skills or exploring a new hobby, AR Drawing makes it simple to produce eye-catching sketches that bridge the digital and physical worlds.
Draw Anywhere, Anytime
Aim your camera at a surface, select a template (or use your own ideas), then project it through your phone. Outline the displayed image in real life and watch your creativity unfold. From cute animals and cars to mouthwatering food and scenic vistas, there’s plenty to inspire your next masterpiece.
Why AR Drawing?
- Endless Templatesю Access a diverse library of designs animals, cars, nature, and more or trace your own references.
- Integrated Flashlight. Keep your subject well-lit so every detail stands out, no matter where you are.
- Multi-Surface Magic. Draw on paper, walls, glass, if you can see it, you can turn it into your personal canvas.
- Share Your Creations. Snap a photo or record a quick video of your AR process to amaze friends and followers.
- Perfect for All Skill Levels. Whether you’re a seasoned illustrator or trying to draw for the very first time, AR Drawing helps you practice perspective, capture outlines, and develop artistic confidence in a fun, user-friendly environment.
Subscription Details:
- Unlimited Access. Unlock premium perks like faster rendering, limitless tracing, specialized editing tools, and more.
- Flexible Plans. Choose from weekly, monthly, or yearly subscriptions that adapt to your artistic needs.
- Auto-Renewal. Your iTunes account is charged at the end of any free trial period. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel auto-renew at least 24 hours before the current term ends.
- Manage Your Subscription. After purchase, visit your Account Settings to modify or turn off auto-renewal anytime.
Privacy Policy: https://telegra.ph/Privacy-Policy-of-AR-Drawing-02-19
Terms of Use: https://telegra.ph/Terms-of-Use-AR-Drawing-02-19
Download AR Drawing now and turn every surface into your personal art studio—trace, color, and create works of art with the power of AR!

bluejetty:00015217:ios.name: European IQ Test: Brain Score
bluejetty:00015217:ios.summary:
Unlock Your Brain's True Potential!
What is an IQ? An Intelligence Quotient (IQ) measures your mental abilities relative to others of your age group. While everyone possesses hundreds of distinct cognitive skills, a scientifically valid te
bluejetty:00015217:ios.description:
Unlock Your Brain's True Potential!
What is an IQ? An Intelligence Quotient (IQ) measures your mental abilities relative to others of your age group. While everyone possesses hundreds of distinct cognitive skills, a scientifically valid test is the most reliable predictor of academic, professional, and personal success.
The European Standard IQ Test is a premier, scientifically validated assessment. Designed with precision, it offers exceptional accuracy—particularly within the high-intelligence range of 140 to 160 (Cattell scale, stdev 24). Previously reserved exclusively for corporations, elite schools, and certified professional applications, this premium test is now available directly on your device.
What You Will Discover:
Beyond just a single score, our exclusive test dives deep into your cognitive profile, assessing your performance across 6 core areas of intelligence:
Logic & Reasoning – Your ability to analyze and solve complex problems.
Visual-Spatial Processing – How well you mentally manipulate shapes and patterns.
Working Memory – Your capacity to hold and process information in real-time.
Pattern Recognition – Speed and accuracy in finding hidden connections.
Quantitative Aptitude – Numerical reasoning and mathematical logic.
Cognitive Speed – How efficiently your brain processes new challenges.
Pro Tip for the Best Score:
The questions within each section get progressively more difficult. If a question is taking too long, skip to the next section and return to it later if time permits. Manage your time wisely to maximize your score!
Ready to measure your brain and discover your true mental age?
Are you the next genius?
Begin your test today!

So you’ve opened the door
bluejetty:00169190:ios.description:
Unlock the doors to otherworldly free-to-play adventure! "Maze of Realities" offers a captivating blend of technology, magic, mystery and puzzles, inviting players to unlock the secrets of otherworldly dimensions!
So you’ve opened the door to other worlds! And turns out that means so many new discoveries! For example, your friend Dr. Charles Michaelson got an invitation from the world of Innovatrix to exchange knowledge and meet the most advanced AI in the universe – Omnira. And since he invites you to come along, you become a witness to its superior intellect. But is it you or Omnira’s creator, Conrad, who has some dangerous plans on his mind? The more you get to know him and the tragic circumstances of his past, the more you suspect that a catastrophe of galactic proportions is imminent… But can you stop it? Or the worlds around you will cease to exist? 
Immerse yourself in this seek and find adventure with hidden objects, where every discovery brings you closer to the heart of an impending cosmic crisis. Are you ready to face the challenges and save the worlds from the brink of extinction?
Features:
Your Own Choices: Every action you take, no matter how big or small, could be the turning point in the adventure!
Relaxing Mini-Games: Unravel clues, seek and find hidden objects, and delve into intricate item search to progress through this gripping adventure quest!
Multiple Hidden Objects: Step into the shoes of a true adventurer as you uncover hidden objects and engage in exciting search and find quests!
A Variety of Achievements: Earn achievements as you solve intricate brain teasers, fostering an immersive gameplay experience unlike any other in the realm of adventure games!
Diverse Worlds: Traverse the realms of Innovatrix and beyond, encountering unbelievably cute robots, high-tech puzzles, and magical brain teasers!
The Maze of Realities awaits – are you ready to shape the destiny of multiple worlds in the free-to-play adventure?

bluejetty:00089120:ios.description:
The Achieve GOOD money app helps you to make daily progress toward your money goals. Track your spending without feeling overwhelmed. Know where your money is going today so you control your financial future.
With the Achieve GOOD app, you can create your own plan to choose how to get out of debt faster.
See where your money is going. First, you can use the Achieve GOOD app to get a clear view of your money. See how much debt you have and how you’re spending your money. Tip: connect all your accounts—bank accounts, credit cards, loans, etc.—to get the most complete and accurate picture of your finances.
Use insights to make smarter financial choices. You’ll get personalized insights into all your debts so you can prioritize which balances to pay off first. You can see estimated timelines of when you could be debt-free based on how much extra you pay each month. You’ll also get insights into your spending trends so you can make smarter spending choices like cutting out costs you don’t need (subscriptions, etc.).
Put extra money toward reducing your debt faster. By knowing where you can curb your spending, you can put that extra money toward the debt you want to eliminate first. We’ll give you estimates when you’ll be debt-free based on extra payments. If you want to get out of debt even faster, you can see if you are eligible for any of our debt solutions.

bluejetty:00016976:ios.name: Pop Art
bluejetty:00016976:ios.summary: 'Pop Art' transforms live video from the built-in cameras, photo library or AI photos generated from text input into Pop Art posters utilizing four different available 'Pop Art Themes': Warhol, HOPE, Posterize or Negged Out!. All four filt
bluejetty:00016976:ios.description:
'Pop Art' transforms live video from the built-in cameras, photo library or AI photos generated from text input into Pop Art posters utilizing four different available 'Pop Art Themes': Warhol, HOPE, Posterize or Negged Out!. All four filters utilize automatic background removal if enabled. The intelligent Warhol filter detects facial features, hair, skin and clothing for a colored bottom layer and overlays a screen layer on top via eight different 'blend modes.' Eight different 'Photo FX' modes can also be applied to the screen layer. The colors that are applied to the different regions are determined via one of 13 available 'Color Presets' corresponding to famous Pop Art artists and artwork. For each frame in the frame layout different sets of colors are used. So for the first frame the hair detected region will have a different color applied to it than the second frame for example. In live video the filter is applied directly as well as the frame layout from a single frame to 2X1, 1X2, 2X2, 3X2, 2X3 and up to 3X3 which can be dynamically changed on-the-fly and the change updates in real-time. When you are satisfied with your Pop Art creation simply tap the red button to capture it and delete, print or share it from the gallery detail view. You can create surprisingly authentic Warholesque artwork using this filter. The HOPE filter creates a Shepard Fairey-inspired HOPE poster with editable text and maps luminance values to the corresponding HOPE colors. Sliders enable you to alter the prevalence of darker tones and brighter tones. Solid colors or interpolated colors can be used and histogram equalization can be enabled to balance the colors more evenly. Like the HOPE filter the Posterize filter maps luminance values to poster colors using the currently selected Color Preset and also has interpolation and histogram equalization. The Posterize filter also uses the same frame layouts as the Warhol filter. The Negged Out! filter applies a negative filter and a poster filter with different levels that are set via a poster levels slider. It also applies a photo effect for intriguing images.
'Pop Art' is a similar app to 'Pop Art Lite' but has three additional Pop Art themes added to it that are currently in development: 'Pollock', 'Lichtenstein' and 'Mondrian' and once these themes become available new releases will be submitted for review and made available once they have passed muster with the review team. So while 'Pop Art Lite' only includes the four themes new themes will be continuously added to 'Pop Art' and available to app subscribers.
- Warhol and Posterize filters transform live video and AI generated and library photos into pop art posters with color presets and dynamic frame layouts of either single frame, 2X1, 1X2, 2X2, 2X3, 3X2 all the way up to 3X3.
- Use the 'AI Image Generator' to create crazy AI images from custom text input. Then crop the AI images and use in any of the four filters.
- HOPE filter creates Shepard Fairey-inspired poster with editable text.
- Posterize and HOPE filters include interpolate mode which interpolates from darker to brighter tones if enabled vs. solid colors otherwise.
- Posterize and HOPE filters also have histogram equalization feature which can be enabled to more evenly distribute the colors.
- For Warhol and Posterize filters choose from 13 different presets based on famous works and artists for five different colors per frame for each frame in the frame layout.
Join the facebook group https://www.facebook.com/groups/PopArtApp to check out other's work and share your creations (either from the app or otherwise) with others.
Privacy policy: https://pop-art-lite.flycricket.io/privacy.html
Terms of Service: https://pop-art-lite.flycricket.io/terms.html
Data Deletion: https://doc-hosting.flycricket.io/data-deletion/e152471e-e6d3-48da-a023-02bf5b2c44ea/other

bluejetty:00066358:ios.description:
Play Taptiles® today – train your brain and relax with the original 3D mahjong puzzle game that millions of players love. 
Install today to play classic majong games free anytime, anywhere!
Taptiles is a simple to learn but difficult to master mahjong puzzle game. Unlike most mahjongg games Taptiles features 3D mahjong tiles that can be rotated to help you find a tile match on any side of the tile stack! Start tapping and see if you can beat the first level!
Find matching tile pairs to complete levels in this exciting mahjong puzzle game. If you can’t find a perfect match, it’s simple – rotate the 3D puzzle to view the other side. You’ll be a tile master in no time!
Taptiles includes multiple fun game modes, countless puzzles and daily challenges for countless hours of fun gameplay. Download today to play the best 3D mahjong puzzle game on the App Store.
How to play Taptiles:
-Find and tap matching tiles that are unblocked on the left or right side of the tiles – these are the same classic mahjong rules you know and love but with a new twist. When you tap on two tiles that are unblocked, the box is removed from the level. Remove each tile box to win the level and become a mah-jongg master
-Use boosts and powerups to complete more levels and get a high score!
-Train your brain with complex 3D tile puzzles that rotate 360 degrees – if you can’t find the tile you want, simply rotate the entire level but don’t forget where Rotate 3D puzzle board to find more matching tile pairs
-Match cubes quickly before the time runs out! Some Taptiles modes have countless levels and your goal is to complete a certain number of mahjongg levels or just make as much progress as you can before time runs out
-Use power tiles to earn more points in many mahjong modes – the power tiles can be used together to ensure that you match as many cubes as possible in the shortest amount of time or gain more time on your game timer
Test your mind with different Game Modes and Challenges:
Dash Mode
Dash Mode is short, simple, and full of tile puzzles perfect for quick, exciting gameplay. Clear tiles quickly to earn extra time. How many puzzles can you clear before the time runs out? Be competitive and test your skills. Quick gameplay earns you special bonus tiles with game-changing effects, such as Wild Tile, Gem Tile, and Time Tile. 
Origins Mode
Origins Mode is a new mahjong puzzle game mode in Taptiles that includes large, challenging puzzles with a more relaxing time limit. Think through each brain teaser and complete the skill building puzzles before time runs out to advance levels.
Relaxation Mode
Relaxation Mode is untimed for a relaxing game experience version of Taptiles. Perfect for players who want a calming puzzle experience without the challenge of a ticking clock. Take a break with Relaxation Mode.
Daily Challenges
Daily Challenges are a favorite feature of Taptiles fans. Players receive new challenges every day. Daily challenges include a wide variety of difficulty on the basic tile tapping game. Try challenges like Color Charge or Tap Tower for daily fun. There are various beautiful box colors for your to enjoy!
Beautiful Graphics and Sound
Play Taptiles and transport yourself to a mysterious world filled with cube or box tiles and puzzles only you can solve. Relax in peaceful gardens and vibrant landscapes that come to life with gorgeous graphics and effects. Multiple audio options ensure that you can play the mahjong game your way and start mastering Taptiles right away.
Start tapping and removing mahjongg tiles in every level of this fun free game!
Download Taptiles for free today and play endless 3d majong games. Enjoy the original 3D mahjong game today!

bluejetty:00080562:ios.description:
Discover the FREE TO PLAY word game that brings a fresh twist to the classic genre. Hexa Search: Word Puzzle features a unique hexagon letter grid that lets you connect letters in six directions, creating endless fun and challenging word hunts. Swipe your fingers to form words hidden in the hexa letter grid and solve puzzles. Enhance your vocabulary and sharpen your mind as you navigate through hundreds of intriguing puzzles!
How to become a Hexa Search master:
• Pay attention to what the search box asks you to find and try to uncover as many words as possible to gain bonus points. Return every day for new daily challenges.
Hexa Search offers various engaging gameplay modes, including Star Hunt, where you find as many words as possible; Quote, where you guess quotes to find missing words; Twister, where you identify opposite words; and Trivia, where you relate words to given themes. With each mode offering a fresh challenge, your journey to becoming a word champion will never be dull.
Key Features:
• Engaging Gameplay: Enjoy a unique design and fun gameplay that keeps you entertained. Explore the hexagon grid and connect letters in six directions for a refreshing challenge.
• Play Anytime, Anywhere: Enjoy the game offline, wherever and whenever you want!
• Brain-Boosting Challenges: Take on daily challenges and a variety of gameplay modes that are easy to start but hard to master. Each level presents a new puzzle.
• Vocabulary Expansion: Enhance your vocabulary with a wide variety of words as you play.
Embark on a word puzzle adventure with Hexa Search: Word Puzzle. Daily challenges and diverse game modes await you. Join thousands of word game enthusiasts and start your journey today!

bluejetty:00140461:ios.description:
CUTE CALENDAR APP - 4.0 DIGITAL PLANNER 2026 For You
The app will solve the problems and troubles that you face in managing your time and working effectively. Besides, it is like a DIGITAL SMART friend managing your life, improving productivity as well as a balance between working time and personal life. Becoming a BETTER VERSION in 2026.
CUTE CALENDAR - ALL IN ONE fully integrates features such as TO-DO LIST, NOTES, DIARY, REMINDER, HABIT TRACKER, and WEATHER,... This makes it possible for users to do everything on a single app without downloading any other app.
In addition to the main features, the App also owns powerful sub-features that support planning and increase user experience: 
- Sticker: The app allows you to freely express your style through Stickers. This feature is applicable to both events and Todo lists.
- Colors set: Use color schemes to make your planner look striking. Here's a tip to help planners plan more effectively.
- Weather: See the weather right on Cute Calendar to help the planner plan for themselves in time.
With CUTE CALENDAR, the App Creator emphasizes the two elements that are the simplest and easiest to use. This makes it possible for any user to use the app. In addition to the cute style, the app is not only a planning aid to save events, to-do lists, tasks, and schedules but also a place to save beautiful memories, photos, and trips,...
Let's explore more detail about the features of the app:
◆Cute Calendar App Features:
▷Calendar:
- Sync with your calendar system ( with Apple Calendar )
- Sync with Google calendar.
- Day, Week, Month, and List views of your events.
- Customize reminder notifications
- Create your events with unlimited color.
- Create your events with a dynamic repeat feature.
- Weather on Calendar
- Week Number on Calendar
- Sticker Calendar with 500+ stickers
▷To do list:
- Create and manage your tasks from basic to advanced, view tasks by expiry, day, week, month
- Can create task and subtask lists
- Can create tasks that are repeated by day, week, month and year
- Can create tasks with unlimited colors and attach stickers
- Tasks completion reminder
- Get notification of unfinished tasks in the past
- Statistical reporting and task management
- Can pin important tasks (priority tasks)
- Organize tasks reasonably
▷Notes:
- Create notes with cute colors, highlight important events
▷Cloud:
- Sync and backup your data with your iCloud
▷Diary:
- Mood diary, you can post your many pictures unlimitedly
▷ Habits:
- Create a new habit, track your challenges daily
And many other small features:
- Private key (Passcode and FaceID)
- IOS 14 widget with many kinds (calendar, mood, todo, memo) can change color
- Lock Screen Widget
- Change calendar theme
- Change background effect
- Choose multiple emojis
- Advanced reminder
- DarkMode and LightMode
- Check the weather on the calendar
Some tips for using the Cute Calendar App for you
- Students: Use the Countdown feature of important test dates to ensure effective preparation. Use Events to schedule planner your studies in school.
- Office workers: Todo list will be your important friend. Make a list of things to do for the day and mark them. Create an agenda to record your day's performance
- Flower shop owner: Make a list of types to buy during the day with a Todo list so as not to be missed. Make agenda to take note of orders of the day.

bluejetty:00044758:ios.name: My Porsche
bluejetty:00044758:ios.summary: The My Porsche app is the ideal companion for your Porsche experience. Call up the current vehicle status at any time and control Connect services remotely. The app is constantly being developed and additional features will be added in the
bluejetty:00044758:ios.description:
The My Porsche app is the ideal companion for your Porsche experience. Call up the current vehicle status at any time and control Connect services remotely. The app is constantly being developed and additional features will be added in the next versions.
The My Porsche app offers you the following advantages*: 
VEHICLE STATUS 
You can view the vehicle status at any time and display current vehicle information: 
• Fuel level/battery status and remaining range 
• Mileage 
• Tire pressure
• Trip data for your past journeys
• Closing status of the doors and windows 
• Remaining charging time
REMOTE CONTROL 
Control certain vehicle functions remotely:
• Air conditioning/pre-heater
• Locking and unlocking of the doors
• Horn and turn signals
• Location alarm and speed alarm
• Remote Park Assist
NAVIGATION
Plan your next route:
• Call up the vehicle location
• Navigation to the vehicle
• Save destinations as favorites
• Send destinations to vehicle
• Find e-charging stations 
• Route planner including charging stops
CHARGING
Manage and control vehicle charging: 
• Charging timer
• Direct charging
• Charging profiles
• Charging planner
• Charging service: information about e-charging stations, activation of charging process, transaction history
SERVICE & SAFETY
Receive important information about workshop appointments, breakdown calls and operating instructions: 
• Service intervals and service appointment request
• VTS, theft notification, breakdown call
• Digital owners manual
DISCOVER PORSCHE
Receive exclusive information about Porsche:
• Latest information about the Porsche brand
• Upcoming events from Porsche
• Exclusive content about your Porsche in production
*In order to use all the features of the My Porsche app, you need a Porsche ID account. Simply register at login.porsche.com and add your Porsche if you own a vehicle. Please note that the range of features of the app may differ depending on the model, model year and country availability.
Note: To make the best use of Connect Services for your vehicle, updates to the IoT containers in your vehicle might be performed in the background, without requiring any action on your part. The purpose of these updates is to ensure the functionality and stability of the services.

bluejetty:00157535:ios.name: Washswat
bluejetty:00157535:ios.summary:
● Contactless pickup and delivery, ready in a second at your door
Just place an order in the app and leave your laundry at your door. You can follow every step from pickup to delivery in real time, so you can hand it over without worrying a
bluejetty:00157535:ios.description:
● Contactless pickup and delivery, ready in a second at your door
Just place an order in the app and leave your laundry at your door. You can follow every step from pickup to delivery in real time, so you can hand it over without worrying about loss or damage.
● Experts inspect your laundry in person and share a care report
Every item is checked in person by a skilled expert. We look for stains, lint, and damaged spots, mark them with photos, and recommend the right washing method for each piece in a report. You can see exactly how it was washed and how it turned out, with nothing hidden.
● No surprise charges, just the care you choose
We suggest only the care your laundry really needs, and you decide whether to go ahead. Whether protecting the fabric or removing a stain matters more, the choice of washing method is yours.
● Check an AI estimate before you hand it over
Take a photo of your laundry with the camera to see the expected cost in advance. There's no guessing about the price, so you can review a clear estimate before you send anything.
● Premium restoration care backed by professional know-how
Bring your favorite clothes back to life with premium care that goes through a professional process. If you have a treasured piece you're worried about, you can leave it to Washswat with confidence.
● App access permissions
These permissions help you use Washswat more comfortably. We're providing this notice in accordance with Article 22-2 (Consent to Access Authority) of the Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection, etc.
[Optional permissions]
Notifications: to let you know about pickup, delivery, and washing progress
Camera: to photograph your laundry with the AI lens and check its type and condition
Photos and media: to upload laundry photos and attach or review your requests
You can still use the rest of the service even if you don't allow the optional permissions. Only those specific features will be limited. You can change permissions anytime in Settings > Apps > Washswat > Permissions.
● We're always here to help
1:1 chat support: every day, 7AM to 8PM
Phone support: weekdays, 9AM to 6PM (lunch 12PM to 1PM)
Customer center: 1566-5892
KakaoTalk channel: @세탁특공대
Closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Chuseok

bluejetty:00046936:ios.summary:
The veil between worlds has fallen. Colossal beasts have emerged from the shadows to lay waste to Earth’s greatest cities. From the glowing city skylines to the depths of the unknown, the modern world is under siege.
You are the last line
bluejetty:00046936:ios.description:
The veil between worlds has fallen. Colossal beasts have emerged from the shadows to lay waste to Earth’s greatest cities. From the glowing city skylines to the depths of the unknown, the modern world is under siege.
You are the last line of defense - a Dragon Rider destined to bridge the gap between ancient magic and modern survival. Strap in, draw your blade, and take to the skies in Dragon Wings, the ultimate fusion of classic Shmup action and epic fantasy role-playing!
GAME FEATURES:
VIBRANT MODERN X FANTASY WORLD: Experience a unique battlefield where high-fantasy magic invades the modern urban skyline. Battle through high-contrast, visually stunning environments that bring the "Modern x Fantasy" conflict to life.
THE VALKYRIE & DRAGON BOND: You aren't just flying a ship - you are commanding a legend. Take control of a Valkyrie, wielding both legendary blades and your dragon’s elemental fire to take down the invading monster hordes.
SCREEN-FILLING BOSS BATTLES: Face off against colossal, multi-phase bosses. From the lightning-charged Bee Hive Queen to the towering Void Demon, every encounter is a high-stakes test of your reflexes and strategy.
DEEP RPG & ROGUELIKE PROGRESSION: Evolve your Valkyrie and upgrade your dragon as you fly. Choose powerful skills during combat and customize your hero with rare gear. Master the Elemental Combat System (Wind, Fire, Ice) to exploit enemy weaknesses and dominate the sky.
OVER 200 CHALLENGING LEVELS: Embark on a massive campaign to push back the monster invasion. With daily missions, special events, and an endless survival mode, the battle to protect Earth never ends.
PLAY ANYWHERE – FULLY OFFLINE: No Wi-Fi? No problem! Save the world anytime, anywhere. Dragon Wings is fully playable offline, making it the perfect companion for your commute or travels.
The skies are burning. Will you answer the call?
Download Dragon Wings today and start your legend!

bluejetty:00041812:ios.description:
MyLink My Zone
MyLink is a one-stop and all-round smart life APP released by China Mobile Hong Kong, dedicated to providing intelligent and convenient life services for residents in Hong Kong. It enables CMHK customers to easily handle communication services anytime and anywhere, and provides a wealth of practical and useful life benefits and services for all MyLink users in Hong Kong and the mainland, striving to be the "intelligent life assistant" for Hong Kong residents.
● MyPet: Choose your own pet now and start the journey with it. Interact with your pet daily to level up and earn MyLink points!
● Ar Link Notification: You can not only visually view their prepaid SIM card and billing information, but also view mall orders, transportation orders, data usage and other communication notifications.
● Mall: Provide cross-border bus routes for the opening of the Shenzhen-Zhongshan Link. TurboJet Hong Kong-Macau 
Ticket Services Online. Endless Coupons and Discounts on Top Brands, Flash Deals at Rock-Bottom Prices, More Precise Product and Service Search, Plus Coupon Center and Uninterrupted Cross-Border Logistics Services.
● Vouchers market: You can order local rights and interests in Hong Kong, such as coffee coupons, Ocean Park discounts, etc., and can also easily order rich mainland rights and interests, such as tea, bus, massage, etc., to meet users' diverse needs for living in the two places.
● MyGarden’s colorful gameplay：Daily task can earn you carbon reduction exp to help your plants grow faster; Complete plant upgrades to earn MyLink points; The Carbon Reduction Mall offers prop packs for exchange, to decorate your very own garden. Whether it's carbon reduction tasks, or plant upgrades, MyGarden has prepared an array of exciting activities waiting for you to experience.
● WeWalk: Optimized the step counting authorization and binding process. Complete daily tasks to earn EXP, unlock growth Exp, and earn reward points.
Subject to the relevant terms and conditions

bluejetty:00148695:ios.description:
Ghost Writer: Song Writing App is not your average songwriting app—it’s like having a quirky, genius ghostwriter on speed dial, ready to help you create those epic lyrics for songs, whether you’re an aspiring pop star, underground rapper, or just someone who likes to belt out tunes in the shower!
OVERVIEW
• Ever found yourself staring at a blank page wondering, “How do I finish the lyrics?” Well, wonder no more! Our AI-powered marvel is both a song lyric generator and an AI rap lyric generator rolled into one. It’s here to sprinkle magic (and a dash of cheeky humor) into your songwriting process, turning your wild ideas into chart-topping masterpieces.
KEY FEATURES
• AI-Powered Inspiration: Think of our app as your personal, slightly eccentric ghostwriter. Need fresh ideas or a twist for your verse? Our AI lyric generator whips up original lines that fit your mood, genre, and style. It’s like having a songwriting buddy who never sleeps!
• Dynamic Lyric Creation: Whether you’re looking to craft a poetic ballad or spit some fire in a rap battle, our easy-to-use editor lets you experiment with different line lengths, structures, and rhythms. It’s the ultimate song lyric maker that lets you play with words like a wordsmith on a caffeine high.
• Built-In Rhyming Assistance: Ever get stuck on a word and feel like you’re hitting a lyrical wall? Our built-in rhyming tool is here to save the day—helping you find that perfect rhyme so you can finish the lyrics without losing your groove.
• Seamless Workflow: Save your genius creations in the “My Lyrics” section, where every quirky verse and heartfelt hook is just a tap away. It’s like having a personal library of your own musical brilliance—no overdue fines, we promise!
• Versatility Across Genres: From catchy pop hooks to edgy rap verses, our app adapts to your creative vibe. It’s the ultimate lyric writer that’s as versatile as your favorite playlist.
WHY CHOOSE Ghost Writer: Song Writing App?
• Finish the Lyrics with Flair: Say goodbye to writer’s block and hello to endless inspiration. Our AI ghostwriter is here to help you finish the lyrics in a snap, so you can focus on what really matters: turning your ideas into earworms!
• Fun Meets Functionality: Who said songwriting had to be serious all the time? With a playful interface and unexpected surprises, our app makes the creative process as fun as a karaoke night with friends—minus the off-key singing.
• For Every Music Lover: Whether you’re a seasoned pro or a weekend musician, our app is designed for everyone who’s ever dreamed of crafting unforgettable lyrics. It’s the song lyric generator that speaks your language—no autotune required!
GET READY TO ROCK!
Transform your songwriting game with Ghost Writer: Song Writing App. Let our AI-powered ghostwriter inspire you to create lyrics that are as catchy as they are clever. Download now, dive into a world of creative possibilities, and get ready to rock the stage—your next hit is just a tap away!
Please note that lyric generation and rhyming features are available with a subscription, which you can easily access through our paywall.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS:
• Start with a 7-day free trial and experience our app. After the trial, subscribe for unlimited access to all lyrics generation and lyrics editing features.
SUPPORT AND FEEDBACK:
• We’re always working to improve Ghost Writer: Song Writing App. Share your feedback and help us make the app better for you.
Embrace your inner wordsmith and let the magic begin. Your audience (and your showerhead) will thank you!
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

From Photo Prints that revive the memories hidden on your phone
bluejetty:00036853:ios.description:
The easiest way to print your Google Photos, iPhone, and iCloud photos!
Do you want to give someone a gift they will never forget? You can find it all right here in our app!
From Photo Prints that revive the memories hidden on your phone or cloud, and Memory Books that bring back the nostalgic photo albums of the 80s and 90s, to Gift Boxes designed to relieve your "what should I buy?" stress—we have unique home decor products and so much more waiting for you.
What are these Gifts?
Photo Prints: Pola Prints, Classic Prints, Square Prints, and more... Available in glossy or matte finishes and various color & size options!
Albums: Past generations' unforgettable photo albums and scrapbooks are trending again! Take notes, decorate them as you like, stick photos with colorful stickers, and bring your memories to life.
Wall Decoration: Decorate your home with Wooden Frames, Sticky Frames, Wooden Wall Signs, and more.
Magnets: Square, classic, retro, or round. Pick your favorite and decorate any metal surface with your memories!
Canvas Prints: No matter the photo or print size you choose, all your memories will look stunning on canvas.
Calendars: You won’t want to put our calendars away, even long after the year is over! It is the perfect way to relive your best memories all year round.
Gift Boxes: We know a gift must be carefully thought out and prepared. We have gift boxes to suit every taste!
Accessories: With various wooden pegs and display stands, you have plenty of stylish choices for your walls and tables.
How Do I Order?
Download our mobile app.
Log in with your Google or Apple account, or your email.
Choose a Sosyopix product you love and start personalizing it.
Enter your shipping address and complete your payment!
Be the first to know about surprise campaigns and discounts. Download our mobile app right now and never miss an opportunity!
Why Choose Us?
Quick and Easy Payment Complete your order securely and quickly using a credit card, debit card, or cash-on-delivery option.
User-Friendly Interface Thanks to our time-saving, simple interface, you can effortlessly browse products, upload photos, and place your order in just minutes.
High-Quality & Premium Customer Experience We guarantee 100% happiness. Our dedicated Customer Service team is ready to answer your questions within 24 hours. We truly value your suggestions and opinions!
Who Are We?
Sosyopix has been Turkey’s first and largest personalized gift platform since 2014. We designed Sosyopix to keep your most meaningful, cherished photos right by your side whenever you want. Today, we have expanded beyond Turkey and are delivering happiness worldwide.
Our journey, which began with photo printing, continues to grow with our "Brighten Up Your Day" gifts and an ever-expanding product variety. Our primary goal is to deliver excellence. That’s why we work diligently on every single detail because we care about you. We create specially prepared, personalized products using the photos of your choice and deliver them to you or your loved ones quickly. 
From concept gift boxes to home decor, fashion, and accessories—there is a wide range of remarkable gift options waiting for you at Sosyopix.

- Regular level updates
- Opportunity to play offline

bluejetty:00169229:ios.description:
Toronto Bus & Subway Tracker — Your Smarter Way Around Toronto
Get real-time TTC bus, streetcar, and subway updates — all in one easy-to-use app designed to make getting around Toronto simple and reliable.
“Finally, an app that shows when the bus is actually coming. The live TTC times are accurate, and the trip planner helps me get anywhere in the city stress-free.”
Why Torontonians love Toronto Bus & Subway Tracker:
• Live TTC bus, streetcar, and subway tracking
• Stop and schedule alerts
• Trip planner with step-by-step directions
• Live and offline route maps
• One-tap “Get Me Home” journeys
• Customizable widgets for quick access
Never miss your stop again — with Get Off Alerts, the app reminds you just before you need to hop off. Track your bus or train in real time, check how crowded it is before boarding, and get instant notifications about delays, diversions, or planned work.
Whether you’re heading downtown on Line 1, catching a streetcar along Queen Street, or commuting to Scarborough, Toronto Bus & Subway Tracker keeps you in control of your trip.
Coverage Includes:
• TTC Buses and Streetcars
• TTC Subway Lines 1 (Yonge-University), 2 (Bloor-Danforth), 3 (Scarborough), and 4 (Sheppard)
• GO Transit connections across the Greater Toronto Area
• UP Express and York Region Transit links
• Real-time service alerts, detours, and closures
Plan your route, check live arrivals, and save your favourite stops — all in one reliable app built for Toronto commuters.
--------
What is Toronto Bus & Subway Tracker?
Toronto Bus & Subway Tracker is a real-time public transit app for the Greater Toronto Area. It shows live TTC bus, streetcar, and subway times, plus service alerts and trip planning.
Does it work with the TTC?
Yes — it covers all TTC buses, streetcars, and subway lines with live arrivals and real-time service alerts.
Can I track TTC streetcars and buses in real time?
Absolutely. You can view live vehicle locations, arrival times, and service updates on the map.
Does it include GO Transit and UP Express?
Yes. Toronto Bus & Subway Tracker includes GO Transit and UP Express schedules, so you can plan multi-agency trips easily.
Can I use the app offline?
Yes — offline route maps and saved timetables let you plan ahead without mobile data.
Will it remind me when to get off?
Yes. “Get Off Alerts”

bluejetty:00018168:ios.name: National Debt - USA & World
bluejetty:00018168:ios.summary: "National Debt" provides insight into the national debts of more than 180 countries! It shows the development of the national debt in real-time, and provides an overview of the year-to-year historical development of the debt. The app has th
bluejetty:00018168:ios.description:
"National Debt" provides insight into the national debts of more than 180 countries! It shows the development of the national debt in real-time, and provides an overview of the year-to-year historical development of the debt. The app has the option to display the debt as percentage of the gross national product, and show this result on a comprehensive World Debt Map!
To put the large numbers of the national debt into perspective, the app shows what you would have been able to buy with the national debt (e.g. find out how many Iraq Wars is equivalent to the national debt). You can adapt and specify your own items in this list.
The app also shows how long it would take to pay off the debt when paying a given amount per day, and shows the debt as percentage of the gross national product.
The data is based on official numbers provided by the governments and are updated on a regular basis.
Disclaimer: the real-time numbers in the app are estimates. No rights may be derived from the data provided in the app.
