From the creators of Frozen pop comes our latest take on the bubble shooter genre, Christmas Games! Join Santa on his world tour to collect toys for next year’s Christmas delivery! 
Travel throughout the world as Santa and collect toys trapped in colorful bubbles! Face Santa’s adversaries as they try to stop you from getting gifts for all the good boys and girls on Christmas eve! 
Make your path through many different parts of the world, and through many unique challenges to end at Christmas, in a final showdown against Jack Frost himself! 
Daily quests and challenging levels await you in this perilous but beautiful world! 
Game Features:

- Multiple worlds based around different seasons! 
- Beautiful, hand-crafted animations! 
- Multiple exciting boss battles! 
- Daily Quests to challenge and reward you! 
- Multiple powerups to ease the challenge! 
- Multiple special bubbles to spice up your adventure! 
Christmas Games is completely free to play! Some optional items in-game require purchases but are not a necessity towards game completion.

bluejetty:00146398:ios.description:
"Detective Club: Missing in the Fog" invites you to step into the fog-draped streets of Victorian London for the ultimate free-to-play detective adventure. Join Thomas, a young investigator, as he embarks on a harrowing journey to solve the mystery of his best friend Emily's disappearance. Dive into a world of search and find games where every clue uncovers more of the gripping tale. Solve intricate puzzles, unravel conspiracies, and outsmart villains in this captivating addition to the world of mystery hidden object games. Can you crack the case and save Emily before it’s too late?
Step into the foggy streets of Victorian London and follow Thomas, a daring young detective, as he races to uncover the truth behind his best friend Emily's mysterious disappearance. With his loyal companion George by his side, he unravels a web of secrets: a murder, a sinister laboratory, and a shipwreck conspiracy. The journey is fraught with peril as the company faces threats from ruthless criminals, who harbor sins of their tragic past and deadly motives. Will Thomas be able to save his friend and bring the villains to justice, or will the shadows of Victorian London claim another victim? In this thrilling hidden-object game, the answers lie at your fingertips.
- Victorian London!
Explore the foggy streets of Victorian London as you unravel a gripping mystery filled with danger and intrigue. This detective adventure takes you deep into a world of mystery games, where every clue could lead you closer to saving Emily!
- Solve Challenging Mysteries!
Use your wits and detective skills to crack object finding games, uncover hidden objects, and decode clues. Each search and find game challenge brings you closer to solving the biggest crime investigation in the city. With every discovery, you’ll unravel a sinister web of lies and conspiracies in this mystery detective adventure!
- Rewards and Hidden Collectibles!
Show off your detective prowess by unlocking achievements and uncovering rare collectibles that enhance the narrative. Each clue you find in these search and find games adds depth to your investigation, while mastering the challenges of object finding games brings a sense of achievement!
- Make Critical Choices!
Your decisions matter! As you progress through this detective adventure, you’ll face tough choices that shape the story. Will you save Emily in time and solve mystery games? With multiple endings, this crime investigation experience ensures replayability for fans of search and find games!
The answers are waiting for you to find them! Play "Detective Club: Missing in the Fog" now for free.

bluejetty:00071364:ios.summary:
Every ride tells a story. Map My Tracks helps you understand yours.
Whether you're cycling the same route every day, training for a sportive, or exploring new roads, Map My Tracks gives you insights that actually matter. Discover patterns
bluejetty:00071364:ios.description:
Every ride tells a story. Map My Tracks helps you understand yours.
Whether you're cycling the same route every day, training for a sportive, or exploring new roads, Map My Tracks gives you insights that actually matter. Discover patterns in your training. Celebrate streaks that keep you motivated. Understand what your body is telling you. Join over a million people who've made Map My Tracks their go-to companion for cycling.
=====
Featured in Apple's What's hot list
#1 iPhone app in Health & Fitness in Japan, France, Belgium, Iceland, Czech Republic
=====
YOUR PERSONAL CYCLING COACH
After every ride, get feedback that's tailored to you. Learn about your training consistency and performance trends. Discover which routes bring out your best. Understand your training load, recovery needs, and performance progression. Get intelligent analysis that helps you improve.
See patterns like: "Your power output improves on rolling terrain" or "You perform best with two rest days between hard efforts." Understand your training load before you overtrain. Celebrate when you hit a new streak or PR. It's like having a coach who knows your history and adapts to your goals.
TRACK YOUR RIDES WITH PRECISION
Record every ride with GPS accuracy. Track distance, speed, pace, elevation gain, heart rate, power, calories, and duration. Or just press start and let the app do the work. Review your week at a glance or dive deep into detailed stats when you want them.
Connect your Garmin, Wahoo, Coros, HeathKit, or more, to automatically bring all your rides into one place. All your training—all your insights—in a single app.
SHARE YOUR CYCLING ADVENTURES
Broadcast live so friends and family can follow along during sportives or epic rides. Add photos and create videos that capture the whole experience. Follow friends and keep each other motivated. Or keep it private—it's your choice.
SET YOUR CYCLING GOALS
Whether it's completing your first century ride, building base fitness, conquering a gran fondo, or improving your FTP, set goals that matter to you. Track your progress with intelligent insights that help you get there.
COMPETE AND EXPLORE
Compare your performance on segment leaderboards. Challenge yourself on popular climbs and routes. Discover new roads and cycling routes near you. Track your progress over time and see your improvement.
UNLOCK EVERYTHING WITH PLUS
• AI-powered Activity Insights after every ride with cycling-specific analysis
• Live tracking so others can follow your progress during events and long rides
• Ad-free experience
• Advanced analysis tools on app and website
• Full access to all features
Subscriptions for Map My Tracks PLUS are $4.99 per month or $49.99 for a full year. Map My Tracks PLUS subscriptions will be charged to your iTunes account after your confirmation of purchase. Your monthly subscription will automatically renew each month and be charged through your iTunes account, yearly subscriptions will automatically renew each year. Subscriptions renew at $4.99 per month or $49.99 for a full year automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings. Cancellation of the current active subscription period is not allowed.
FEEDBACK
If you're enjoying Map My Tracks: Cycling Tracker, leave us a good review in the App Store. If not, send your feedback to support@mapmytracks.com and let us fix it before you write a review.
Map My Tracks uses HealthKit to export your cycling activities into the Health app and to read heart rate and biometric data. This service is optional. Please note that continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
Terms of service: https://www.mapmytracks.com/term-service
Privacy policy: https://www.mapmytracks.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00032994:ios.description:
Transform your music and lighting into a captivating visual journey with iLightShow, the premier app designed to sync your favorite tracks from Spotify and Apple Music with your Philips Hue, LIFX, and Nanoleaf setups. Create an electrifying atmosphere perfect for dance, parties, or any moment worth illuminating with dynamic light effects and strobes that perfectly match the rhythm of your music.
Key Features:
- Music Integration: Seamlessly connect with Spotify and Apple Music to bring your playlists to life. iLightShow ensures your Philips Hue, LIFX, and Nanoleaf lights mirror the energy and tempo of your music, setting the stage for unforgettable dance and party moments.
- Extensive Light Compatibility: Designed for versatility, iLightShow is compatible with Philips Hue (requiring a Hue bridge v2), LIFX Lights, and Nanoleaf Panels, enabling a broad range of visual experiences, from soothing ambient setups to lively dance floors.
- Precision Sync: Our sophisticated algorithm detects every beat, drop, and mood shift in your music, ensuring your light effects and FX are in perfect synchronisation. Whether it’s for a party, dance, or relaxation, the lights follow every nuance of your soundtracks.
- Customized Visuals: Dive deep into customization with adjustable strobes, flashes, pulses, and more to match your party or dance theme. Select from an array of palettes to craft the perfect ambiance for every track, enhancing every beat and rhythm for a truly immersive experience.

bluejetty:00071751:ios.description:
With hashcloud – your new cloud storage - you can easily share files using #hashtags.
Simply come up with a new #hashtag and share it with friends or colleagues. Anyone who knows this #hashtag can then upload files to it and download files from other users. This makes hashcloud perfect for exchanging files at university, at work, among friends, or within the family.
Hashcloud is a cloud storage service designed specifically for easy file sharing. You no longer need to ask for contact information from people you want to collaborate with. Nor do you need to create complicated and confusing links to send to these individuals. With hashcloud, you simply come up with a suitable #hashtag that best describes your group work or file directory. The involved parties can easily remember this #hashtag and enter it into their app.
The cloud storage is completely hosted in Germany. All files are stored on German servers and are thus subject to GDPR. So, you don't have to worry about your files falling into the wrong hands. Also, a #hashtag acts like a password. The more difficult and unique your #hashtag is, the less likely someone will access your files. Conversely, you can also create open #hashtags, for example, if you want to share files with as many users as possible. However, if you want to be completely secure, simply add a password to your #hashtag. You must be an admin or the creator of the #hashtag to do this. Other users can only join the #hashtag if they also know your chosen password.
So, your files are always protected in hashcloud storage. Here's a list of all features:
+ File sharing via #hashtags – Avoid cumbersome links and share your files using easy-to-remember #hashtags
+ Access to all files (free and without registration/login) at www.hash.cloud
+ All files and user data are stored on German servers and are subject to GDPR
+ Password protection for extremely sensitive files
+ Available as an iOS and web app (www.hash.cloud)
+ Upload up to 10 files simultaneously
Accessing files is completely free. Only for uploading new files, you need to purchase a quota. You can test the platform with up to 1GB of storage for uploading files. If you need more storage, please consider upgrading to hashcloud+ with 1,000GB of storage.
For more information, visit www.hash.cloud.
For questions and suggestions, we are available at help@hash.cloud at any time.
Terms of Use: https://www.miosga-software.com/Terms_of_Use_EN.pdf
Privacy Policy: https://www.miosga-software.com/Privacy_Policy_EN.pdf

bluejetty:00080466:ios.name: Mitigate
bluejetty:00080466:ios.summary: Mitigate™ is the field app from Cotality™ for restoration professionals who'd rather be drying structures than filling out paperwork. Capture everything a water loss needs — right from your phone, right where the work is happening — in a wo
bluejetty:00080466:ios.description:
Mitigate™ is the field app from Cotality™ for restoration professionals who'd rather be drying structures than filling out paperwork. Capture everything a water loss needs — right from your phone, right where the work is happening — in a workflow built around the daily rhythm of a mitigation project.
Set up the job the way it actually dries:
Create the loss, map out levels and rooms, and build your drying chambers to match how the structure really breaks down — not a generic form.
Record readings that hold up:
Capture moisture content by material and monitoring point, plus atmospheric and psychrometric conditions — tied to the room they came from and tracked toward your drying goals.
Log your equipment:
Place dehumidifiers and air movers by chamber and room, and keep a running record from setup to demobilization.
Keep photos where they belong:
Attach documentation to the exact room, chamber, or reading it supports, pre-tagged so nothing is lost in a camera roll.
Work where you work:
Capture in the field even when signal doesn't cooperate; your work uploads automatically in the background once you're connected.
Documentation you can stand behind:
Restoration work only counts if it's documented. Because every reading, photo, and piece of equipment is tied to where and when it happened, the record builds itself as you do the job. When it's time to justify the drying plan — to a reviewer, a carrier, or your own office — the whole story is already there, organized and complete.
Everything you log flows to the web portal, so the job is documented once, cleanly, and stays in sync.
Confidently do what you do best. Built for the field, trusted on the claim.

"Learn English - Listening And Speaking" is one of PORO’s ongoing apps for self-learners who want to speak English easily and effectively. With 750 daily dialogues, a list of le
bluejetty:00186683:ios.description:
LET’S START LEARNING TO SPEAK ENGLISH LIKE A NATIVE SPEAKER! 
"Learn English - Listening And Speaking" is one of PORO’s ongoing apps for self-learners who want to speak English easily and effectively. With 750 daily dialogues, a list of lessons with various topics from greeting, introduction, shopping, business conversations, family talks, etc…. It's suitable for all English learners from beginner to intermediate and advanced learners to practice speaking English.
While listening to the conversation of the native speaker, try to imitate full sentences with the same intonation, pronunciation like the native speaker. By PORO's app, you can not only learn the speaking style, pronunciation, the way to break and intonation of native speakers and improve listening skill but also learn groups of vocabularies and useful phrases to communicate in daily talking.
»»»»»»»»» Main features of PORO's App:
»»» Common conversations.
- More than 750 lessons about English common conversation in daily life with audio files of native speakers.
- Various topics from greeting, introduction, small talk to business conversations… 
- Consist of the audio script for learner to follow. 
»»» Show/ Hide transcript, translation.
- Understand and remember the native speaker's reading way by customizing the show/ hide transcript mode.
- Understand the meaning of new vocabulary and the meaning of the full sentence in each situation by customizing the translation mode
»»» Sentences are highlighted following the audio. 
- The mode that sentences are highlighted following the audio will help you to follow the conversation directly. 
- You can click on the sentence to listen/ practice that phrase again
»»» Playlist mode.
Enjoy practicing English while driving or traveling…, you just need to turn on the app and click on playlist mode. 
»»» Practice game.
By playing completing sentences game, you would know if you have already remembered the full sentence and its structure or not.
»»» Learn English through news.
Not only can you improve your listening skill and vocabulary but also can enrich your knowledge and update world news.
»»» Learn English through stories.
Learning English becomes more interesting because PORO has added a new function called Learning English through stories. You can enlarge your vocabulary, and learn how to express yourself in particular situations!
»»»»»»»»»»»» The App “Learn English - Listening And Speaking" is suitable for:
»»» False-beginners and who want to improve English communication.
»»» Those who self-study English at home.
»»» Learners who want to practice for TOEIC, IELTS tests. 
»»» Those who love communicating in English and practicing English by shadowing method.
»»» Those who like to challenge your level. 
“Learn English - Listening And Speaking” App is still in the developing process, so we hope to receive your contributed comment to make it better. We are a team that loves the English language and always try to share our love with the community, so if you like this app then please take a moment to rate 5 stars for it! You can also contact us by commenting or clicking the feedback button on the options screen. 
»»»»»»»»»»»» Please kindly contact: 
- Email: support@porostudio.com 
- Terms of Service : https://www.app-privacy-policy.com/live.php?token=9IX6U9VAY1mzwTkiOgzvo0UH5Xh6CkfD
- Privacy Policy : https://www.app-privacy-policy.com/live.php?token=cxtcI7oVskzmPTGNmt2cQIOT19S7fwDh
Thank you very much and good luck to you!

From the cool to the functional to the downright weird, we showcase over 25,000 live products across 350 categories. We also feature 12 new discoveries every single day to cater to every interest whether you’re into the latest smart home devices or EDC gear.

Use the app to save products to your wish list and create a custom feed to discover more from your favorite categories. With detailed yet engaging descriptions paired with high-quality photos and videos, you wouldn’t be the first user to go down a satisfying spiral of product discovery.

Whether you’re looking for geeky gadgets, luxurious products, travel gadgets, camping gear, car accessories, drones, TVs, gaming gear, or simply a gift for someone special, you’ll find it here.

By chance Lily met the handsome painter Jack. The two fell in love at first sight. Jack invited Lily to spend Christmas at his castle. Because of Jack's need to leave, Lily strolled about alone in the castle and unexpectedly uncovered many secrets. A sleeping Egyptian girl, a girl frozen in the cellar, and an immobilized Japanese geisha. A female character beset by monsters.
All the mysteries you must uncover!
Begin an exciting and terrifying castle adventure, a thrilling challenging escape and save the imprisoned girl. All the puzzle levels are progressive, and more fun games are waiting to challenge you!
We also made it user-friendly with cheat codes. At key moments you will be given a small hint, allowing you to smoothly advance. Beloved mystery game of young players. Don't miss out on such a classic mystery game!

bluejetty:00136201:ios.description:
Parenting is hard. Getting sleep + peace of mind shouldn’t be! Maximize your Happiest Baby devices’ ZZZs-boosting benefits—plus, get expert tips, track activities & more! 
The Happiest Baby App is your all-in-one parenting companion. It connects seamlessly with your Happiest Baby devices, including SNOO Smart Sleeper—the world’s first FDA De Novo authorized infant sleep system—and SNOObie Smart Soother—our all-in-one sound machine, nightlight, and sleep trainer, while offering additional features like a free baby tracker and the Timeline, packed with personalized parenting advice. 
CUSTOMIZE YOUR SNOO EXPERIENCE 
Created by Dr. Harvey Karp, renowned pediatrician and sleep expert, SNOO intelligently responds to your baby’s needs with womb-like soothing to help the whole family get 1-2+ hours more sleep a night. The Happiest Baby App lets caregivers personalize their baby’s sleep journey with advanced SNOO settings, including: 
* Log: Track every SNOOze automatically, see sleep-wake patterns at a glance, and keep tabs on sleep successes! 
* Alerts: Get notified if your baby needs more than SNOO's soothing (due to hunger or discomfort). 
* Remote Control: Quickly respond to your baby's unique needs by adjusting SNOO’s levels up and down. 
* Adapt: Pick the best motion and white noise settings for your baby—boost the level of rhythmic sensation to get through sleep disruptions, adjust sensitivity for the just-right response, and more! 
* Easy Weaning: Special setting helps babies learn to sleep without motion, to prepare for the transition to the crib. 
EASILY TRACK BABY’S ACTIVITIES 
Record sleep (in and out of SNOO), feeds, diaper changes, growth, and pumping all in one place so you get a full picture of your baby’s routines! 
GET DR. KARP’S ADVICE…AT YOUR FINGERTIPS 
Like a pediatrician in your pocket, more than 1,000 articles and expert tips are available in the Timeline to answer your questions and guide you through every little milestone of babyhood...and beyond! 
PROGRAM SNOOBIE ROUTINES 
SNOObie is our all-in-one white noise machine and nightlight system! This portable bedtime buddy features customizable nightlight colors and special soothing sounds that can be controlled with the App. To program SNOObie routines that signal when it’s time to sleep or when it’s okay to wake, just pick your preferred light color, sound, time, and day(s) of the week. Once you save the routine, set it by tapping your device to SNOObie, and your routine will be ready to play at the scheduled day and time! 
A Wi-Fi® connection is required to connect the App to your Happiest Baby products. An NFC-enabled device is required to connect the App to SNOObie. For more info or if you have questions, visit HappiestBaby.com! 
Note: Auto-renewable subscriptions can be canceled anytime with no penalty. 
Prices are in USD. Pricing may vary in other countries and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on your country of residence. Payment will be charged at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period with the same term (monthly) and same price. 
Privacy Policy: https://legal.happiestbaby.com/privacy-policy?lang=en_US 
Terms of Service: https://legal.happiestbaby.com/terms-of-service?lang=en_US 
ISI: https://happiestbaby.com/fda

bluejetty:00160612:ios.description:
GhanaPostGPS is Ghana’s official digital property addressing system which ensures that all locations in the country are addressed. With GhanaPostGPS, every location has a unique digital address.
The digital address is a composite of the postcode (region, district & area code) plus a unique address. GhanaPostGPS translates your GPS location to a user friendly digital address. With GhanaPostGPS,
users can now precisely pinpoint any location in Ghana using the digital address of the place.
GhanaPostGPS is integrated with Google maps to allow for easy navigation of a particular area, detailing major road networks and other landmarks

Not anymore!!!
Meet your new design companion — Poster Maker: AI Flyer Design. Whether you're planning an event, building your brand, or just sharing a thought on your favorite platform — we give you the power to create stunning posters, flyers, logos, banners, and social media posts in minutes — no design skills required.
---
Design in Seconds. Impress for Days.
Bring your boldest ideas to life.
With 20,000+ fully customizable templates, you're never starting from scratch. Just pick a layout, plug in your message, and watch your ideas come alive — faster than ever.
From bold posters and elegant invitations to eye-catching Instagram stories and professional logos, you’ll find every format for every occasion.

Why People Love It:
AI Poster Generation
Type in your idea — like “Party flyer with neon theme” or “Elegant wedding invite” — and let AI instantly turn it into a ready-made design you can edit.
AI-Powered Templates
Let our smart engine recommend beautiful, ready-to-use layouts tailored to your purpose.
Beginner-Friendly Interface
No clutter. No confusion. Just powerful, easy-to-use tools that guide you every step of the way.
20,000+ Templates for Every Use
Posters. Flyers. Logos. Business cards. Invitations. Social media posts. Product and brand cutout. All fully editable.
Total Customization Control
Change text, swap images, adjust colors, add icons — all with drag-and-drop ease.
100+ Designer Fonts
Make your words pop with curated typography that fits your style and mood.
Built for Business and Social
Perfect for promoting events, products, services, or simply making your content shine on platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and more.
Save, Share & Reuse
Export in high resolution, save your work for later, and revisit designs whenever inspiration strikes.
---
One App. Endless Possibilities.
- Poster Maker AI – Launch ideas that stand out, from storefront posters to digital announcements using AI.
- Flyer Designer – Promote sales, events, and offers with stunning one-pagers.
- Logo Maker – Build a brand identity that’s both personal and professional.
- Invitation Maker – Craft heartfelt invites for weddings, birthdays, and celebrations.
- Social Media Editor – Create scroll-stopping posts and stories in just a few taps.
- Banner Creator – Design promotional banners, ads, and website headers with ease.
- AI Design Tools – Work faster and smarter with tools like AI Art Generator, Background Remover, Object Eraser, Image Upscaler, Photo Colorizer, and more — all built to save time and boost creativity.
---
Made for Creators, Entrepreneurs & Everyday Storytellers
Whether you're a small business owner, marketer, student, or influencer — Poster Maker helps you tell your story with style. Design isn’t just for professionals anymore — it’s for you.

bluejetty:00131645:ios.description:
We're working to make the place we call home, better. As the largest newsroom in Wisconsin, and a three-time Pulitzer Prize winner, we have an obligation to our community, to tell all the stories that need to be told. 
We’re here because we believe that local journalism is valuable – from simple things like the weather to hard-hitting opinions, breaking news and in-depth investigations. 
We’re our Milwaukee’s trusted storytellers. We’re here for it. 
WHAT WE’RE ALL ABOUT: 
• Journalism that makes our home better by celebrating the good, solving the bad, and investigating the ugly. 
• Access to Public Investigator, our Pulitzer Prize finalist series of quick-turn investigations. 
• Access to PackersNews.com, your source for unbeatable Packers coverage. Go pack go. 
• Sports coverage for locals, by locals: the Bucks, Brewers, Packers, Wisconsin Badgers, Marquette Hoops, and UW-Milwaukee. 
• Reporting that keeps you informed on the actions of decision makers and the political issues that impact residents. 
• Get the latest updates on the 2024 Presidential Election, as well as Wisconsin’s U.S. Senate and House races. 
• App features like real-time alerts, challenging puzzles and lively podcasts, a personalized feed, the eNewspaper, and more. 
APP FEATURES: 
• Real-time breaking news alerts 
• A personalized feed on the all-new For You page 
• The eNewspaper, a digital replica of our print newspaper 
Subscription Information:
• The Milwaukee Journal Sentinel app is free to download and all users can access a sampling of free articles every month. 
• Subscriptions are charged to your account at confirmation of purchase and automatically renew each month or year, unless turned off in your account settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. See "Subscription Support" in the app's Settings for more details and customer service contact information.  
MORE INFORMATION:
• Privacy Policy: https://cm.jsonline.com/privacy/
• Terms of Service: https://cm.jsonline.com/terms/
• Help Center: https://help.jsonline.com

bluejetty:00182910:ios.name: GL Golf
bluejetty:00182910:ios.summary: GL Golf is a 3D sports game for the casual gamer. With a realistic physics system and great simple graphics, you and up to four players can golf all 720 holes (some available through in-app purchase) for countless hours. Everything in a rea
bluejetty:00182910:ios.description:
GL Golf is a 3D sports game for the casual gamer. With a realistic physics system and great simple graphics, you and up to four players can golf all 720 holes (some available through in-app purchase) for countless hours. Everything in a real game of golf is included, such as water hazards, sand traps, trees, bushes, wind, four seasons, different time of days to play, and a driving range. Other great features include both an internet and individual high score list, game saving, great music, iTunes controls, 3 difficulty modes, mulligans, the ability to choose your set of clubs, match/stroke play, online tournaments, customizable male and female golfers, and much more. GL Golf is constantly being updated with free new features. Four new courses are released every year, available for in-app purchase.
*New Game Center Multiplayer Support* - Play against your friends or a random opponent on any of your favorite courses. Golfers alternate every three hole until a winner is crowed after all 18 holes are finished.
If you like GL Golf, make sure to check out Nuclear Nova’s other games, all available for the Mac/iPhone/iPad/iPod. 
• Nova Golf, the successor to GL Golf, is a much more detailed golf simulator with more modern graphics 
• Pinball Shuffle and Pinball Massacre are two unique comic book arcade style pinball tables 
• Barnyard Blaster is a unique shooter with plenty of weapons, animals, and environments 
• Rocket Golf gives golf a new twist with its unique 2D side scrolling gameplay 
• Liquid Defense, Hydrothermal, and Escape are our three classic puzzle/simulator games 
• Fractal 3D and ASCII Art are our first non-game apps
Play now on your iPhone, iPod, and iPad!
"This is a solid game and should definitely be on every duffer's app download list." -tuaw.com
"In the end, GL Golf is an incredibly deep game, serving up six courses and tons of options, it never gets old" -iPhoneGamingNetwork.com
"Of all the golf games and simulations I’ve played so far for the iPhone, there’s one that stands head-and-shoulders above the rest. GL Golf." -intomobile.com
"I must say, this app is a very fun app. I am kind of addicted." -iPhoneMatters.com
"The game play is solid. To swing the club just double tap on the screen; when the power meter reaches to a spot you want, just single tap and the club will swing, hitting the ball. You can change the type of club you have by dragging your finger up/down the screen, thereby changing the range. The game does pause itself when you tap the home button, so if you get a call while playing, you won't lose your game. " -Tuaw.com

bluejetty:00177639:ios.description:
Three Card Poker is a popular card Poker variant played in real Casino. 
This is an online casino game of 3 Card Poker for iPhone and iPad!
3 Card Poker is played against the dealer using 3 cards hands. 
In this casino game three independent bets can be played - Ante, Pair Plus and 6-Card Bonus. The Ante bet is compulsory whereas other two bets are optional.
You can start playing the 3 Card Poker as soon as you open our game with 100,000 Bonus chips.
How To play :
1. Select the poker chips and then click on the desired bet area on the table. 
2. After placing the bet, the player is dealt with three cards face up and the dealer with three cards face down. 
3. The player has the option to fold the hand or raise if he thinks he can beat the dealer's poker hand. 
4. If the player folds, he loses his ante bet. 
5. If the player raises, then an additional Play bet is made equal to the Ante bet and the dealer reveals his cards. 
6. The dealer qualifies only if he has Queen High or better. 
7. If the dealer doesn’t qualify, player wins 1 to 1 on Ante bet and Play bet will push. 
8. If the dealer qualifies, the higher poker hand between the player and the dealer wins. 
- If the player wins, he will get 1 to 1 on both Ante and Play bets. 
- If the dealer wins, player loses both the Ante and Play bets. 
- In case of a tie, Ante bet and Play bet will push. 
9. If the player has a Straight Poker Hand or higher, then he receives an Ante bonus. 
10. The Pair Plus bet wins if the player's hand has a Pair or higher. 
11. The 6-Card Bonus bet wins based on the highest 5-card hand that is made out of player’s and dealer’s 6 cards combined.
12. Payouts for Pair-Plus and 6-Card bonus bets are based on the rank of the hand.
Pair Plus Bonus Payouts
Straight Flush 40 to 1
Three of a Kind 30 to 1
Straight 6 to 1
Flush 4 to 1
Pair 1 to 1
6 Card Bonus Payouts
Royal Flush 1000 to 1
Straight Flush 200 to 1
Four of a Kind 100 to 1
Full House 25 to 1
Flush 15 to 1
Straight 10 to 1
Three of a Kind 5 to 1
Ante Bonus Payouts
Straight Flush 5 to 1
Three of a Kind 4 to 1
Straight 1 to 1

• HD Graphics and user friendly interface
• 20+ Tables with different betting options
• First Time Login Bonus and Daily Bonus in every 2 hours
• First 2 Table are Unlocked
• High stake tables get unlocked as you clear Levels
• Send and Receive Gifts from your friends in the form of chips
• Share your Score with friends on global leader board
• Invite Friends to play the game

• Check your game statistics

bluejetty:00130861:ios.description:
Welcome to Jigsaw Sort: Block Puzzle, the exciting new puzzle game where you can bring beautiful pictures back to life! With over 7000 carefully picked images to choose from, each level offers a unique and enjoyable experience that will keep you hooked for hours on end.
Unlike traditional jigsaw puzzles, Jigsaw Sort: Block Puzzle challenges you to restore scrambled images to their original state by sliding the tiles around the board. And with various puzzle styles to choose from, you'll never get bored!
Our game also has 10 beautiful frames for you to choose from, adding an extra sense of excitement to your game play. Completing each level is like completing a beautiful painting, and you'll love the feeling of accomplishment you get with each completed level. Plus, our frames will be updated regularly, so there's always something new and exciting to discover!
Jigsaw Sort: Block Puzzle is more than just a puzzle game - it's a fun and relaxing way to kill your free time. With the smooth interface and easy operation, you will enjoy the stress-free experience of playing our game.
So how to play this game？
1. Click or drag a tile onto another tile of the same shape.
2. The same tile will swap positions after moving, and different tiles cannot change positions.
3. The content on the four sides of the puzzle cannot be moved.
4. Move all the pieces to the correct position to complete the level.
Game features:
- jigsaw type game
-Multiple types of puzzle styles
-10 kinds of game frames
-7000+ levels
-Simple and fresh game interface
-Silky smooth operation feeling
-Play instantly, no waiting
-Easy game experience
-Release stress
So what are you waiting for? Come and feel the charm of Jigsaw Sort: Block Puzzle, the ultimate puzzle game for puzzle enthusiasts and casual gamers alike. Get ready to become a puzzle artist today!

bluejetty:00186939:ios.description:
All Right — English for kids online
An app for students of the AllRight online school. The first lesson is free!
- Lessons are conducted right in the app itself, now you can study without a computer!
- Here you can plan your lesson schedule, book and reschedule lessons.
- Track student progress and results of knowledge checks
- Get feedback from the teacher after the lesson: the app has a chat with the teacher, and you can always ask them questions that arise
- Stay connected with our school's support team in the chat within the app
- In the app, the child can do homework and will receive a reminder about an upcoming lesson
Why 15,000 parents from 46 countries have already choosen AllRight
- The teaching methodology is based on the Cambridge program, which means that after passing the level at school, children can take the Cambridge English Qualifications for Young Learners exam
- Lessons are taught by certified teachers with extensive experience working with children. All teachers are constantly trained, they know how to involve the child in play, how to get the child interested and motivated during lessons
- Learning takes place in a playful way: children sing songs, solve puzzles, and go on adventures. They are accompanied everywhere by our favorite character - Charlie the fox
- During lessons, we develop all of the language skills: listening (listening comprehension), reading, writing and speaking
- Programs and special courses are adapted to the child's age, interests and learning goals. You can choose a course on reading, a course on songs - it will help you set pronunciation and expand your vocabulary, a course on Minecraft - for those who are keen on the popular game.

Ahoy, Captain! Dive into the thrilling world of naval warfare in Warships Mobile 2, the ultimate modern warship game for your mobile device!
Command a fleet of cutting-edge warships, from nimble destroyers to formidable battleships, and dominate the high seas. - Regular Updates: Stay tuned for exciting new content, including additional warships, maps, game modes, and events. Keep your naval armada ready for new challenges. 
Get ready to set sail and conquer the oceans in Warships Mobile 2, the pinnacle of warship games. Hoist the anchor, raise the flag, and prepare for battle in the best warship simulator on mobile. It’s not just a game; it’s a naval war adventure!

bluejetty:00047003:ios.description:
WatchGuard’s AuthPoint app allows you to authenticate right from your own phone! No need to carry keyfobs or thumb drives; instead install and activate AuthPoint, and then use it to authenticate to company networks and cloud applications. It enables speedy push-based authentication as well as offline authentication using QR codes with the phone’s camera. This app requires activation of AuthPoint service, offered by WatchGuard.
The AuthPoint app features:
- convenient, secure authentication in seconds when you approve a push notification message
- additional storage for all your authenticators such as those used with Google Authenticator, Facebook, Dropbox and more
- quick self-service migration of tokens when changing phones
- customizable tokens with unique names and pictures
With AuthPoint, you can do your part to prevent unauthorized access to sensitive systems and data arising from lost or stolen credentials.

bluejetty:00080003:ios.description:
Remember these precious moments!
Pricey photoshoots and spending so much effort in photography sessions are a thing of the past. With the Tiny Peanut Baby Photo Editor app, you have your own studio at your fingertips -- literally.
The Tiny Peanut app comes with a wide range of varied backdrops which suit any needs -- milestones, pregnancy shots, photo calendars -- all that’s needed in the scene is you and your precious one!
No-fuss, no time spent on getting your props together -- it’s all hassle-free professional-looking photos in minutes!
Just snap away and share with the loved ones on WhatsApp, Facebook, Twitter, or other social media channels to celebrate the moment.
FEATURES
AI MAGIC Remove Background - Our AI technology cuts your baby’s photo and removes the background AUTOMATICALLY so you can add your baby to any scene easily.
STUDIO QUALITY BACKDROPS AND PROPS - Select from 100s of backdrops and props for the lovely shots. No need for a baby photographer or a studio anymore. You got it right here in the palm of your hand.
FUN NEWBORN FACE REPLACE - Fun, epic and beautiful concepts, easy to use. Magically add your newborn's face to a variety of newborn concepts.
A VARIETY OF THEMES TO CHOOSE FROM:
Art
Sports
Special Days
Holidays
Outdoors
Humour
Announcements
SAVE OR SHARE ON SOCIAL MEDIA - You can easily save the photo shoots to your camera roll or share them on Facebook, WhatsApp, Twitter, Instagram, or any other social media channels.
FOLLOW Tiny Peanut App on INSTAGRAM and mention us on Instagram to be shared https://www.instagram.com/tinypeanutapp/
SUBSCRIPTION
Tiny Peanut is free to download and every user is welcome for a test drive.
If you like the app, you can access premium content by subscribing to our Premium Plan, which is cheaper than going to a photography studio.
Payment will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period.
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after purchase. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Paga tus facturas con tu tarjeta preferida en pocos pasos y realiza recargas de forma rápida y segura para mantenerte siempre conectado. Olvídate de los trámites y gestiona todo desde la palma de tu mano.

Obtén respuestas al instante con nuestro ChatBot disponible las 24 horas del día, los 7 días de la semana. Si requieres atención personalizada, nuestros asesores están disponibles de lunes a viernes, de 07:00 a 21:00, para ayudarte cuando lo necesites.

bluejetty:00071452:ios.name: Barkio: Dog Monitor & Pet Cam
bluejetty:00071452:ios.summary:
Barkio dog monitoring app turns two devices into a smart pet camera. Watch live video of your puppy, hear if your dog barks, and interact with your pet remotely. Staying close to your dog has never been easier.
Helpful Barkio features for
bluejetty:00071452:ios.description:
Barkio dog monitoring app turns two devices into a smart pet camera. Watch live video of your puppy, hear if your dog barks, and interact with your pet remotely. Staying close to your dog has never been easier.
Helpful Barkio features for all pet parents:
- live HD video to watch your dog, puppy, and pet
- record video and capture a photo during monitoring
- hear if your dog barks, howls, whine
- see if your dog is calm (motion detection) 
- upcycle your older iPhone or iPad and give it a new purpose
- unlimited distance between you and your dog with WiFi and cellular data
- talk to your puppy and communicate remotely
- prerecord commands to calm your dog down 
- 2-way video so your dog can see you too
- activity log to see everything your pup has been up to 
- multiple platforms - keep an eye on your dog through phone, tablet, or laptop
- detect signs of separation anxiety in dogs
- all family members can monitor their pet
- no need for pet cameras, treat dispensers, or collars
For some functionalities, you need to purchase Barkio Premium (free trial available).
HOW BARKIO HELPS MONITOR YOUR PET?
Watch video of your dog
See what your pup is doing in a live HD video feed. Is your dog barking, howling, playing, or destroying your new pair of shoes? When the visibility is bad, Night Light can help with brightening up the room and catch the attention of your pet.
Hear every bark
Barkio transmits the sound, so you'll know if your dog is barking, howling, or whining, and you'll be able to calm your pet down remotely.
Distance is no longer a limit
Barkio works on WiFi and cellular data so you can monitor your pet from anywhere - from work, when running errands or when enjoying a night out.
Stay notified in every situation
When noise is registered, Barkio will send you a notification with an audio snippet. You'll be able to tell if your dog is noisy and needs your attention.
Power-saving background mode
When using Barkio in the background, the pet monitor will inform you about your dog through notifications. This mode helps to save a lot of battery on your device when monitoring.
Interact with your dog
With Barkio pet camera, you can communicate with your puppy remotely, calm it down, or stop your dog from disobeying. Whenever you can't talk to your pet live, you can prerecord your custom voice messages (commands) and use them to ease your dog's anxiety. 
Communicate with two-way video
With our dog surveillance app, you will see your pet, and your dog or puppy will be able to see you as well.
Activity log
Barkio records noises, videos, or photos from each monitoring.These activity logs help you to understand your dog's behavior, and show any signs of separation anxiety, such as excessive barking, howling, or whining.
Upcycle your older phone or tablet 
Do you have an older device lying around? Reuse your older phone or tablet as the Dog Station and give it a new meaning. No need to purchase expensive hardware cameras or collars when you can recycle and reuse devices you already have. By upcycling your older devices, you help to save the environment while being able to watch over your pet remotely with the Barkio Dog Monitor app.
Deal with separation anxiety in dogs
Dog surveillance proves to be a helpful way to discover signs of separation anxiety in dogs. Barkio provides you with an overview of the pet's behavior to get a proper diagnosis by the vet and helps with solitude training.
Monitor across all platforms
Enjoy Barkio across all platforms with an easy setup and no extra cost. You'll be able to check on your dog from any device and connect to your pet cam at home.
Invite family members to join
All family members can join Barkio and monitor the dog together. You'll also have access to logs from past monitorings on all your devices, to see how your pet's behavior improves in time. 
Terms of Use: https://barkio.com/terms
Got any questions or ideas? We'll be happy to hear from you at support@barkio.com.

bluejetty:00137903:ios.description:
Engaging Casual Adventure Game! Are you a fan of fun merge games? If you enjoy playing computer & video games to unwind after a busy day or travel games on your phone, immerse yourself in an unparalleled fun merge puzzle casual game experience packed with a captivating story and thrilling exploration. Engage in thrilling adventure games, merge and combine items, and create new ones as you progress through the game. A captivating adventure and casual game for any occasion! 
Experience the adventure of Casual Merging Games like never before as you strategically merge your way through various challenges and obstacles. In this fun merge game journey, embark on a quest with Elsa, venturing to a mesmerizing archipelago filled with mysteries waiting to be uncovered. As you merge items to progress in the merging game and create new elements, you'll find yourself drawn deeper into the heart of the travel games adventure. 
Merge Your Way to Victory 
Merge Adventure stands out among other merging games and travel games alike; it's a story-driven and fun merge game extravaganza! Join Elsa as she leaves behind the comforts of her hotel renovation project to answer her uncle's call to the mystical archipelago. Here, every corner holds a new secret, treasure, or challenge, making it the ultimate destination for merging game enthusiasts and travel game aficionados. From abandoned temples to lush jungles, every location offers a unique merge puzzle waiting to be solved. But beware, for not everything is as it seems; the islands are fraught with peril, from the threat of a mysterious company to the eerie disappearance of Elsa's uncle's friend, the famous traveler. It's up to you to unravel the mysteries, restore the tourist city to its former glory, and transform the archipelago into the ultimate vacation paradise!
Welcome to Merge Adventure, the go-to merge game that takes you on a journey like no other! Dive into an immersive blend of merge puzzle mechanics and captivating storytelling as you join Elsa on an unforgettable adventure to a mysterious archipelago. Get ready to merge, explore, and unravel the secrets of this mesmerizing world! 
Embark on a New Adventure 
Join Elsa as she leaves her hotel renovation project behind to answer her uncle's call and venture into the unknown. Immerse yourself in a rich narrative filled with twists, turns, and unexpected surprises at every corner. Explore a diverse range of locations, from ancient ruins to lush jungles, each with its own fun merge puzzles, travel games, and mysteries waiting to be solved.
Uncover Mysteries and Solve Merge Puzzles 
Put your problem-solving skills to the test as you encounter and overcome challenging merging games throughout your journey. Uncover the mysteries of the archipelago in a thrilling travel game as you delve deeper into its secrets and uncover hidden treasures.
Restore The Island Town

bluejetty:00023301:ios.description:
Go straight to voicemail. Skip the ringing. Skip the conversation.
When you dial with WhatCall, the call goes straight to voicemail instead of ringing the phone. It still comes from your own number, and on supported networks will even show a missed call.
Say what you need to say, on your terms.
HOW IT WORKS
Dial the number in WhatCall as you normally would. WhatCall puts you through to voicemail. Leave your message and you’re done.
WHEN TO USE IT
• Calling in sick. Let your boss know you won’t be in without a round of questions.
• Short on time. Return a call without getting pulled into a half hour chat.
• They’re busy. In a meeting, driving, putting the baby down. Leave a message instead of trying to catch them at a bad time.
• Too long for a text. Say it in 20 seconds instead of typing a paragraph.
WHERE IT WORKS
• Mobile and landline numbers with voicemail
• Automatic dialling code detection for supported countries
• Dial in your usual local format where supported
• Some networks also send a missed call text alert
WhatCall is free to download. Calls use credits available to buy in the app.
The number you call must have voicemail. Behaviour varies by network and settings.

bluejetty:00179911:ios.name: Pet Monitor VIGI
bluejetty:00179911:ios.summary: Monitor your puppy or aging dog while away from home. Get alerted with noise and motion notifications to know when your dog is barking, howling, or suffering from separation anxiety. Record videos of your furry friend owning the house. Talk
bluejetty:00179911:ios.description:
Monitor your puppy or aging dog while away from home. Get alerted with noise and motion notifications to know when your dog is barking, howling, or suffering from separation anxiety. Record videos of your furry friend owning the house. Talk to your pet remotely to say hello or continue with the training.
Leave an old iPhone or iPad running the app at home as a Pet Cam. Use your iPhone to receive noise and motion alert notifications from the Pet Cam. Connect back home and watch live, record videos or take pictures of your pet's funny moments. Soothe him remotely when he/she misses you.
HOW CAN PET MONITOR VIGI HELP YOU
Want to know what is going on at home, while away?
Use sound and motion alert notifications with automated photo snapshots from the Pet Cam to get notified about any unexpected activity.
• Need to get out leaving your puppy alone?
• Do you have a dog with separation anxiety?
• Is your dog barking or howling when alone?
Do not miss any special pet moments. Record videos, and snap photos while remotely watching your pet, share them with friends directly from within the app.
Going out with friends and family has never been easier for pet parents. Switch on Pet Monitor VIGI and enjoy your dinner with a mind free of pet worries.
FEATURES
- Motion and sound alerts with automated photo snapshots from the pet camera
- Two way audio & video chat
- Picture in Picture support on iPhone and iPad
- Record videos and snap photos of your pet during live monitoring
- Zoom in on live video
- Activity log recording past behavior of your pet
- Remotely controllable night light
- High quality live video and super sensitive audio
- Unlimited range
- Secure, reliable, easy to use
- Support for Apple Watch notifications
MOTION AND SOUND ALERTS
Get instantly notified of any disturbance in pet activity by the app's sound and motion alerts. Enjoy the sense of security, because if your dog is barking or has a separation anxiety, you will know it right away. Sound and motion alerts are automatically triggered whenever any dog or cat activity is detected by the pet camera. Photos from the camera are saved in the Activity Log, sent to your iPhone, and Apple Watch.
TWO WAY AUDIO AND VIDEO CHAT
Chatting with your furry friend is easy. Watch live video and talk to your dog or puppy remotely from your iPhone or iPad. Keep your pet happy even if you are not at home. Drop in every now and then to say hello, to soothe your dog from separation anxiety, or to continue with the puppy training.
PICTURE IN PICTURE
Keep an eye on your furry friend via live Picture in Picture monitoring while multitasking on your device.
RECORD VIDEOS, SNAP PHOTOS
Do not miss any important moments from your pet friend‘s life. Record videos or take photos of your dog, cat, puppy, or kitty’s special moments remotely with the pet monitor and share them with friends or family directly from within the app to your favorite social media (Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, Twitter, Snapchat,…).
ACTIVITY LOG, PHOTO LIBRARY
Play back recorded videos, browse photos, examine activity alerts to learn more about how your pet behaves when you are away. Send recorded video clips and photos to your friends, family, or social network. 
REMOTE NIGHT LIGHT
Turn on night light when you want to check your puppies at night.
UNLIMITED RANGE
Keep checking on your pet when away from home, watch live video from anywhere. Pet Monitor app works on any Wi-Fi network, over 3G, 4G, LTE, or 5G. Requires no special configuration of your home Wi-Fi router. Audio and video stream is end to end encrypted to make sure you and only you have access to your camera.
CUSTOMER SUPPORT
Happy customers are our highest priority and your feedback is always welcome. Contact us at support@petmonitorvigi.com with your questions or suggestions.

•Personal Finance Software

bluejetty:00174446:ios.description:
Meditopia Yoga was born with a clear intention: making yoga classes accessible and mindful. And since we are also the creators of Meditopia, the #1 mental health app, we combined the forces of mindfulness and yoga with flying colors.
We are advocates of the famous “me time.” And we are here to give your body more energy and balance through this millenary practice. 
Download for free and explore our library of yoga for beginners and more advanced! We have workouts to get stronger, feel better in your body, increase your flexibility, and reduce stress and anxiety, we have practices for you!
All you have is 10 minutes? We can work with that. Our practices are 10-30 minutes long to fit your schedule, not the other way around. 
High-Quality videos for all kinds of practitioners 
Would you like to focus on your upper body? Or perhaps a full-body routine? Choose the intensity of your practice according to your level or mood of the day. 
More powerful flows for when you’re ready
Whenever you feel it's time to advance in your practice of yoga for beginners, you can choose between longer and more powerful video practices. Progress in your practice at your own rhythm.
Your practice, your goals
Increase your flexibility, build strength, improve your posture, boost your morning mood, take quick stretching breaks, sleep better… It’s up to you!
Yoga in your language
We want you to focus on enjoying your practice, not on trying to understand it. Available in two languages (more to be announced soon)
Run by yoga and meditation experts
Let’s call it a 360° awareness experience. Where you count on the expertise of yoga and meditation experts to integrate both practices for elevated bodily and mental results.
iPhone/Airplay integration
Watch our High-Quality videos on Airplay-supported devices, and follow your workouts’ progress from your iPhone.
Apple Health Integration
Meditopia Yoga works with Apple HealthKit to sync workout data.
Download it and get unlimited access to high-quality yoga videos, mindfulness content, breathing exercises, and more. 
Namaste!

bluejetty:00064639:ios.description:
NOTE: Currently the app is only available for North Carolina WIC, Illinois WIC and MT SNAP.
Bnft has everything you need to manage your EBT benefits securely and simply. As a SNAP and/or WIC cardholder who has Bnft you can:
• Instantly get access to your real-time available balance
• View up to a year of transaction history
• Update your card status
• Order a replacement card
• Select or change your PIN
• Locate a store
Bnft allows you to securely manage your benefits at the touch of a button. Easily register with your account information. If you have already registered to mybnft.com then you are all set and ready to go. Simply use your existing username and password to sign in.
REAL-TIME, AVAILABLE BALANCE
You will have access to check your benefit balance. Bnft will also send you notifications when a deposit is posted to your account and when you are expected to receive your next deposit.
CARD AND PIN UPDATES
Is your card lost, stolen, or damaged? Bnft has you covered as you can update your card status and order a new replacement card all within the app.
SCAN IT!
For WIC cardholders, Bnft allows you to scan a food item to determine not only is the item a WIC approved product, it will tell you if you have benefits to purchase the product. 
FEATURE PRODUCTS
As a WIC cardholder you will have access to view feature products at stores within your location based on your current benefits.
PUSH NOTIFICATIONS
Bnft will send notifications for card status changes, deposit notifications, expected deposit dates, low balance or expiring benefits, and when your PIN is locked due to consecutive incorrect attempts.
FIND A STORE THAT ACCEPTS EBT
Bnft has a store locator feature which shows you all stores in your area that accept SNAP and/or WIC. 
Download Bnft to manage your SNAP and/or WIC benefits now!

bluejetty:00147138:ios.summary: Introducing QR TIGER QR Code Generator, your comprehensive solution for effortlessly creating personalized QR codes with images. Unlike typical QR code makers, our app boasts a range of captivating features, and it includes a free QR code s
bluejetty:00147138:ios.description:
Introducing QR TIGER QR Code Generator, your comprehensive solution for effortlessly creating personalized QR codes with images. Unlike typical QR code makers, our app boasts a range of captivating features, and it includes a free QR code scanner devoid of annoying ads.
Unlock a world of possibilities with our unique QR Code Generator, designed to cater to your diverse needs anytime, anywhere. In a rapidly advancing technological landscape, we are committed to offering the most intelligent solutions.
This innovative QR code creator is particularly valuable for those who seek to transmit information securely and instantly in an encrypted form. Whether it's links, website URLs, contacts, text, Wi-Fi credentials, business cards, applications, or social account details, our app provides a seamless platform for generating QR codes.
The standout feature of our app lies in its ability to work both statically and dynamically, ensuring compatibility and security on your device. Take a closer look, and you'll quickly recognize that this app stands out from the crowd.
We empower you to effortlessly craft stunning QR codes for your products with the option to choose between static and dynamic modes. The dynamic option not only facilitates data tracking but also allows for editing, eliminating the need for reprinting QR codes and saving both time and money.
Our app offers four intuitive menus enabling users to customize patterns, colors, and even add logos. Download your creations in various formats hassle-free.
Delve into the analytics with our extensive tracking features. Filter data by day, week, month, or year to gain insights into how many people scanned your QR codes. View time charts, device charts, and even a map chart that provides a global perspective on where your QR codes are being scanned.
Key Features:
User-friendly interface
Color customization with a color picker
Custom background and foreground colors
Unique patterns and logo insertion
Attractive graphics
Seamless save and share options
Easy operation
Data tracking capabilities
Static and dynamic QR code options
Editable campaigns
Historical tracking
Built-in QR code scanner
Support for WiFi and SMS QR codes
How to Use:
Select the QR code type
Input the desired content
Choose patterns, colors, or images
Press 'Generate' to create
Share or save your QR code
Track data effortlessly
Formats:
PNG
Create as many QR codes as you desire with unparalleled ease. Your feedback is invaluable to us! Support our efforts by rating us with Stars & Reviews.
=== QR TIGER QR Code Generator ===

Your casual day has never been so fun and relaxing before this addictive and simplest puzzle game.

•Relax and relieve your stress.

•Master all the challenges and go for big matches.
•One of the most addictive puzzle games.
•Offline 3D game.
Start your delicious journey and make it your brain teaser!

bluejetty:00034691:ios.description:
Anima Jigsaw: The Ultimate Jigsaw Puzzle for Seniors
Have you been searching for the ideal Jigsaw Puzzle game to pass the time but designed with mature adults in mind? Look no further than Anima Jigsaw! Embark on a delightful journey with Anima Jigsaw, the perfect Jigsaw Puzzle game tailored for seniors. Immerse yourself in this addictive and easy-to-play experience, boasting over 20,000 FREE adorable HD pictures crafted specifically for seniors. Welcome to the enchanting world of Anima Jigsaw!
Anima Jigsaw ensures a frustration-free experience with puzzles that have no missing pieces, providing a seamless and enjoyable gameplay for seniors. Exercise your short-term memory and concentration while passing the time with real jigsaw puzzles and without taking up as much room.
Anima Jigsaw faithfully replicates the charm of traditional jigsaw puzzles, offering a diverse array of collections, including captivating landmarks, delectable food, intriguing people, breathtaking art, charming animals, and more. Join us in the Jigsaw world where every piece fits perfectly!
Anima Jigsaw Features:
- Extra Large Puzzle Pieces: Experience visual comfort with oversized puzzle pieces, making every detail easy to see and manage.
- Tailored for Seniors: Enjoy a user-friendly interface with large buttons and single columned, easy-to-read card lists.
- Tons of Free, Beautiful HD Puzzles: Explore a vast collection of over 30 categories. Each puzzle is a work of art in high definition.
- Daily Free Puzzle Games: Start each day with a new challenge! Enjoy a daily dose of free puzzle games featuring captivating images.
- Difficulty Levels for Everyone: Tailor your puzzle-solving experience by choosing from 36 to 400 puzzle pieces. Whether you're a novice or a seasoned pro, there's a challenge for everyone.
- Rotation Mode: Elevate the excitement by turning on rotation mode. Challenge yourself with a twist as you navigate through the puzzle pieces in a more intricate way.
- Classic Jigsaw Shapes: Embrace the timeless joy of classic jigsaw shapes. Immerse yourself in the nostalgia of traditional puzzle-solving.
- Custom Backgrounds: Personalize your puzzle-solving environment by choosing your favorite background appearance. Set the mood and make each puzzle-solving session uniquely yours.
- Zoom In and Zoom Out: Hone your focus and easily solve puzzles by zooming in and out. Take control of your perspective and enjoy a seamless puzzle-solving experience.
Download Anima Jigsaw now and embark on a visual feast of puzzles designed exclusively for the discerning tastes of mature players. Experience the joy of puzzle-solving without compromise - Anima Jigsaw is here to redefine your leisure time!

bluejetty:00088515:ios.description:
Welcome to the most intuitive and comprehensive sports app out there. Period. 
The SportsGrid app is the complete package, providing you with all the pre-game analysis, game tracking, and post game stats you need as a sports bettor or casual fan. Combine that with the most watched FREE streaming network for live sports betting coverage, news & expert analysis, and you simply won’t need another sports app!

-Access to our 24/7 streaming network, live all day long. Watch or listen to our sports coverage wherever you are!

-Matchup previews providing odds, analysis, betting game logs, projections, injury news, lineups, line movement, and more in a concise, easy to use view
-Detailed player pages with prop recommendations, stats, splits, prop game logs, health status, and more
-Super fast live game tracking, with easy to access stats, box scores, live odds, and more

-Bet syncing so you can easily see how your bets are doing while following the games live

bluejetty:00081107:ios.description:
Welcome to Sort Tidy 3D: Match Puzzle! Are you prepared to embark on an electrifying journey that will test your intellect and provide endless entertainment? Get ready to immerse yourself in the captivating world of sorting, matching, and tidying up in this revolutionary 3D puzzle game! 
In Sort Tidy 3D, your mission is crystal clear: restore order to a chaotic shelf by sorting and matching a myriad of items. Whether it's books, toys, or household objects, it's up to you to tap and drag items to meticulously arrange them. Match three or more identical items to trigger a spectacular chain reaction, earning valuable points with each successful match. As you progress through the levels, the game's complexity intensifies, demanding lightning-fast reflexes and unparalleled sorting skills. 
But don't despair! Sort Tidy 3D isn't merely a game – it's a rigorous workout for your brain! With each level, you'll sharpen your cognitive faculties and hone your problem-solving prowess. It's the ultimate fusion of entertainment and mental acuity, promising a deeply satisfying experience with every play session. 
So, are you prepared to embark on the ultimate sorting odyssey? Waste no time – dive headfirst into Sort Tidy 3D: Match Puzzle and prepare to be captivated by its immersive gameplay and boundless challenges. With its dazzling graphics and addictive mechanics, this game guarantees hours of unbridled fun. Unleash your inner tidying virtuoso and conquer every obstacle that stands in your path! 
With Sort Tidy 3D, the excitement never wanes. Whether you're a casual gamer seeking a relaxing diversion or a seasoned enthusiast craving a cerebral challenge, this game caters to all tastes. So seize the opportunity – arm yourself with your device, download Sort Tidy 3D, and embark on an unforgettable journey of tidying mastery! 
As you delve deeper into the enchanting realm of Sort Tidy 3D, you'll discover an endless array of surprises awaiting your exploration. With its intuitive controls, breathtaking visuals, and addictive gameplay, this game is destined to become a staple in your gaming repertoire. So don't delay – join the legions of players worldwide who have already succumbed to the allure of Sort Tidy 3D! 
In summary, Sort Tidy 3D: Match Puzzle transcends the realm of mere entertainment – it's an immersive experience that challenges, delights, and captivates at every turn. From its mind-bending puzzles to its exhilarating gameplay, this game promises an unparalleled adventure for players of all ages. So why delay? Begin your Sort Tidy 3D odyssey today and prepare to be swept away on a tide of excitement and discovery!

bluejetty:00163885:ios.description:
Cameramark reads your photo's Exif data and adds it — camera logo, model, lens, shooting settings, and more — to a frame around the photo, without compressing the resolution.
If a photo has no Exif data, you can enter the info yourself and save your settings as a preset for quick switching.
You can also read Fujifilm film simulations, turn GPS coordinates into a place name, add a signature or handwriting, upload your own logo, and add frames to multiple photos at once. Presets sync via iCloud.
Cameramark supports all major digital cameras and most film cameras.

listings.name: Cameramark: Photo EXIF Frame
listings.description:
Cameramark reads your photo's Exif data and adds it — camera logo, model, lens, shooting settings, and more — to a frame around the photo, without compressing the resolution.

If a photo has no Exif data, you can enter the info yourself and save your settings as a preset for quick switching.

You can also read Fujifilm film simulations, turn GPS coordinates into a place name, add a signature or handwriting, upload your own logo, and add frames to multiple photos at once. Presets sync via iCloud.

Cameramark supports all major digital cameras and most film cameras.

* Cameramark's Japanese version was translated by Kazuto Okumura. Thank you very much!

bluejetty:00129699:ios.description:
Do you love baking? Whether you're a baking novice or a seasoned pro, Baking Time is the perfect game for you. The ultimate bakery game that will satisfy your cooking fever and love for baking!
In this fun-filled game, you'll get to make all kinds of delicious baked goods, from croissants to cookies and everything in between. With automated baking processes, you can sit back and watch as your goodies rise and bake to perfection.
But the real fun begins when you start serving your baked goods to your customers! With a steady stream of hungry customers waiting in line, it's up to you to deliver their orders quickly and efficiently. And with each satisfied customer, you'll earn money that you can use to hire additional staff and expand your bakery to include new setups and products.
But that's not all - Baking Time is a merge and dig game, which means you'll have to strategically merge and dig your way through various challenges and obstacles to reach your baking goals. And with each successful merge, you'll unlock new recipes and ingredients that you can use to create even more delicious treats.
With its vivid and colorful graphics, addictive gameplay, and endless baking possibilities, you'll be hooked from the very first bake. So what are you waiting for? Grab your apron and get ready to bake up a storm in Baking Time!

bluejetty:00178673:ios.summary: Diary, Calendar, Organizer, Planner combines a notepad, planner, reminder, calendar, habit tracker, and to-do list into one easy-to-use app for both your personal life and work. It replaces your traditional paper planner with a fully digita
bluejetty:00178673:ios.description:
Diary, Calendar, Organizer, Planner combines a notepad, planner, reminder, calendar, habit tracker, and to-do list into one easy-to-use app for both your personal life and work. It replaces your traditional paper planner with a fully digital version, letting you effortlessly create and track your plans to achieve your goals.
A dream written next to the date becomes a goal!
Millions of people worldwide rely on our planner. Organize class schedules, keep notes, manage client tasks, create shopping lists, build habits, boost productivity, and never forget important things.
The planner’s interface mimics the classic paper notebook used for generations. It’s the simplest, most user-friendly way to plan—like a school agenda or minimalist paper planner.
View your entire week’s plans on one screen—the perfect timeframe for smart scheduling. Easily swipe through weeks, months, or years.
Add, edit, or remove tasks, plans, and habits with ease. No complicated forms or data entry—just type or speak your notes, just like making an ordinary memo.
Key Features of Diary, Calendar, Organizer, Planner:
• Enjoy a satisfying page-flip experience like a paper calendar or planner—no need to carry a physical notebook anymore.
• See your full week at a glance plus a detailed daily view for extra notes. Keep all your plans in clear sight.
• Choose from a variety of backgrounds to fit your style—and change them as often as you like.
• Quickly navigate to any date, past or future.
• Highlight notes with color, underline, strikethrough, bold, or italics to prioritize and mark tasks complete.
• Maintain a separate notes list (to-do list) untethered to dates—perfect for shopping lists or jotting down ideas.
• Display week numbers and jump back to today’s date anytime.
• Customize colors and font sizes of your entries.
• Change app language settings.
• Select your preferred first day of the week.
• Add voice notes or use a stylus on tablets.
• Sync and back up with iCloud.
• Search for words within your notes and plans.
Also included:
• Recurring events (daily, yearly, etc.) for birthdays, workouts, and more.
• Automatic reminders.
• Checkboxes to mark completed tasks.
• Integration with your iPhone Calendar.
Coming soon:
• Hourly day views for detailed scheduling.
• Options to share your calendar with colleagues, friends, and family.
• Integration with other calendar services like Google Calendar.
• And much more.
The essential features of Diary, Calendar, Organizer, Planner are always free. Upgrade to Premium via one-time purchase or subscription for additional features.
Questions or feedback? Contact us at appweeklyplanner@gmail.com

Impressive your friends with your repertoire by learning some famous songs and chord progressions.

See how you are progressing over time.

bluejetty:00106150:android.summary: Welcome to Wraithy: Glow Blast, a radiant match-and-blast puzzle where every move pushes back the darkness. Slide and connect luminous orbs, ghostly wisps, and enchanted shards to spark brilliant bursts that ripple across the board. It’s ea
bluejetty:00106150:android.description:
Welcome to Wraithy: Glow Blast, a radiant match-and-blast puzzle where every move pushes back the darkness. Slide and connect luminous orbs, ghostly wisps, and enchanted shards to spark brilliant bursts that ripple across the board. It’s easy to jump in for a quick run, but the best wins come from thoughtful setups—plant your combos, shape the grid, and watch your glow cascade into satisfying chain reactions.
Each stage brings a new “shadow trick” to solve: dimmed tiles that need charging, cursed seals that lock paths, fog that hides key pieces, and haunting barriers that only break when you trigger the right glow effect. Build bigger groups to forge special lights—beam blasts that sweep rows, pulse bombs that cleanse clusters, and spectral links that jump between targets. Pair them together for explosive synergy that clears objectives in a single dazzling sequence.
Progress feels rewarding and playful: collect boosters that recharge the board, break stubborn obstacles, or amplify your next blast into a screen-wide flash. There’s no rush—just calm strategy, punchy effects, and hundreds of compact puzzles that keep evolving. If you love the mix of cozy vibes and clever problem-solving, Wraithy: Glow Blast is your next glow-up obsession.

bluejetty:00069554:ios.description:
Fall asleep easily, focus, or relax with brown noise, green noise, pink noise, and white noise, plus an integrated sleep timer.
Features:
* High-quality white noise, pink noise, green noise, and brown noise
* Integrated Sleep Timer that fades out noise after a set time
* Mix noise with the audio from other apps
* Play on speakers, AirPods, or HomePod
* Control from the lock screen
* Relaxing Dark Mode
* Ask Siri to "Play Noise Machine” or to play a specific noise
Noise Machine is the best noise maker app! The beautiful design of this white noise maker app is a joy to use each night.
Noise Machine features four “colors” of noise - each with different properties:
• Brown Noise (also known as Red Noise) has a rich, deeper character with strong low frequencies and roars like a river or an ocean. Brown noise is beneficial for sleep, and even more effective when played through a powerful speaker to bring out its deep tones. Our brown noise is mathematically accurate, representing the true nature of brown noise.
• Green Noise has an ambient and natural feel that gives the feeling of being in a forest or river valley. Green noise is energizing like a long walk in the woods.
• Pink Noise has a more balanced texture that highlights the middle frequencies evenly, like a calming rain storm. Our pink noise is mathematically balanced.
• White Noise is pure and flat with an equal balance of low, medium, and high-frequency sound. White noise may sound like a waterfall cascading down a rocky cliff. Our white noise is mathematically accurate, representing true white noise.
Noise Machine now works with Siri. Say “Hey Siri, play Noise Machine” to pick right up where you left off with your favorite noise. You can also say:
“Hey Siri, play brown noise on Noise Machine.”
Are you often distracted by irritating sounds when trying to sleep at night, like city noise, loud traffic, the fan ticking, the neighbor’s music, or a partner snoring? Put on your sleep noise using this app, and you will soon find that distractions are no longer bothering you. You will also notice that this noise has a calming effect that helps you relax and drift off to sleep naturally. Once you have connected with the benefits of these sleep sounds, it may profoundly change the way you sleep.
These noises are also very effective in focusing the mind on office work, study, or thought in distracting environments.
