bluejetty:00145204:ios.summary:
Take control of your Klipper 3D printing experience like never before! Mobileraker puts professional-grade monitoring and precision control right in your pocket, transforming how you interact with your printer.
REVOLUTIONARY PRINTING CONTR
bluejetty:00145204:ios.description:
Take control of your Klipper 3D printing experience like never before! Mobileraker puts professional-grade monitoring and precision control right in your pocket, transforming how you interact with your printer.
REVOLUTIONARY PRINTING CONTROL
Unleash the full potential of your Klipper-powered printer with an intuitive interface that gives you complete command over every aspect of your printing process. From anywhere, anytime!
POWERFUL FEATURES AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
• Real-Time Print Visualization: Watch your designs come to life with GCode preview and live print tracking
• Smart Print Management: Control jobs instantly with pause, resume, or stop functions while getting real-time progress updates
• Precision Control Suite: Command all axes with pinpoint accuracy and perfectly manage temperatures across multiple extruders
• Advanced Monitoring Dashboard: Visualize bed mesh data in stunning detail and track temperature fluctuations in real-time
• Intelligent Filament System: Master your inventory with Spoolman integration and stay ahead of issues with filament sensor alerts
• Fully Customizable Interface: Create your perfect command center by arranging controls exactly how you want them
• Complete File Command: Upload, download, zip, edit, and manage files with unprecedented ease
• Macro Mastery: Streamline complex operations with grouped GCode macros at your command
• Multi-Printer Fleet Control: Manage your entire printing ecosystem from one powerful interface
ENHANCED PRINTING EXPERIENCE
• Multi-Camera Monitoring: Keep eyes on your print from every angle with advanced camera integration
• Interactive GCode Console: Communicate directly with your printer through an intuitive command interface
• Smart Notifications: Stay informed with customizable alerts about your print status, no matter where you are
• Temperature Preset System: Switch between your most-used settings with lightning speed
• Secure Remote Access*: Maintain rock-solid connections through Octoeverywhere, Obico, or your custom setup
LEARN MORE
Discover all capabilities and latest updates on Mobileraker's GitHub page.

bluejetty:00124109:ios.name: Pearl's Peril - Hidden Objects
bluejetty:00124109:ios.summary:
Pearl's Peril does not require payment to download and play, but it also allows you to purchase virtual items with real money inside the game, including random items.
Calling all eagle-eyed fans of Hidden Object Games! Play Pearl's Peril,
bluejetty:00124109:ios.description:
Pearl's Peril does not require payment to download and play, but it also allows you to purchase virtual items with real money inside the game, including random items.
Calling all eagle-eyed fans of Hidden Object Games! Play Pearl's Peril, the stunningly beautiful Hidden Object Adventure Game set in the golden age of mystery and adventure!
Join heiress and ace pilot Pearl Wallace on a round-the-world hunt for clues as she unravels the mystery of her father's apparent suicide. From New York City to the heart of Africa, follow Pearl into deadly danger as she strives to unmask the real killer and reveal their villainous plans! 
Renovate and redecorate the Wallace family's exotic estate on the private Polynesian island of Artemis!
Uncover a diabolical plot that touches everyone in Pearl's life, and could even topple nations!
If you love Hidden Object Games, Pearl's Peril is the mystery you've been waiting for. Stand side by side with trailblazing 1930s heroine Pearl as you explore hundreds of exquisite hand-drawn scenes and exotic locations. Meet and make friends, and test your skills against a huge international community of Pearl's Peril Adventurers.
Your adventure begins here!
A NEW WAY TO PLAY
Pearl’s Peril is growing! Play Iris's Eyes to match objects to their silhouettes and unlock exclusive island decorations!
HUNDREDS OF BEAUTIFUL SCENES
No other Hidden Object Mystery can match Pearl's stunning hand-drawn scenes. From the streets of 1920s New York to Paris, Polynesia and beyond, an exotic world of glamour, mystery, adventure, and romance comes lavishly to life.
A GRIPPING STORY
Epic adventure, mind-bending mystery, and heart-stopping romance are woven into the fabric of Pearl's Peril, for a rich, rewarding story you won't forget.
Game Story by Steven-Elliot Altman, Johanna Fischer, Karen Haloran, William Hiles, Catherine Duquette, and Sebastian Nußbaum.
UNRAVEL THE MYSTERY
You'll need a keen eye and a sharp mind to unlock the secrets of Pearl's Peril and uncover the mastermind behind her father's untimely fate!
YOUR PERSONAL PARADISE
Welcome to Artemis Island, the Wallace family's private estate. Build and decorate to create the island getaway of your dreams!
If you love Hidden Object Games, Pearl's Peril is the mystery you've been waiting for. 
---------------------------------------------------------------
Having problems? Any suggestions? We would love to hear from you! You can reach us here: http://woo.ga/PPhelp
Become a fan of the game for the latest stories, rewards, and competitions:

bluejetty:00161119:ios.description:
Con Turismocity compara cientos de sitios de viajes en una sola búsqueda y ahorra hasta un 50%! Además, entérate primero cuando hay promociones increíbles. 
Principales características de la aplicación:
- Comparador de pasajes aéreos
- Buscador y comparador de hoteles
- Comparador de paquetes de viajes
- Descuentos exclusivos en hoteles
Búsqueda de pasajes baratos:
- Comparamos los principales sitios de viajes, agencias y aerolíneas.
- Búsqueda flexible. ¿La fecha te da igual? Enterate en qué momento es más barato viajar y ahorrá.
- Posibilidad de crear alertas para recibir notificaciones en caso que los precios bajen.
- Posibilidad de filtrar por aerolínea, duración del vuelo, escalas, horarios de salida y llegada, etc.
Promociones aéreas:
- Posibilidad de recibir notificaciones inmediatas de vuelos baratos y ofertas de último momento.
Paquetes de viajes:
- Selección de paquetes de viajes de los mejores sitios de viajes.
- Paquetes verificados: analizamos el precio de los paquetes y te avisamos si convienen comprarlos o si es más barato comprar el vuelo y hotel por separado.
Búsqueda de hoteles:
- Comparamos los precios de más de 100 sitios de viajes como Booking, Expedia, Hoteles.com y Airbnb, entre otros. Descubrí qué sitio tiene el mejor precio para reservar tu hotel o apartamento.
- Filtrá rapidamente por puntuación, estrellas, ammenities y ubicación de tu hotel o apartamento.
Alertas de precios:
- Posibilidad de generar alertas personalizadas que te avisan cuando baja el precio del vuelo o paquete que te interesa.
Aerolíneas y Agencias de Viajes que comparamos:
- Argentina: Almundo, Aerolíneas Argentinas, LATAM, Flybondi, Atrapalo, Avantrip, Transatlantica, Garbarino Viajes, Andes, Kiwi, eDreams, Booking, Sky Airlines, American Airlines, Buquebus, Expedia, Iberia, Falabella Viajes, Gol, Air France, United, KLM, Lufthansa, British Airways, BestDay, Norwegian, Avianca.
- Colombia: VivaColombia, Avianca, Atrapalo, Los tiquetes más baratos, Copa Airlines, Satena,Booking, Almundo, Edreams
- Chile: LATAM, JetSmart, Atrapalo, SkyAirlines, ViajesFalabella, Cocha, Travelsecurity, Almundo, Edreams
- Mexico: BestDay, VivaAerobus, Volaris, Almundo, Pricetravel, Interjet, Aeromexico, Booking 
- Peru: TACA, Atrapalo, Costamar, Nuevomundo, Domiruth, TAP Air
- Uruguay: eDreams, Sky, Kiwi, Aerolineas, Avianca, Latam.

bluejetty:00147023:ios.summary:

Bad Daddy’s Ap
bluejetty:00147023:ios.description:
Bad Daddy’s offers a chef-driven menu of gourmet signature burgers, chopped salads, appetizers, artisan sandwiches, scrumptious sides, and so much more! Enjoy a truly delicious experience with rapid delivery directly to you.
Bad Daddy’s App Features:
- Quickly modify and add food to your cart
- Enhance your online ordering experience with beautiful product and ingredient imagery
- Enable geolocation to find your nearest Bad Daddy’s restaurant
- Order food for delivery
- Save credit and debit cards for faster checkouts
- Apply coupons to order online
- Reorder past orders
How to Order Bad Daddy’s:
- Enter your delivery address and choose from the delivery locations in your area
- Choose a category and add an item or modify an item to add to your cart
- After you’ve finished adding items to your order, select checkout from your cart
- Proceed through the checkout flow, and monitor your delivery progress from your order confirmation screen
- Visit your account to reorder past orders quickly
Bad Daddy’s Cooks Up the Savory Burgers You Love
Bad Daddy’s boasts an extensive menu featuring bold, flavorful burgers and great choices for your meal. You can indulge in satisfying gourmet burgers like the Sam I Am Burger with American cheese, a fried egg, pesto, and rosemary ham; the Bad Ass Burger embellished by 10 ounces of beef with housemade American cheese, buttermilk fried bacon, horseradish mayo, lettuce, tomato, and pickles; or challenge yourself with the Bacon Cheeseburger on Steroids, brandishing Monterey Jack cheese, three pieces of jalapeno bacon and applewood smoked bacon, housemade bacon mayo, shredded lettuce, tomato, red onion, and pickles. Now, are you really hungry?
Classic Starters, Delicious Wings, Salads & More!
You can order your favorites now! Bad Daddy’s strives to offer a variety of menu items that have a unique Bad Daddy’s twist, so they are truly one-of-a-kind.
Delight your stomach and fulfill your appetite with Bad Daddy’s Backyard BBQ Pork Nachos, made with crispy pork, black beans, and roasted corn, topped with amber ale queso, pineapple salsa, applewood smoked bacon crumbles, jalapeño ranch, BBQ sauce, cilantro, and green onions. Sample the Chicken Wings, tossed in your choice of traditional buffalo, BBQ, or Thai chili sauce, served with blue cheese or ranch dressing and celery sticks. Enjoy the enormous Stella’s Greek Salad with romaine lettuce, grilled chicken breast, tomato, red onion, cucumbers, Kalamata olives, pepperoncini peppers, feta, radish, and chickpeas, tossed with Greek lemon oregano vinaigrette.
Ready for more? Order a Bad Daddy’s Chicken Enchilada Sandwich, handcrafted with grilled chicken breast, seasoned and tossed in Bad Daddy’s house-made signature enchilada sauce, topped with pepper jack, avocado, lettuce, tomato, crispy tortilla strips, and a fried whole jalapeno on a toasted brioche bun. That being said, there’s literally nothing like the Salmon Teriyaki Sandwich, made with wild-caught salmon fillet grilled with teriyaki, loaded with house-made pineapple salsa, sriracha, and sweet potato fries on a brioche bun.
Of course, there are plenty of sides, such as hand-cut french fries, house-made potato chips, tater tots, mac & cheese, onion rings, and more to tickle your palate.
Bad Daddy’s commitment to menu innovation allows the creation of a variety of American cuisine that is sure to please your appetite. Bad Daddy’s food is dangerously delicious, and you can order it now with the app!

bluejetty:00040301:ios.name: Yana: Cozy Self-Care
bluejetty:00040301:ios.summary:
This is the new Yana: the emotional companion you know, renewed to be with you on good days and not-so-good ones. She helps you check in with your feelings, care for yourself at your own pace and grow your inner world.
Every day, Yana asks
bluejetty:00040301:ios.description:
This is the new Yana: the emotional companion you know, renewed to be with you on good days and not-so-good ones. She helps you check in with your feelings, care for yourself at your own pace and grow your inner world.
Every day, Yana asks how you feel, and your world reflects it: clouds, rain, sunshine, a rainbow, under a sky that follows the real time of day. Check in, do small acts of care and build a home that feels like you. And whenever you want to talk about anything, Yana is one tap away.
A few minutes a day
Most of us only make time for ourselves when something already hurts. But emotional wellbeing is built a little at a time, on ordinary days too. Yana turns a few minutes a day into something you look forward to: a check-in, a small routine and a world that grows with you. That way, when a hard day comes, you’re not starting from zero.
Think of it like a gym: the music and the lights aren’t the reason you go, but they make you want to come back. That’s why Yana is a game. The play is there so taking care of yourself feels like something you want to do, not something you have to.
How it works
• Check in: tell Yana how you feel in a few taps, put a name to the feeling and watch your world reflect it. Add a note or a few tags, and your check-ins become a mood journal.
• Small acts of care: get a short routine of everyday activities picked for how you feel today, like stretching, drinking a glass of water or sending a kind message to a loved one.
• Earn acorns: every check-in, affirmation and activity earns acorns.
• Make it home: spend your acorns to decorate with furniture, plants and decor. Mix styles, pick colors and make every corner yours.
• Talk with Yana: tap her armchair and chat about your day, the big things and the small ones. Yana is an AI companion, here whenever you want to talk.
• A kind word: reveal a daily affirmation chosen for how you feel.
• Look back: your mood history keeps every check-in, so you can see how your days and weeks have felt.
Why Yana
• A mood journal, a habit builder and a cozy world to care for, all in one place.
• Every feeling belongs. Rain is as welcome here as sunshine.
• No guilt, no pressure. Miss a day and Yana is simply happy to see you again.
• A check-in takes just a few taps. Some days, that's all it needs to be.
• Every decoration can be earned through daily care. No purchase needed to decorate your home.
Free to use
Your world, your check-ins, your activities and your affirmations are all free. Chatting with Yana is free for your first 50 messages, and Yana Premium (monthly or annual subscription) unlocks unlimited chat. Acorn packs are completely optional, just in case you’d like to decorate faster.
Knew Yana before?
Welcome back. This is a big change, and some of the things you used aren't part of this version for now, like streaks, meditations and the community. Your chats and mood history are safe: log in with your account and you'll find them right where you left them. For the details, visit yana.ai/faq.
Privacy
Your privacy matters to us. Your conversations are kept separate from your identity, and we never sell your personal data.
Privacy Policy: https://yana.ai/privacy
Terms and Conditions: https://yana.ai/terms
Yana is a supportive companion, not a therapist, and it is not a medical device. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. If you are going through a crisis, please contact your local emergency services or find a free helpline at findahelpline.com.

bluejetty:00094875:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00094875:ios.description:
Plays commentary automatically as you drive so you don't miss any of the best places to visit, plus stories, tips & directions.
GyPSy Guide’s narrated driving tour for Zion and Bryce Canyon National Parks in Utah, is an excellent way to enjoy all the benefits of a guided tour while you explore at your own pace.
There are 190+ audio points that play automatically along the scenic drive, featuring the best things to see and do, stories, tips and driving directions. 
Professional tour guides share advice on how to prioritize your time at recommended “not to be missed” viewpoints, suggested side-trips and places of interest. Tours are filled with stories to provide an entertaining and deeper understanding of the region.
Tours work offline, using free GPS signal and location services, so no data roaming, network, or wifi is required while touring.
Visit www.gypsyguide.com for route maps, sample commentary and tips & advice.
WHAT TO EXPECT: 
This tour features 2 of Utah’s most magnificent parks, both Zion and Bryce Canyon National Parks. The highlight of each park is their incredible geological formations. In Zion it’s the massive near vertical rock walls that line the canyon carved by the Virgin River. For Bryce, it’s gazing down from the rim of the Amphitheater and trying to absorb the presence of thousands of hoodoo formations.
Your tour includes both parks and the 1.5 hour drive using Highway 89 that connects them. The tours begin as you approach either Zion or Bryce Canyon, you can begin at either, or even join the route along the way if you are arriving from Grand Canyon North Rim.
The commentary highlights all of the best location of viewpoints and has information on many of the popular hiking trails you may choose to explore. And the region has a rich collection of stories of characters who framed the history, the native Americans who came before them as well as providing background of the amazing natural wonders.
Shuttle buses operate in the busiest sections of these parks. You can take this tour with you and continue listening if shuttle bussing is mandatory during your visit.
WHAT YOU’LL SEE:
Some of the highlights along the route include;
• Zion Canyon including all stops on the Canyon's Scenic Drive
• Bryce Canyon Amphitheater
• Bryce Canyon 18-mile Scenic Drive
• Highway 9 switchbacks and Tunnels
• East Zion & Checkerboard Mesa
• Red Canyon
• La Verkin Overlook
• Grafton Ghost Town
BATTERY USAGE:
++ Continued use of GPS/Location Services in the background increases battery usage. We strongly recommend taking a cigarette style (DC outlet) car charger. Avoid using a direct connection to the USB port of a rental vehicle.
IPADS:
** iPad models must include a GPS chip. Please note only the iPad Wifi + Cellular models of iPad contain a GPS chip. Wifi-only iPad models have limited location service capabilities and are unable to play commentary automatically.
DOWNLOADING:
The apps are larger in size in order to work offline. You must be on wifi to download as the store may block the download over cellular networks. 
ABOUT US:
GyPSy Guide™ produce award winning narrated audio tours along scenic drives and road trips around the world. 
Enjoyed by travelers who prefer to set their own pace and itinerary on vacation, but enjoy a fun, informative and educational guided experience while driving themselves. 
Our goal is to provide a great introduction to the region and inspire you to learn more and return. 
None of our apps include paid advertising or placements for benefit

bluejetty:00018819:ios.description:
TheFork is Europe’s leading restaurant booking platform, proudly bringing people together through unique and affordable culinary experiences since 2007. What are you waiting for? Activate your location and we’ll activate your taste buds! You set the tone, we set the table.
TheFork continues to be savoured across the biggest foodie hotspots in France, Spain, Italy, the UK, the Netherlands, Belgium, Switzerland, Portugal, Denmark, Sweden and Australia. But wait, what exactly do we bring to the table? Here are 6 reasons to download TheFork app right now.
1. Things that tickle our taste buds: fast, free and easy online booking
We know that normal life means having a lot on your plate, so to make things a bit easier for you, we've simplified restaurant booking. With a few simple taps on our mobile app, you’ll be one step closer to having that ‘mmm’ moment of pure belly satisfaction, in the most seamless way possible.
2. Frugal on prices, never on flavours
Our amazing restaurant partners love their diners as much as we love ours and offer exclusive discounts on reservations throughout the year (automatically applied and subject to conditions at the time of booking). That way restaurants get to open their doors to all types of diners, making dining out accessible to everyone.
3. Community insights = better bites
Tuck into the wisdom of our gourmet community! With over 20 million trusted reviews from only customers who have actually tried the restaurant—your palette is in good hands!
4. We don’t skimp on choice
Reserved? Not us. That’s just a label for a table. So whether you’re looking for the perfect spot for bottomless brunching, taco crunching or al-fresco munching, our foodies are spoiled for choice with our diverse collection of over 60,000 restaurants and 40,000 photos, menus and community reviews that will satisfy just about any culinary mood and occasion. After all, variety is the spice of life! Browse, scroll and add to favourites, so you can find more of what you love. Now that’s food for thought.
5. INSIDER: sit back and relax while we level up your dining-out game.
Our foodie experts are always hard at work to stay on top of our INSIDER collection featuring the best restaurants. With our feed of critically acclaimed insights and selections, no chances are taken on promoting the dining out spots that are turning heads for the best ambiance, ratings, service and food.
6. We take loyalty VERY seriously. 
To reward our awesome foodie community, every booking with TheFork accumulates unique Yums points, which can be redeemed in the form of a tasty discount at one of our many partner restaurants down the line. Here’s how it works:
1 reservation = 100 Yums (Y)
Once you've accumulated enough you can enjoy amazing offers which converts to: 
1,000 Y = €10 / CHF15 / AUD$20 / £20 loyalty discount!
2,000 Y = €25 / CHF35 / AUD$50 / £50 loyalty discount!
Keep an eye out for double Yums and other ways to earn more Yums as you book.
We love hearing from our TheFork foodie community! Reach out at contact@thefork.com.
>In the UK, follow us on:
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/TheFork.uk/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thefork_uk/?hl=en

bluejetty:00022464:ios.summary:
Con ETN y Turistar podrá consultar horarios de autobús, viajes y rutas de autobús y comprar su boleto de transporte. Somos una Línea de Autobuses de Lujo dedicada al Transporte de Pasajeros.
Además hacemos envíos de Paquetería y Mensajería
bluejetty:00022464:ios.description:
Con ETN y Turistar podrá consultar horarios de autobús, viajes y rutas de autobús y comprar su boleto de transporte. Somos una Línea de Autobuses de Lujo dedicada al Transporte de Pasajeros.
Además hacemos envíos de Paquetería y Mensajería ligera con servicio a través de nuestras oficinas ubicadas a lo largo de nuestras rutas.
ETN Turistar le permite ver rutas y comprar su boleto de autobús de forma rápida y sencilla. Contamos con descuentos para que pueda viajar en autobús, sin perder ninguna de nuestras ventajas. Si ya sabe su ruta, solo le queda elegir los asientos de su boleto de transporte para viajar en nuestros autobuses de lujo. 
◉ VIAJES DE LUJO DIFERENCIADOS EN AUTOBÚS
Servicio de entretenimiento individual a bordo de nuestros autobuses
Salas de espera VIP en más de 15 terminales alrededor de la República, donde contará con comodidades antes de realizar tu viaje en autobús
Boletos con salidas exclusivas en CDMX y Guadalajara
◉ RENTA DE AUTOBÚS
Si necesita rentar un autobús o varios autobuses para sus viajes, contamos con servicios perfectos para escuelas, excursiones, congresos, y otros servicios. El servicio de Turismo Gran Clase de ETN y Turistar, ofrece diferentes opciones de acuerdo a sus necesidades para la renta de autobuses. 
◉ AUTOBÚS + HOTEL
Estamos especializados en la venta de paquetes de viajes que incluyen el boleto de Autobús y Hotel cubriendo sus necesidades, ya sea Cliente Particular o Corporativo.
◉ “VIAJAMAS” CON ETN TURISTAR LUJO
El Programa de Lealtad, enfocado a nuestros clientes de ETN y Turistar, le ofrece beneficios al viajar como canje de boletos de autobús. ¡Con cada boleto, acumulará puntos para viajar!
◉ ETN TURISTAR Y DOTERS
Gana Puntos Doters en cada uno de tus viajes con tus compras de boletos de autobús en ETN Turistar y disfruta de beneficios y recompensas:
Boletos recompensa
Abordaje prioritario en nuestros autobuses
Descuentos en paquetería
◉ DESTINOS MÉXICO 
ETN Turistar Lujo le lleva a más de 70 destinos, somos especialistas en transporte ¡Consulte todos nuestras rutas y horarios de autobús!
Podrá comprar su boleto de autobús en cualquiera de nuestros puntos de venta y taquillas a destinos como: Ciudad de Mexico (CDMX), Cuernavaca, Guadalajara, Morelia, San Luis Potosí, León, Aguascalientes, Culiacán, Toluca, entre otros, cubriendo el 80% del territorio nacional.
◉ AUTOBÚS AEROPUERTO CIUDAD DE MÉXICO
Queremos ofrecerle la mayor comodidad en sus viajes, es por eso le ofrecemos servicios directos de transporte del Aeropuerto de la Ciudad de México a Querétaro y viceversa.
Las llegadas y salidas de dichos servicios se llevan a cabo en el lobby del Hotel Camino Real, el cual cuenta con un puente peatonal cubierto, conectándolo directamente al interior del aeropuerto.
Contamos con autobuses de última generación y la más alta tecnología, configurados en 24, 30, 33 y 35 asientos, con descansa-pies, luz de lectura individual, aire acondicionado individual, cinturón de seguridad, sanitarios para dama y caballero, porta-vaso, revistero, pantallas LCD y/o pantalla individual, audio individual, sistema de video y velocidad regulada a 95 kms/hr.
Buscamos facilitar la planificación de sus rutas en autobús o viajes en autobús. Con la app de ETN podrá consultar todos los horarios de salidas de autobuses, encontrará sus puntos de venta o taquillas donde podrá comprar su boleto de transporte, o si lo prefiere puede compra su boleto desde la app. 
¿A qué espera para descargar nuestra app?
Consulte los horarios y rutas de autobuses con la app de ETN Turistar Lujo. También podrá comprar sus boletos para cualquiera de nuestras rutas de viaje
¡Nunca ha sido tan cómodo viajar en autobús!

bluejetty:00149051:ios.name: AmpUp - EV Charging
bluejetty:00149051:ios.summary:
EV CHARGING MADE EASY
If you own an EV, you know how frustrating it can sometimes be to charge. AmpUp makes charging easy by enabling building and property owners to provide charging for their residents, workers, or people just passing by –
bluejetty:00149051:ios.description:
EV CHARGING MADE EASY
If you own an EV, you know how frustrating it can sometimes be to charge. AmpUp makes charging easy by enabling building and property owners to provide charging for their residents, workers, or people just passing by – seamlessly and hassle free. People like you!
FIND CHARGERS NEAR YOU
Find chargers nearby or on your route, see if they are available, and even reserve them ahead of time. Bookmark favorite chargers or enable notifications for when an occupied charger becomes available. Discover not only AmpUp powered chargers, but also chargers from other networks.
CHARGE WITH A QUICK SCAN
Just scan the AmpUp QR code on the charger with the app’s QR reader to start your session in seconds. Or check into a charger reserved at a location in advance. Some locations require special access, which you can request from the charger’s host. 
PAY IN APP OR SCAN RFID
Pay using a credit card or with a card in your phone’s wallet. Save your payment method so you can charge quickly and easily on any of AmpUp’s thousands of chargers. You can also link your existing RFID card or badge - or request a new AmpUp RFID card - to swipe and charge quickly without your phone.
COMMUNITY POWERED 
Each charger host sets the prices and policies for their chargers. AmpUp makes the policies and pricing transparent for drivers, so you can see what charging speed you’re getting and what you are paying per minute or kWh of charging. 
REMOTELY MONITOR AND GET NOTIFICATIONS
See how your charge is progressing right on your phone. Get notified when your session is done. Know exactly what you’re paying and how many kWh you have added to your vehicle. See charging session history and receipts. 
PRICES AND FEES

bluejetty:00087267:ios.description:
Her journey begins with a cryptic letter from an anonymous sender, inviting her to explore "The Enigma Mansion" - a meticulously constructed estate brimming with riddles and intricate puzzles.
Upon entering The Enigma Mansion, Lily is drawn into an otherworldly realm where everything exudes vitality, and a subtle aura of darkness moves silently. She navigates through various rooms and hallways, each harboring enigmatic conundrums, intellectual challenges, and intricate logical dilemmas. Solving these puzzles becomes Lily's sole path to advancing further.
From deciphering concealed codes within ancient artworks to arranging gemstones in precise sequences, Lily tirelessly investigates, learns, and deduces, delving deeper into the mansion's enigmas. Throughout her odyssey, she uncovers subtle hints that guide her to undisclosed family secrets and the concealed mysteries lurking within the mansion's walls.
The presence of the mansion's enigmatic shadows seems to have its own deliberate purpose, offering Lily enigmatic clues and puzzle trials to impede her progress. Nonetheless, armed with persistence and intellect, Lily forges ahead, surmounting obstacles to ultimately unveil the answer: Where are her missing parents?
Beneath the final painting, after deciphering a series of intricate puzzles, Lily ultimately uncovers a hidden passage leading to a concealed chamber housing a map that reveals her parents' whereabouts. The game concludes with an exhilarating blend of suspense and anticipation as Lily unravels the enigma and embarks on a new quest to reunite with her family and uncover the truths concealed within The Enigma Mansion.
Features:
• Many challenging puzzles.
• A great storyline that reveals many mysteries.
• A hint system is available if you need it.
• Excellent sound effects.
• Completely free.
• Many hidden objects.
Download and discover "The Enigma Mansion" now! Please contact Contact@bamgru.com if you have any questions. Thank you!

bluejetty:00022747:ios.description:
SSH client designed for usability and performance.
RELIABLE AND FAST
• Hardware accelerated text rendering.
• Robust terminal emulation based on the PuTTY engine.
• Works great with programs such as 'screen' and 'irssi'.
CONTROL WITH GESTURES
• Default gestures optimized for irssi. Just swipe to switch channels or to scroll up and down.
• Fully customizable. Any keypress or action can be attached to any gesture.
EASY CONNECTING
• Save user credentials and configure a remote command such as ‘screen -rd’ to connect with one tap.
• 3D touch support. Connect directly from the iOS home screen.
CUSTOMIZABLE KEYBOARD
• Easily bind custom actions to buttons on the keyboard toolbar.
• Works with custom iOS keyboards such as SwiftKey.
OPEN LINKS AND SELECT TEXT
• Familiar iOS text selection experience. Long-press on text to show the selection controls.
• Copy and paste text.
• Select a URL to easily open it in the web browser.
OTHER FEATURES
• iCloud sync support.
• Terminal color themes. Choose your favorite from the several themes included or make your own.
• Key file authentication support. Import an existing private key, or create a new key and export the public key.
• Host key verification and management.
• Agent forwarding (OpenSSH servers only).
• Keep connections alive while the app is in the background.
• Connection history with optional realtime location data.
• Plenty of other configuration options.
Please note that some features require a paid upgrade. You can try all features for free for a limited time.

bluejetty:00088381:ios.description:
Tired of the same default watch face every day? 
Try "TopWatch“- This ”Watch Faces Gallery” offers unlimited personalization options for your Apple Watch, making your watch truly a one-of-a-kind work of art. We offer a variety of watch faces to support the display of your sports and health data, as well as to let you make your own watch faces.
Why have over 100,000 users chosen TopWatch?
【Watch Faces Gallery】
No matter what style you prefer, you can find the perfect dial here.
- A variety of style watch faces: We provide you with a variety of style dial, including cute, mechanical, ins, cartoon, macaron color, labubu and so on. 
- Top collaborations: We collaborate with top global designers to release exclusive co-branded watch faces — updated regularly with fashion, creative styles.
- One-Tap Apply: Switch your favorite watch face with a single tap — quick, easy, and frustration-free.
【Health Data Tracking & Display】
TopWatch isn’t just a Watch Faces Gallery — it’s also your health companion, tracking and displaying all your key wellness data.
- Health data display：Our watch faces supports the display of your sports and health data, so that you can keep track of your health status and activity progress.
- Not Just Data: TopWatch is not only about accurately tracking your health metrics — it’s about presenting them on your iWatch in a more intuitive and user-friendly way.
【DIY Watch Faces】
We know that everyone has a unique taste and creativity, so we offer the function of DIY watchfaces.
- Easily Customize Your Watch Face：Through the simple and intuitive interface, you can choose your favorite background, font, pointer style, etc., and freely arrange and combine to make the perfect dial that meets your personal preferences.
- Real-Time Preview: In the process of making the watch face, you can preview the effect in real time to ensure that every detail is in line with your expectations.
- Instant Share: You can also share your work with friends and other users on social media to show off your creativity and personality.
Key Features:
- Regular updates and additions: We will update the app regularly to bring you more new dial styles and features. You'll enjoy a constant stream of fresh dial options, keeping your personality on display.
- Low Power Optimization: All dynamic watch faces have passed 24-hour battery life tests — stunning animations without draining your battery.
-Your Smart Daily Companion: Whether you’re working, resting, or exercising, TopWatch keeps you gently reminded through your iWatch — helping you stay motivated and live better every day.
- - - - - -
The watch faces and DIY features in the app use Apple's HealthKit API to read data directly on your device, with all data stored locally or on other devices where you have iCloud syncing enabled.
TopWatch members automatically subscribe to instructions
* You can cancel your free trial or subscription at any time by turning off automatic renewal in iTunes Account Settings Management. Please do this manually 24 hours before the end of the free trial or subscription period to avoid incurring fees.
* Free Trial subscriptions will automatically renew to paid subscriptions unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial period
* Cancellation will take effect on the last day of the current subscription period and you will be downgraded to a free service
Privacy policy: http://download.xzmobi.com/resources/com.sm.watchfaces/PrivacyPolicy.html
User terms: http://download.xzmobi.com/resources/com.sm.watchfaces/UserPolicy.html
If you have further ideas or comments, please contact us: topwatchfaces@163.com
Follow us:
Tiktok: @topwatch_official

bluejetty:00138011:ios.summary:
CARRINGTON, WATCH THE FORCES THAT MOVE THE WORLD

bluejetty:00138011:ios.description:
CARRINGTON, WATCH THE FORCES THAT MOVE THE WORLD
In 1859, a solar storm set telegraph wires sparking across the planet. We call it the Carrington Event. Back then, only the telegraph was wired. Today, everything is, satellites, power grids, GPS, the device in your hand. It happened before. It will happen again. The only question is whether you'll be watching.
Carrington puts the planet's biggest natural forces on one live screen: space weather, earthquakes, volcanoes, tsunamis, and the health of the oceans. Most apps give you a single window. We show you the whole system, the real-time data, the open science, and the connections the standard models keep in separate boxes. Then we let you decide for yourself.
SPACE WEATHER, LIVE
• KP index & geomagnetic storms, 1-minute and 3-hour updates
• X-ray flux, solar flare activity (B, C, M, X class)
• Solar wind at L1 from NOAA RTSW, SOLAR-1 and ACE, plus IMAP & Wind with Advanced
• Proton & electron flux, F10.7, sunspots, magnetometer, cosmic rays
• TEC, DRAP & geoelectric fields for radio and grid conditions
EARTH & HAZARD MONITORING
• Earthquakes, live global, multi-source
• Volcanoes, activity plus stratospheric-injection tracking
• Tsunamis, official warnings and DART buoy data
• Aurora, OVATION forecasts with visibility
• Ocean health (AMOC), Atlantic circulation, watched in real time
THE OBSERVATORY, EARTHQUAKE RESEARCH UNDER LIVE TESTING
Published and Carrington-built earthquake research methods, run live and shown openly as map heatmaps and a daily global earthquake probability set against its baseline. ETAS aftershock clustering, EEPAS medium-term build-up, deep-quake watch zones, and ionospheric (TEC) watches, clearly labeled for what they are, including when a signal doesn't hold up. We forecast probabilistically and show our work. These are research watches, not official alerts: for safety, use USGS and your local civil authorities.
INTERACTIVE MAPS & VISUALS
• G.E.C. Map, named for the Global Electric Circuit, 55+ toggleable 2D/3D layers: quakes, volcanoes, tsunamis, plate boundaries, aurora, wind, ocean, magnetic field & more
• 3D Planet Map, explore the solar system with real orbital data
• 80+ live solar video streams (SDO, GOES, SOHO)
• ENLIL solar-wind models from NOAA & NASA, plus UK Met Office HUXt runs with Premium
• NOAA's newest WSA-ENLIL CME model run in 3D, rendered by Carrington from NOAA open data, full screen with zoom (Advanced)
NOTIFICATIONS
• Space weather: flares, KP, proton & radio storms, NOAA watches and more
• Plus earthquake, volcano, volcanic-ash advisory, tsunami, cosmic-ray and ocean-buoy notifications
• Location-matched notifications for reported quakes, volcanic activity and aurora visibility near your saved places
• L1 lead-time research watches, from solar-wind data measured upstream of Earth
OPEN SCIENCE, NOT SETTLED SCIENCE
Carrington is built for people who'd rather see the data than be told a story. Read the research papers behind every focus area, see where the science is still debated, and join a community that reviews it. We show you the hypotheses, the evidence, and the honest results, and let you watch the Sun–Earth connection unfold yourself.
PLANS
• Free, the full live monitor, ad-supported
• Basic, everything Free, ad-free
• Advanced, expanded notifications, full data screens, the full earthquake archive back to 1900, analysis tools & advanced map layers
• Premium, location-matched notifications, L1 lead-time research watches, premium map layers & the complete research toolset
On Mac there is no ad-supported plan: new accounts start with a 7-day free trial.
Available in 7 languages. Download Carrington and start watching the system.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00078501:ios.description:
A mysterious tavern with a deadly secret! Check-in to this magical tale of murder and mystery where not everything is as it seems. Explore the tavern in secret or in style, meet and mingle with guests and staff, wield weapons and magic and uncover clues before the killer strikes again!
Evertree Inn is an immersive 265,000 word interactive experience by Thom Baylay, where your choices control the story. It’s entirely text-based--without graphics or sound effects--and fueled by the vast unstoppable power of your imagination.

• Boldly confront guests and staff or lurk in the shadows as you uncover clues.

Year of 2099, a time where people can buy and sell memories.

The superstar with a screw loose “Ain,”
The reckless colleague “Syd,”
The stingy freelancer “Hansol,”
The idiot chief “Jeff,”
And the world's laziest rabbit robot “Mode”!
The kind of weird, and somewhat lacking,
but strangely lovable 6 main characters with explosive chemistry!

[Game Introduction]
The sixth game from Storytaco, the creators of 'Dangerous Fellows'! Mayday Memory!
A new interactive female-oriented story game filled with unique problems and twists.

Memory loss, mystery, comedy, detectives, cyber punk, shocking plot twists, memory loss, drama, and of course romance!

:: Away with only romance! Comedy, Suspense, Action, experience it all!
Interactive otome visual novel, the game that tops it all!

🎨 Transform Your Photos with Cartoon Picture App
Cartoon Picture App is an easy-to-use photo app that helps you turn ordinary photos into cartoon pictures, sketch drawings, and artistic images in just a few taps. With a collection of cartoon filters, sketch and drawing effects, along with simple photo editing tools, anyone can create creative photos without professional skills.
This app is designed for users who want clear results, simple steps, and artistic photo styles, not complicated editing workflows.
✨ Cartoon & Sketch Filters for Artistic Photos
Bring a creative touch to your photos using a variety of cartoon and sketch filters.
From pencil sketch effects to cartoon-style drawings, Cartoon Picture App lets you explore different artistic looks easily.
Each filter is optimized to keep your photo natural while adding an artistic feel. Simply choose a filter, apply it to your photo, and enjoy your cartoon or sketch result instantly.
✂️ Crop Photos Easily
Use the built-in photo crop tool to adjust your images before or after applying effects.
You can crop photos freely to:
- Focus on the main subject
- Remove unwanted areas
- Adjust images for sharing or saving
The crop tool works smoothly and fits perfectly with cartoon and sketch effects.

bluejetty:00099589:ios.description:
Stop scrolling. Start living.
One Thing flips phone addiction on its head. Instead of fighting dopamine-driven habits, this app channels them — blocking distractions until you complete one meaningful activity each day. Exercise, read, meditate, do deep work, or practice an instrument. Finish first, then earn back access.
The result? A daily digital detox that builds real habits, reduces mindless scrolling, and gives you hours of focus back.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
All features require an active subscription after the free trial period.
HOW IT WORKS (Subscription Required)
Pick one activity every morning: gym, reading, meditation, studying, journaling, running, walking, or any productive pursuit. Until it's done, distracting apps stay locked. No willpower needed. The environment does the work.
SMART BLOCKING (Subscription Required)
System-Level Control: Native iOS Screen Time integration locks apps at the deepest level
Personalized Filters: Select exactly which apps to restrict based on individual triggers
Flexible Scheduling: Set weekly routines, daily challenges, or immediate timed blocks
Usage Caps: Limit daily or weekly opens and minutes for specific apps
Emergency Unlock: Safety valve for moments when access is genuinely urgent
AI-POWERED VERIFICATION (Subscription Required)
Photo Proof: Snap a picture and GPT-4 Vision confirms whether the activity was actually completed
Works Everywhere: From gym selfies to reading sessions, the AI adapts to any habit
No Cheating: Intelligent analysis catches shortcuts and keeps accountability honest
TRUE FOCUS MODE (Subscription Required)
Distraction-Free Timer: Full-screen countdown for deep work, studying, or creative sessions
Cross-Device Sync: Pairs with Mac for seamless focus across phone and desktop
ADHD-Friendly: Structured sessions with grace periods reduce the friction of getting started
PROGRESS & MOTIVATION (Subscription Required)
Streak Tracking: Build momentum day after day with visual completion calendars
18-Level Progression: Journey from "Brain Rewiring" on Day 1 to "One Year Champion"
Detailed Analytics: Monitor hours saved, daily completion rates, and long-term growth
Milestone Alerts: Celebrate achievements at key moments throughout the journey
PRIVACY & RELIABILITY (Subscription Required)
On-Device Data: Personal information never leaves the phone
Background Processing: Blocks stay active even when the app is closed
Live Activity Widget: Persistent lock-screen reminder showing streaks and countdowns
BUILT FOR
Anyone trapped in a scroll-refresh-repeat cycle
Students needing structured study sessions and fewer distractions
Professionals seeking a digital detox during work hours
Fitness-focused individuals building consistent gym or running routines
People with ADHD looking for external structure and accountability
Families creating healthier relationships with technology
WHY IT WORKS
Traditional habit trackers send reminders and hope for the best. One Thing creates real consequences: access to social media, news, and entertainment stays blocked until the daily habit is done. It's not about restricting freedom. It's about trading a dopamine loop for a life-changing routine. JOMO (joy of missing out) replaces FOMO, one day at a time.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Payment: Charged to Apple ID upon confirmation of purchase
Renewal: Automatically renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends
Management: Manage or cancel anytime in Apple ID Account Settings
No Commitment: Cancel at any point, no penalties
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://onethingapp.framer.website/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00022533:ios.name: ARDOR
bluejetty:00022533:ios.summary:
ARDOR is a personalized training platform for functional fitness. Every workout is designed by a coach and adapted to you: your equipment, your schedule, your ability, and how you're recovering.
One workout. Built around you.
THE VELLNER
bluejetty:00022533:ios.description:
ARDOR is a personalized training platform for functional fitness. Every workout is designed by a coach and adapted to you: your equipment, your schedule, your ability, and how you're recovering.
One workout. Built around you.
THE VELLNER PROGRAM
Hybrid strength and conditioning designed with 5x CrossFit Games medalist Pat Vellner. Six days a week, one theme per day: Olympic lifting, sprint conditioning, bodybuilding, engine work, gymnastics, and a weekly grind. Pick your duration — 30 minutes, an hour, or a full session — and ARDOR fits the day to it.
ADAPTS TO YOU
- Your gym: swap movements for the equipment you actually have
- Your time: the same session, sized to the window you've got
- Your level: same stimulus for a beginner and a Games athlete, different loads
- Your day: readiness and recovery shape what you're asked to do
PREDICTS, THEN LEARNS
Enter one number — a time, a weight — and ARDOR predicts the rest. Every result you log sharpens the next workout. The program gets more yours every week.
TRAIN TOGETHER
Relative leaderboards that measure effort, not just output. Share any workout with a friend and ARDOR adapts it to them automatically. Community chat and kudos from people who understand what you just did.
MONTHLY ATHLETE CHALLENGES
Each month a partner athlete publishes an open workout to the whole community. Open it and it's already scaled to you. Post your result, climb the board, and enter the monthly draw. Entries are always free — no purchase necessary. Availability varies by region; see ardor.fitness/draw-rules.
FOR CROSSFIT, HYROX, AND HYBRID ATHLETES
Built for people who train hard and want programming that keeps up.
FREE TO START
Seven days of full access, then $19.99/month or $119.99/year. Cancel anytime through the App Store
Consult a healthcare professional before starting any exercise program.
Support: support@ardor.fitness
Privacy: ardor.fitness/privacy-policy
Terms: ardor.fitness/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00169966:ios.name: Trench Warfare WW1: Army War
bluejetty:00169966:ios.summary: Become a WWI General, commanding your army across the historic battlefield of the Western Front and Eastern Front. Engage in immersive real-time strategy (RTS) and shape the course of history, from the opening action of 1914 to the brutal t
bluejetty:00169966:ios.description:
Become a WWI General, commanding your army across the historic battlefield of the Western Front and Eastern Front. Engage in immersive real-time strategy (RTS) and shape the course of history, from the opening action of 1914 to the brutal trench warfare of 1917 and the final offensives of 1918. In this theater of total war you will get to play as the general for every major nation that participated in WW1, both the Allies and the Central Powers.
Engage in intense frontline combat and action, deploying a variety of units, including infantry, tanks, and powerful artillery. Lead your troops through legendary battles such as the Somme, Verdun, and Gallipoli, and fight for victory in a relentless contest for strategic supremacy. Conquer enemy bunkers, survive waves of attacks, and utilize your tactic to achieve conquest.
This isn't just a WW1 experience. The sandbox mode allows for custom battles of any era. Design your own RTS battles, build fortifications such as bunkers, place artillery cannons and set up your defenses for survival. You decide how major you want the fight to be, spawn more than a 1000 soldiers fighting eacAh other. Recreate famous moments from WW2, including the pivotal D Day landings and command your armies on the beaches of Normandy. Imagine bringing a WW2 Tank to a Napoleonic era battle! Or even modern soldiers from a hypothetical WW3 scenario. Switch between 1917 and 1945, or equip your troops with uniforms from any era.
Choose from a wide array of nations, including the British, Germans, French, and Ottoman forces. Unleash iconic elite units such as snipers, flamethrowers, mortars and test your strategy in hardcore scenarios. Upgrade your forces to dominate the war.
Features:
- 10+ campaigns with 300+ historical WWI levels
- Sandbox mode, create your own battles with more than 200+ decorations
- Use historical uniforms from WW1,WW2, modern times and much more
- Pixel style graphics
- Offline play
- No forced ads
- Cloud save
Experience the thrill of real time strategy, forge your own path to military victory, anytime, anywhere with offline play!

bluejetty:00155131:ios.summary: The HomePro Mobile app puts your smarthome system in your pocket with easy access to your entire home from inside a single app. (Features vary based on your configuration, but any and all of the benefits below can be added to your system, c
bluejetty:00155131:ios.description:
The HomePro Mobile app puts your smarthome system in your pocket with easy access to your entire home from inside a single app. (Features vary based on your configuration, but any and all of the benefits below can be added to your system, contact your HomePro rep for details)
With the HomePro app you can:
-Remotely arm and disarm your security system
-Answer your video doorbell from anywhere, and view recorded clips from your phone
-Live stream indoor and outdoor cameras to your mobile device and speak to pets and children using Live Talk
-Access and view disarm photos captured by your touchscreen panel camera so you’ll know when people get home
-Peek in on your panel camera instantly or capture photos the next time the camera detects motion
-Remotely access and control your smart lighting to save energy and give the appearance that you’re home even when you’re not
-remotely unlock doors for a friend or neighbor stopping by while you’re not home, and remotely lock it again when they leave
-Create new codes for anyone who should access your home so you never have to make copies of your keys, and remotely manage your codes so you can prevent unwanted access after code abuse.
-Automatically adjust the thermostat when you leave home using geoservices, saving energy and making your arrival more comfortable by automatically resuming your schedule as you return
-Get alerts when you leave a door, window, medicine cabinet, or garage door open, and remotely close garage doors so you don’t have to turn around and go back to close it manually.
-Receive in app notifications or text messages when a smoke detector, flood detector, carbon monoxide detector, or security sensor is tripped
-Create unlimited customizable smart scenes to easily control multiple actions with a single touch, like “Leaving” which locks your doors, turns off all your lights and appliances, adjusts the temperature, closes your garage and arms your security system, keeping your home secure and energy efficient while you are gone.
-View a snapshot of your day with easy timelines that keep you aware of what’s happened in your home even though you missed it earlier
-Trigger an emergency panic right from the app if suspicious characters attempt an attack

bluejetty:00093549:ios.name: MOVAhome
bluejetty:00093549:ios.developer: 极净际远科技(苏州)有限公司
bluejetty:00093549:ios.summary: The MOVAHome APP is a professional cleaning management tool developed for the MOVA brand intelligent sweeping robot. By connecting to the MOVA sweeping robot through the MOVAHome app, remote control of the sweeping robot can be achieved, an
bluejetty:00093549:ios.description:
The MOVAHome APP is a professional cleaning management tool developed for the MOVA brand intelligent sweeping robot. By connecting to the MOVA sweeping robot through the MOVAHome app, remote control of the sweeping robot can be achieved, and personalized management of cleaning space and time settings can be achieved, allowing you to control your home floor cleaning anytime, anywhere. Through the MOVAHome app, you can easily unlock the following advanced features:
[Equipment Information]: By monitoring the robot in real-time, it can accurately grasp its cleaning progress and path, working status, any faults or abnormalities, as well as the service life of cleaning consumables.
Remote control: By connecting devices, remote control of the machine can be achieved, setting the robot's cleaning plan, adjusting multiple parameters such as water volume and suction strength.
[Zoning and Selection Cleaning]: Through the map interface, visually select and customize the cleaning area of the robot, accurately specifying any location you want to clean.
[Appointment Cleaning]: Schedule a scheduled cleaning task, and the robot will start executing the task at the specified time. After completion, it will automatically return to the charging dock.
【 Layout Map 】: Create a personalized home map, customize room names, divide areas, and plan floor materials and cleaning sequences to meet household needs.
[Prohibited Area Setting]: Define cleaning restricted areas on the layout map, and robots will avoid these areas according to the setting to ensure that they do not enter the designated prohibited areas during the cleaning process.
Firmware Upgrade: With OTA technology, upgrade your robot to the latest firmware version with just one click, allowing you to experience cutting-edge features first.
【 Voice Connection 】: Register and log in to the application, establish a connection with the robot, and you will be able to enjoy compatibility with third-party voice assistant platforms, achieving convenient voice control functions.

bluejetty:00165362:ios.description:
Download and play this FREE merge game! 
Welcome to this wonderful Tastyland. Many beautiful fairies are waiting for you! You can freely play what you want, with your fantastic ideas to build your own city! 
Fairies were living a carefree life in the Tastyland. A mysterious freezing took away their calm. The city was destroyed overnight, and they had to rebuild their home. And you, who shoulder the heavy responsibility, will lead them to create this reconstruction legend with merge magic! 
There is no war, no killing, no fighting, "Tastyland" is a completely peaceful merge game! In order to help the fairies rebuild their home, you need to use the merge magic to merge continuously. Merge everything!
Fairies can be merged, elves, butterflies can be merged. You can merge and hatch more than 200 magical creatures! Houses can be merged, miners can be merged, treasures can be merged, trees, grass, rocks, food, chests, and even diamonds can be merged! Merge will make them upgrade and evolve!The fairies will become stronger, the treasure will become rich, and miners can produce more materials! By constantly merging and evolving, you will eventually be able to create more than 400 types of objects! These are the resources and wealth of your city construction! You are like a magician who will build a great city with your intelligence and talent! 
Of course, in Tastyland, you can not only design home, but also go to some challenging and interesting levels to test your merge magic. In the process, you can not only easily have some fun, but also enliven your mind. Hope you like it and enjoy it! 
Tastyland Features:
● Use merge magic to create all things
● 200+ creatures can be merged, hatched, collected,
● 300+ super fun level puzzles can be beat
● 400+ fantastic objects can be merged
● 600+ bonus tasks are waiting for you to challenge!
● Login Facebook to play with friends 
Are you ready to enjoy Tastyland? 
It's time to Download now and start the most addictive merge magic!

bluejetty:00137418:ios.description:
Unleash your musical genius with VocalMe—the ultimate all-in-one AI Music Generator, Song Maker, and Cover Creator. While other apps just generate audio, VocalMe brings your entire musical vision to life. Whether you want to write an original hit from a text prompt, cover your favorite track with a brand-new voice, craft a 100% custom vocal identity, or generate a stunning AI Music Video ready for social media, VocalMe does it all in seconds. No music theory, no expensive studio—just your imagination.
Core Features That Set VocalMe Apart:
【Custom Voice & Voice Cloning (Exclusive)】
Tired of the same generic AI presets? VocalMe lets you design your own signature sound. Clone your own voice so you can sing flawlessly in any genre (without hitting a single bad note), or create a completely unique AI vocal persona for your tracks. Your music, your true voice.
【Instant AI Song Generator】
Turn your ideas into studio-quality tracks instantly. Just type a vibe, mood, or lyric prompt (e.g., "A moody synth-pop track about midnight city drives"), and VocalMe will generate a fully composed song—complete with original lyrics, dynamic beats, and realistic vocals.
【Seamless AI Cover Songs】
Remix the rules of music. Upload any song and use VocalMe’s advanced AI to swap the vocals. Hear how your custom voice, or our diverse library of AI singers, sounds on the world's biggest hits. Perfect for covers, parodies, and viral TikTok mashups.
【Cinematic AI Music Videos】
Don't just share an audio file. VocalMe turns your generated songs and covers into stunning, share-ready AI Music Videos. Our engine perfectly syncs the emotional tone and rhythm of your music with captivating visuals, making your tracks ready to go viral on YouTube, Instagram Reels, and TikTok instantly.
【Why Choose VocalMe?】
• Genre-Defying Styles: Pop, Hip-Hop, Rap, R&B, EDM, Lofi, Rock, and more. Mix and match genres effortlessly.
• Pro-Level Audio Quality: Crisp vocals and studio-grade instrumentals that sound like they were recorded by real musicians.
• All-in-One Creator Hub: From writing lyrics to generating the final music video, you never need to leave the app.
• Zero Learning Curve: Intuitive interface designed for total beginners, yet powerful enough for pro creators.
【Who is VocalMe for?】
• Content creators looking for copyright-free, original background music or viral MV content.
• Shower singers who want to sound like pop stars using Custom Voice.
• Lyricists and poets who want to hear their words sung out loud.
• Anyone who loves playing with music!

Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a pro subscription during the free trial period. The cost of renewal depends on the Subscription Plan you choose. Stop dreaming about your next big hit. Download VocalMe today, design your custom voice, and let the world see and hear your musical masterpiece!

bluejetty:00147132:ios.description:
August locks are supported exclusively in the United States and Canada.
At August Home, we believe that the door to the home isn't just about keeping your home safe from unwanted visitors. It's also about letting the right people in - at the right times, on your terms. With August, you are always in control of your front door, no matter where you are. 
For use with the August Wi-Fi Smart Lock, August Smart Lock, August Smart Lock Pro + Connect, August Smart Keypad and other compatible products. 
A key that works everywhere. Lock the front door. And unlock it. From anywhere.
No more hiding or looking for keys. Send secure keys to friends, family or people you trust instantly, all from the August app.
Always know who comes and goes with Activity Feed. See exactly what time guests and loved ones enter and leave your home, with August’s Activity Feed right on your app.
Never fumble for your keys again. Auto-Unlock detects when you arrive and unlocks the door. Enable Auto-Lock to lock when the door closes.
Alerts that actually help. With Smart Alerts, you choose and set your notifications to customize your preferences. 
Let guests in from anywhere. Unlock your door from anywhere with the August Wi-Fi Smart Lock or August Smart Lock with Wi-Fi Connect Bridge.
Use your voice. Seamlessly connect your August smart product with Amazon Alexa or Hey Google for convenient voice control.
Smarter hosting. Integrate your August account with your Airbnb account for easier, safer and more convenient hosting. 
Works with your smart home. August works with many of the top smart home systems including Apple HomeKit, Samsung SmartThings, Philips Hue and more.
Compatible Products:
August Smart Lock
August Smart Lock Pro
August Wi-Fi Smart Lock
August View
August Doorbell
August Smart Keypad
August Connect
Yale Assure Locks with Wi-Fi 
Yale Assure Levers with Wi-Fi 
Yale Smart Cabinet Lock
Yale Smart Delivery Box
Yale Assure Lock for Andersen with Wi-Fi
Emtek Empowered Smart Lock

bluejetty:00186904:ios.description:
Looking for the best interval ear training app? Do you want to improve your sense of hearing, develop your ability to identify intervals, or take your musical development to the next level?
Then Auricula is the app for you - updated and evolving since 2014!
Features you don't want to miss:
- Exercises with different levels of difficulty
- Analytics for your learning progress: overview of your skills, showing averages from your last and all exercises
- Enjoy clear entry of all intervals and display of the correct interval after three incorrect entries with automatic replay.
- Receive daily exercise reminders to ensure a steep learning curve
- Supports light and dark mode
Unlock Auricula Pro - full access to all features and support for independent app development:
- All exercise variations in addition to ascending: descending, random and simultaneous intervals
- Choose your preferred intervals for training: all, weakest, or custom selections
- Dive into endless highscore mode, where you identify the interval of the previously played note
- Change custom application icons
- Email Support
Got any feedback? Send an email to: feedback@simonbraun.eu

Guichet.com ! L’application numéro 1 de la billetterie digitalisée au Maroc. Elle met à la disposition des amoureux de la culture les meilleurs événements ! Entre des pièces théâtrales, des concerts, des festivals, ou même des matchs de Foot, Guichet.com transporte ses clients vers un univers révolutionnaire, où divers événements leur sont proposés !
Aujourd’hui, votre expérience LIVE existe en un seul clic !

Pourquoi utiliser GUICHET ?
- L'application numéro 1 de billetterie en ligne au Maroc.
- Plus d'un Million d'utilisateurs au Maroc.
- Plus de 2000 événements référencés annuellement.
- Les plus grands événements au Monde : Festival Mawazine, Oasis Festival, Marrakech de rire et bien plus.
Parce que Guichet est aussi :
- Une application très simple à utiliser.
- Les paiements sont à 100% sécurisés.
- Un service d'assistance 24h/24h et 7J/7
A propos de Guichet
Guichet est une application de billetterie en ligne, qui vous permet d'acheter des tickets pour les meilleurs événements de musique, d’humour ainsi que de matchs de foot au Maroc.
Guichet est le leader de la billetterie en ligne au Maroc.
Sa mission fondamentale est de faciliter l’accès aux événements les plus attendus !
Vous avez besoin d'aide ? Nos conseillers sont à votre disposition !
L'équipe Guichet cherche en permanence à offrir à ses clients des expériences mémorables et uniques ! Si vous avez besoin d'aide, notre équipe vous apportera toutes les réponses et les facilités dont vous aurez besoin.

Get real-time access to Burlington, VT and Plattsburgh, NY local news, national news, sports, traffic, politics, entertainment stories and much more. Download the WPTZ MyNBC 5 app for free today.
With our Burlington and Plattsburgh local news app, you can:
- Be alerted to breaking local news with push notifications.
- Watch live streaming breaking news when it happens and get live updates from our reporters.
- Submit breaking news, news tips or email your news photos and videos right to our newsroom and it could be featured on air.
- Check out current weather conditions, hourly and 7 day forecasts wherever you might be.
- Our interactive radar lets you zoom in and out to street level and watch storms as they approach. Move the map around to see major weather activity.
- See weather alerts and updates, watch videocasts from your favorite meteorologists and more.
No matter where you are in the Burlington and Plattsburgh local area, you can stay up to date on the latest news and weather information with the WPTZ MyNBC 5 app.
Although Hearst Television believes the majority of its news content is appropriate for a variety of ages, it is intended for individuals 18 and older.

bluejetty:00127184:ios.description:
جوالك على راسك لعبة جماعية مسلية تحتاج لاعبين او أكثر 
يمكنك جعل الجلسة والجمعة مع العائلة والأصدقاء أحلى مليئة بالتسلية والضحك 
أحد الأشخاص سيضع الجوال على جبينه وسيحاول البقية مساعدته في معرفة الكلمات الظاهرة على الشاشة بدون ذكر الكلمة
تأتيكم الآن ولكن بكلمات عربية ..
..
بلدان ومدن .. حيوانات ونباتات..مسلسلات..رياضيين..ماركات..
شعراء..علماء..وأدباء
مشاهير وممثلين خليجيين وعرب وغيرها الكثير...
..
يعتمد مبدأ اللعبة بأن يقوم اللاعب بوضع الجوال على جبينه وستظهر كلمة وسيحاول أصدقائه مساعدته على معرفتها بدون ذكر أي جزء من اسم الكلمة 
وفي حال معرفتها يقوم بتدوير الجهاز للأسفل وفي حال عجزه عن معرفة الكلمة يقوم بتدوير الجهاز للأعلى لتجاوز الكلمة ثم ستظهر كلمة جديدة
 وسيحاول اللاعب والفريق معرفة أكبر عدد من الكلمات خلال المدة المحددة.
يمكن اللعب بشكل أدوار بأن يقوم كل لاعب بلعب دوره والفائز هو من يحقق أكبر عدد من الكلمات،
 أو يمكن الانقسام إلى فريقين وكل فريق يختار لاعب ويحاول بقية أعضاء الفريق مساعدته، ثم يأتي دور الفريق الثاني ليلعب نفس الفئة التي لعب فيها الفريق الأول وهكذا من فئة لفئة وبالنهاية يحقق الفوز الفريق صاحب أكبر عدد من الكلمات. 
يمكنك الاختيار بين أكثر من 50 فئة وآلاف الكلمات والتي تغطي مجالات واسعة من الحياة والثقافة العامة:
بلدان-مدن-مملكة الحيوانات-فواكه وخضار-رياضيين ولاعبين-شعراء وأدباء-ماركات وشركات-شخصيات إسلامية-مشاهير عرب-أفعال وحركات-لهجات-ممثلين-مسلسلات خليجية تركية سورية ومصرية-مخترعين وعلماء-أشياء وأدوات-منوعات عامة.. وغيرها الكثير من الأصناف والفئات
والآن تم إضافة لعبتين جديدتين شيقتين:
- حركة ستوب: قم مع صديقك بتقليد الحركات أمام الكاميرا للفوز بالجولات - لعبة مثيرة ومضحكة لأبعد حد
- مين الجاسوس؟ اكتشف من هو الجاسوس بينكم في هذه اللعبة الشهيرة والممتعة

bluejetty:00157874:ios.name: Smart Alarm Clock - Alarmer
bluejetty:00157874:ios.summary:
Alarmer is an app that will become your assistant to wake up easily and fast. It's very difficult to oversleep using exciting tasks to stop the alarm clock. Wake up every morning with the Alarmer - the smartest alarm clock.
HOW IT WORKS:
bluejetty:00157874:ios.description:
Alarmer is an app that will become your assistant to wake up easily and fast. It's very difficult to oversleep using exciting tasks to stop the alarm clock. Wake up every morning with the Alarmer - the smartest alarm clock.
HOW IT WORKS:
At first, select the time of waking up. Then select a ringtone to start your day with nice sounds or your own music. Also, there is an ability to add one or multiple tasks and in the morning be ready to complete them to stop the alarm. They are barcode scanning, face recognition, solving a math problem, word rewriting, and shaking the phone. If you just close the application in the morning, the alarm clock will start sending notifications, reminding you to complete the tasks.
MAIN FEATURES:
- Set unlimited alarms
- Set alarm ringtone. You can use the app's default nice ringtone or select your own one from the iTunes Library
- Pick one or multiple tasks to prevent oversleeping
- Ability to select days of the week for repeating alarms
- Ability to enable/disable vibration
- Ability to change the volume level
- Ability to enable/disable fade-in of the ringtone
- Ability to snooze the alarm, select the snooze duration and disable this option
- Take photos. You can save a photo of your face after successful face recognition. Saved photos are stored in the app's Photos Library (Settings > Photos Library). There you can view, share or delete them
- Set a suitable color theme
LIST OF TASKS:
- Face recognition. You should show your face in front of a camera and smile.
- Barcode scanning. It supports all types of barcodes, so you can scan any of them using the rear camera. There is an option to scan any of the barcodes or some specific.
- Solving a math problem. Choose the correct answer out of the proposed options. Also, you can select the difficulty level: easy, medium, or hard.
- Word Rewriting. Repeat randomly generated word without any mistakes.
- Shake your phone several times.
PREMIUM FEATURES:
- 'Guess the country flag' task
- 'Bubble pop game' task
- Premium themes
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS:
Many features in the app are free, but you will need a subscription to access all the features of this app. You can choose the subscription plan that suits you best:
- Monthly subscription (with 7-day free trial)
- Annual subscription (with 7-day free trial)
Please note:
- The subscription is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase;
- If you start a free trial, it will be automatically upgraded to a paid subscription unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the trial period;
- You can cancel your subscription or free trial at any time by turning off auto-renewal in your iTunes account settings. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the free trial or subscription period to avoid being charged. Cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period, and you will be downgraded to the free version;
- Any unused portion of the free trial period (if offered) is lost when purchasing a paid subscription during the free trial period.
IMPORTANT NOTES:
For complete ability to use all features and set alarms, you will need to allow access to the following:
- Notifications – to receive notifications when the app in background mode. 
- Media Library – to set your own music as an alarm sound.
- Camera - to use Face Recognition & Barcode Scanning tasks, i.e, recognize your face, and scan any barcode.
- Photo Library - to save your photos.
We really appreciate our users and we are looking forward to your feedback.
If you have any suggestions, issues, or questions please contact us at sawasapps@gmail.com. 
If you like and enjoy our app please rate us and write feedback in the App Store. Thanks

Privacy Policy: https://sawasapps.wixsite.com/alarmer/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00133484:ios.summary:

Dive into the adrenaline-pumping world of high-speed racing with "Car Speed Racing - Idle Tycoon"! Start as a rookie racer and transform yourself into a tycoon by building and expanding your very own
bluejetty:00133484:ios.description:
Build and Expand Your Car Racing Empire
Dive into the adrenaline-pumping world of high-speed racing with "Car Speed Racing - Idle Tycoon"! Start as a rookie racer and transform yourself into a tycoon by building and expanding your very own car racing empire. Customize every twist and turn of your racing tracks to create challenging, heart-pounding experiences that will leave players at the edge of their seats.
Upgrade and Tune Your Race Cars
Collect a jaw-dropping collection of race cars, from sleek sports cars to powerful muscle machines. Upgrade and fine-tune every aspect of your vehicles, from engines to tires, to gain a competitive edge on the racetrack. Maximize performance and speed to dominate the competition.
Manage Crashes and Repairs with Precision
Racing is a thrilling adventure, but it can also be perilous. Accidents can happen, and when they do, it's up to you to get your prized cars back on the track swiftly. Manage repairs efficiently to minimize downtime and keep your racers on the fast track to victory.
Satisfy Spectators and Racers with Refreshing Beverages 
In addition to racing, it's vital to keep the energy and excitement flowing. Serve up cold, refreshing beverages to both the enthusiastic spectators and thirsty racers to keep them in high spirits. Happy fans mean bigger profits, so make sure they have a frosty beer or a tasty soda in hand while they root for their favorite drivers.
 Climb the Leaderboards and Prove Your Dominance 
Compete head-to-head against rival tycoons from across the globe in thrilling races. Take on challenging opponents, master every twist and turn of your tracks, and prove that you have what it takes to be the ultimate car racing tycoon. Reach the top of the leaderboards and bask in the glory of your racing achievements.
Experience the Ultimate Racing Tycoon Adventure 
"Car Speed Racing - Idle Tycoon" combines the excitement of high-speed racing with the strategy of tycoon management. It's a game that tests your skills as a tycoon, race manager, and entertainer. Assemble your dream racing team, optimize your tracks, and become an unstoppable force in the world of car racing.
Ready to rev your engines and start your journey to tycoon glory? Download "Car Speed Racing - Idle Tycoon" today and take the first step towards becoming the ultimate car racing tycoon! Dominate the racetrack, satisfy thirsty fans, and claim your spot at the top of the leaderboard. Start your epic racing adventure now!

bluejetty:00077439:ios.description:
Want to check your Spotify stats anytime? Stop waiting for Spotify Wrapped - with StatsApp for Spotify, you can explore your personalized music stats whenever you want.
StatsApp is your all-in-one Spotify analytics tool, showing you your top songs, top artists, and top albums across different time ranges. Whether you’re curious about your listening trends from last week, last month, or all time, StatsApp gives you instant access to your complete Spotify history.
Why users love StatsApp:
- Explore your Spotify listening stats instantly - no need to wait for the yearly Wrapped.
- See your most-played songs, favorite artists, and top albums anytime.
- Check your music trends weekly, monthly, yearly, or all-time.
- Analyze detailed song attributes including mood, energy, tempo, and danceability.
- Get your weekly and monthly recaps automatically updated.
- View your complete Spotify streaming history for songs, artists, and albums.
- Discover new tracks and rediscover forgotten favorites based on your stats.
- Compare how your listening changes over time and track your evolving music taste.
- Personalize your experience with clean design and smooth performance.
Discover fascinating insights about your listening habits and uncover what makes your taste in music unique. Analyze your favorite tracks, compare your top artists, and dive deep into detailed song attributes like popularity, danceability, and energy. StatsApp helps you understand your music journey in a fun, visual, and interactive way.
Your Spotify Wrapped - anytime you want.
Spotify Wrapped gives you a recap once a year, but with StatsApp, you can experience that excitement every week or month. Enjoy your own “Wrapped-style” recaps filled with colorful visuals, personal insights, and shareable highlights.
How it works:
1. Log in securely with your Spotify account.
2. Let StatsApp analyze your listening activity in seconds.
3. Explore your personal dashboard showing top artists, albums, and tracks.
4. Tap into detailed song stats and discover how your listening evolves.
StatsApp is designed for Spotify users who love to track their music journey, analyze their stats, and relive their favorite listening moments. It’s simple, secure, and always up-to-date.
Start tracking your Spotify stats today. With StatsApp for Spotify, you can:
- Explore your music insights anytime
- Discover your top Spotify songs and artists
- Enjoy a Wrapped-style experience every week
- See what defines your listening personality
Download StatsApp now and check your Spotify Stats.
