bluejetty:00062653:ios.description:
Explore 18 puzzles with Santa and other Christmas figures and get into the holiday spirit! 
Your kids will just love these wonderfully drawn pictures and will improve their skills while having fun! 
Our educational games are specifically tailored to fit preschool-aged kids, and encourage them to learn from each activity. We specialize in fun educational games.
Aimed for kids in the ages 1-6
*** What's New ***
* 20 Downloadable Puzzle Packs, over 1000 predefined puzzles.
* Variable puzzle size starting from 2 pieces up to 30 pieces for preschool kids and first graders!
* Play a new daily puzzle each day in 4 play variants - jigsaw puzzle, swipe puzzle, scratch card and color scratch
* Paint your own puzzles - paint by hand or import your pictures to create infinite new puzzles! 
* New Stories section - 18 first stories fit for ages 1-5.
* Create your own paintings, puzzles, stories and mazes
* New Language section with ABC letter tracing, Alphabet Sounds, Word Families, Sorting, Odd Words, Spelling and Writing 
* Dozens of games and learning activities including:
 +Learning numbers, 
 + Counting, 
 + Addition, 
 + Subtraction, 
 + Shapes, 
 + Colors, 
 + Order by size,
 + Order Numbers, 
 + Number line, 
 + Patterns, 
 + Tell Time, 
 + Matrix matching, 
 + More & Less, 
 + Great & Small, 
 + Big & Small, 
 + Long & Short, 
 + Tall & Short.
 + Bubbles shoot, 
 + Match, 
 + Memory, 
 + Domino, 
 + Maze, 
 + Cookies, 
 + Whack a bunny, 
 + Connect the Dots, 
 + Raining shapes
 + Animals Flow (New - 5 animal packs. 5x5-10x10 boards. 600 levels!)
 + Balloon Pop (New - learn colors, shapes, numbers and english ABC)
 + Animal Flow (New)
 + Letter Tracing (New)
 + Music Time (New)
Collect Stickers and a many more fun surprises! 
+ The game Does Not contain ads nor social links.
+ The game contains In App Purchases to unlock the base pack or subscribe to Tiltan Games entire educational library. 
+ The first 2 levels are open for free in each difficulty zone. Unlock all from the parents section.
Important things to know about the subscription:
• Subscription can be canceled anytime 
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Payment is charged to your iTunes Account when you confirm the app purchase.
• Account is charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current billing period at the subscribed price
• You can manage your subscriptions from your account on the AppStore 
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Для кого:
- для ресторанов, отелей, салонов красоты, курьерских служб.
- для самостоятельных исполнителей из сферы услуг.
Сервис поможет организовать приём чаевых представителям любой сферы, где это актуально. Для клиентов оплата чаевых будет простой и удобной.
Владельцам бизнеса и администраторам:
- помогаем с материалами 
- интегрируем QR-коды в кассовые системы, присылаем визитки, стикеры и тейблтенты.
Снимаем нагрузку с бухгалтера
Сотрудники получают чаевые напрямую от гостей по договору дарения — это не облагается налогами.
Собираем для вас отзывы 
Вместе с чаевыми клиенты могут оставить в сервисе комментарий об исполнителе и поставить ему оценку.
В общий котёл или персонально
Добавляйте в систему одного человека для сбора чаевых для всей смены или всю команду для получения личных чаевых.
Исполнителям:
- бесплатная виртуальная карта Visa за минуту.
- вывод денег с сервиса без комиссии в первый месяц. 
- персональный QR-код — виртуальный или на красивой визитке.
- баланс вашего счёта и статистика по оценкам и отзывам в личном кабинете сервиса.

bluejetty:00075604:ios.name: Ninja Sword: Ragdoll swordsman
bluejetty:00075604:ios.summary: Sword Ninja is a game in which everyone can feel like a real warrior or ragdoll fighter. Sword fighting games offer simple and intuitive functionality and colorful graphics. This app is no exception. Full immersion in the process is guarant
bluejetty:00075604:ios.description:
Sword Ninja is a game in which everyone can feel like a real warrior or ragdoll fighter. Sword fighting games offer simple and intuitive functionality and colorful graphics. This app is no exception. Full immersion in the process is guaranteed.
What awaits you in the Sword Ninja game?
After you've installed the game on your phone, you don't need to waste a lot of time on tedious registration and profile creation. The gameplay will begin immediately. The main character is a ninja fighter which you have to manage. The location on which the ragdoll fights take place is the pixel buildings. At this height, your main task is to kill all opponents that are on the field. To cope with this task, you need to learn how to properly move your game hero without wasting time. Otherwise, if you don't kill the others, they will kill you and the game will be over. Test your dexterity in pixel fighting games! Be on the alert!
Ragdoll fights games have many levels that differ in their complexity. The game is built in such a way that you will definitely not get bored. At the very beginning of the fighting games, it may seem that everything is too simple. But believe, this is only at first glance! In the hands of a good player, ninja fights better than anyone else. 
Everything is built in such a way that the further you advance, the more opponents you will have in pixel fighting games. The sword fighting in each level will end when there are no more opponents on the field. Feel like a real warrior!
This Sword Ninja Fighter is enthralling because it will suit absolutely everyone! It doesn't matter if you are a student who wants to while away the lecture time, a schoolboy who just wants to have fun, or an adult who wants to relieve stress and enjoy the process. This is a good choice for everyone! Bright graphics, a plot that captivates. Everyone can enjoy the gameplay. Also, in the Sword Ninja game you can change the look of the character, and also many weapons are available to you. Remember, ragdoll fights exactly as you control him. Everything depends only on you!
Will you be able to collect all the points by passing level after level on the roof of a skyscraper? Challenge all opponents to become the first in a rooftop fight.
Feel like a real ragdoll fighter in our pixel fighting game!

bluejetty:00177972:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
GO BALL!
Go Ball is a challenging brain training kids game - a combination of a classic tile puzzle and mathematics tasks for 8-12-year-olds. This learning game helps your child develop thinking, focus & concentration by resolving a variety of unique puzzles & math assignments. Slide the tiles to unblock the ball & let it roll to the goal! 
Go Ball features:
- Challenging kids game for mind training
- Hundreds of levels with unique puzzle combinations & routes
- No time limits - give it a proper thought!
- Hints to guide you when stuck
- Customized math content developed by teachers for kids of different learning levels
- A safe game without advertisement
_____
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00045820:ios.name: Foqos - Tap to Block
bluejetty:00045820:ios.summary:
Turn your phone into a distraction-free zone in seconds.
Choose the apps that pull you in Instagram, TikTok, games, email, or anything else and block them instantly with a single tap or scan. No complicated settings, no endless menus.
Her
bluejetty:00045820:ios.description:
Turn your phone into a distraction-free zone in seconds.
Choose the apps that pull you in Instagram, TikTok, games, email, or anything else and block them instantly with a single tap or scan. No complicated settings, no endless menus.
Here is how it works in real life:
• Studying at your desk 
Place an NFC tag or QR code on your desk. When it is time to study, tap your phone on the tag or scan the code. Social media, games, and other distracting apps are blocked so you can focus on your notes, not your notifications.
• Deep work at the office 
Stick a tag on your monitor or laptop. Before you start an important task, tap or scan. Messaging, email, and news apps are paused so you can stay in flow and actually finish that report.
• Reading and writing 
Put a tag on your bedside table, notebook, or favorite reading spot. Tap or scan to block the apps that break your concentration so you can read, journal, or write without reaching for your feed every few minutes.
• Focus anywhere 
Add tags to places where you tend to lose time the kitchen, couch, or coffee table. One tap or scan turns your phone from a distraction machine into a simple tool for the task at hand.
You are always in control:
• Pick exactly which apps to block for each tag or code 
• Create different focus setups for work, study, or downtime 
• Turn blocks on with a tap or scan, and off just as easily when you are done
Instead of relying on willpower every time you pick up your phone, change your environment so focus becomes the default. Set up your tags or codes once, then use them whenever you sit down to concentrate.
Choose your apps. Tap or scan. Stay focused. 
Tags are not unique per device, so share them around!

bluejetty:00123404:ios.description:
Dial a Bottle® offers one hour home delivery for beer, wine, liquor, champagne, spirits, liqueurs, cigarettes, snacks and pop! We will deliver beer and liquor to all our service areas in Canada and the United States! We'll even return your empties. 
Simply order using your app and we'll do the rest! We'll bring it to your door—deliveries in less than an hour!! That’s IT!
We are the original and we became the largest beer and liquor delivery service in Ontario. Today, Dial a Bottle® is expanding across all of North America.
Many years ago, someone came up with the great idea of quick home delivery of beer. Now you can easily order by phone, online or using your smartphone. Simply provide us with the necessary information that we'll ask you when you order. One of our professionals will purchase your items at the local beer or liquor store and deliver them to your front door!
Each Dial a Bottle® territory is independently owned and operated by licensed business owners (A.G.C.O. in Ontario).

bluejetty:00019600:ios.description:
Raya is a private global community designed to help members discover meaningful connections anywhere in the world. Whether you're looking for dating, friendship, or professional networking, Raya aims to bring together interesting and kind people looking to connect beyond their existing circles. Membership is available by application only.
Applications are reviewed by our global committee on an ongoing basis. Based on a number of factors, application review can range from days to months. Accepted members may choose a 1, 6, or 12 month membership.
Through features like Daily Recommendations, Maps, and Directory, members can discover and connect with people nearby or across the world.
Trust, respect, and privacy are central to the Raya experience. Members control their visibility within the community, personal information is carefully protected and never shared, and accounts may be suspended or terminated for behavior that does not reflect our community guidelines.
Memberships are offered as auto-renewing subscriptions. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time.
—
For more, please see our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:
https://www.rayatheapp.com/terms

bluejetty:00031495:ios.description:
The world’s first on-demand drone delivery service is coming to your backyard!
Anything you need - from sushi takeout or your morning coffee to toothpaste you just ran out of, will be delivered instantly to your backyard or a public point nearby.
- Skip the lines and the 6 pm traffic. Your food will be delivered hotter and faster than ever before.
- No contact. Order from the comfort of your home, and our drones will take care of the rest.
Here’s how it works:
- Download the app and select your preferred delivery location
- Browse through the available local restaurants and add items to your cart
- Complete the checkout and track your order’s progress
- Follow the drone’s flight in real-time as it flies to your backyard
- Watch as your order is gently lowered to the ground
- Eat, then repeat
The service is available in select locations in the USA. Delivery zones and times are limited. Find out more at www.flytrex.com

bluejetty:00084737:ios.description:
The YouTV app version enables television on iPhone and iPad in a new dimension. Record everything and watch it anytime. In HD, with subtitles, skip commercials and with audio description. And new: watch running recordings shortly after their start. 
Watching German TV how YOU want - worldwide. With YouTV® you record every German TV channel, every TV show, worldwide with one click. The amazing YouTV is a cloud based Online TV recorder that enables you to record your favorite TV shows with one single click. No need for further hardware! This App and the connected cloud VCR are enough! Lean back and select one of your recordings available from a simple to use App. 
• German TV video recorder, time shifted TV
• Closed captions and Ad-Skip
• Record TV shows with one click
• HD High Definition streaming
• Use the search to find your favorite show
• Heimat-TV, news, sport, documentary, and many more
• Simple to use TV library and program guide
• Ready for your children
• Audiodeskription for blind people
• Worldwide usage
• Watch App for quick VCR overview
• Watch complications
• Chromecast support
• Podcast-RSS support
• Recording-Assistants for automatic series, genres, etc recording
• And many more
-- About in App purchases -- 
YouTV VCR subscriptions like the well known "PRO" subscription with longterm-archive and 7 day TV library access, are available also through iTunes in App purchase. Buy your desired VCR subscription secure and easy with your iTunes account. Some information about the purchases: 
• The length of every subscription (time period) is one month and each subscription will be auto-renewed till it will be cancelled.
• The payment is charged to your personal iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. 
• Your iTunes Account will be charged for renewal every month. The amount depends on the selected product:
 – 5,99€ each month for BASIC
 – 9,99€ each month for PRO
 – 14,99€ each month for FAMILY
More details about the products and features can be found on YouTV.de
Please note: the cancellation and termination of your personal YouTV VCR subscription is possible at any time. Subscriptions will be managed by going to the iTunes subscriptions control pane (settings of your device). A termination through the website youtv.de is not possible. 
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period .
General terms and conditions and documents about our privacy statement can be found and read on YouTV.de at any time. 
General terms and conditions: http://help.youtv.de/customer/portal/articles/2173458-agb
Privacy statement: http://help.youtv.de/customer/portal/articles/2173475-datenschutz

- "Alien Hive looks and feels like
bluejetty:00065764:ios.description:
- "Indie Showcase Top 10 Award & Best Art Award." - Casual Connect Asia 2013
- "Appxplore brings us yet another fun and addicting puzzle game that is unique to any other." - GameDynamo, EDITORS' CHOICE! 
- "Alien Hive looks and feels like the best puzzle game I’ve played in a very long time... It’s brilliant, addictive, and endlessly fun." - Arcade Sushi, 9/10 Stars! 
- "A extremely addictive and surprisingly original title in the overly-crowded match-three puzzle genre. It combines block swapping with monster-collection and breeding. Well worth your time and your IAP money!" - LittleAppPreview, Score: 9/10 
- It's a winning combination, with an almost perfect relaxation-to-robot ratio - KOTAKU
*Check out the BLITZ MODE Trailer - http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sUbjeXzooYk
Alien Hive is all about evolving aliens, blending match-3 with sliding tile puzzles for a game that feels both familiar and fresh. Swipe tiles to make matches – combine eggs to hatch cute baby aliens, and then help them fully evolve into Supreme Aliens. 
Match resource tiles for upgrades that let you take command of the board, with the goal of building the ultimate alien hive. Strategically avoid the villainous Bots, who block your progress, by crafting power-ups to eliminate these baddies. As you advance, you will uncover the mystery of the hidden aliens… and tame the Red Planet! 
Alien Hive Features: 
* Evolving-aliens puzzle gameplay: hybrid of match-3 and sliding tile puzzles… it’s a whole new type of puzzling fun 
* Match tiles to harvest resources, grow new species of aliens and zap the villainous Bots 
* Chill out: pastel graphics and mellow soundtrack, with no time limit to harsh the vibe 
* Advance the alien society: collect and unleash dozens of Supreme Aliens 
* Additional Fast-Action Fun BLITZ MODE.
* 70 Achievements to suit all styles of play 
* 14 Achievements for Blitz Mode 
* Auto save game progress 
* High Score and Achievements sharing on Facebook 
* Free to play universal app for iPad, iPhone 
* iCloud & Game Center Support
* Over thousands of Power Boost combinations
* Level up your Supreme Aliens
If you face any technical issue on your device, appreciate if you can contact us prior to writing negative review. We will try to address the issue as soon as possible.

bluejetty:00124011:ios.name: Lies Of Astaroth-Clash Games
bluejetty:00124011:ios.summary:
Top 5 epic clash strategy card games in more than 50 countries!
Lies of Astaroth (LoA) is a free-to-play and highly addictive epic fantasy MMORPG card-battle hybrid! With its simple yet deep battle design, the game has long been championed
bluejetty:00124011:ios.description:
Top 5 epic clash strategy card games in more than 50 countries!
Lies of Astaroth (LoA) is a free-to-play and highly addictive epic fantasy MMORPG card-battle hybrid! With its simple yet deep battle design, the game has long been championed as the combination of best of both worlds, satisfying both hardcore card game fans for strategy depth and causal players for fantasy RPG gameplay.
"Lies of Astaroth made me a firm believer in the potential of card-based adventure games" - Gamezebo
"If you love card battle games, this iOS CCG is a must-try title" - Tapscape
"Definitive example of free to play done right" - The Miki Show
FEATURES
1. Stunning Graphics and over 400 collectable beautifully drawn cards, collect, upgrade and evolve your card with additional skill.
2. Rich and Engrossing Storyline, follow our hero (or heroine) and Maddisy to an epic adventure of more than 100 stages with humor and suspense!
3. Fluid & deep battle mechanics, with the combination of different cards, runes faction and skills, every battle will be unique and satisfying!
4. Rich Features to keep you occupied for months, including 
*** (Newly added) King of Kings - A competition with randomly generated rule, can you outwit your opponents?
*** (Newly added) Land Scramble - A clash of 2 faction that shakes the world of LOA, prove your worth by slaying more foes and bringing more points to your faction!
*** (Newly added) Wall of Honor - give props to top players in your server and get rewarded!
*** PVP Arena - Challenge other players to reach the top.
*** Clan Match - Battle with clan mates to becomes the strongest clan in your server.
*** Dungeon - dig deep in the Dungeon and face with some of the hardest level in the game.
*** Demon Invasion - fight with other players in your server to defeat the ultra-strong bosses.
*** Chop Shop - Collect items in Maze and exchange them to spectacular prizes.
*** Month Card - Best valued item. Receive 50 crystal reward for daily reward in a month (30 days) as well as time saving feature such as Auto Maze and Auto Defend.
*** Card Compose - Every little makes a mickle, use card scraps and universal scraps to compose cards that you desire
And much much more!
5. Reward System for active players, including 20 day log-in card, level bonus, event reward and frequent free goodies!
Lies of Astaroth is a growing experience with new content added frequently, including new cards, new stages, new feature and new rewards! Remember to check back regularly to see what's new!
Connect with other players on Facebook: - http://www.facebook.com/LiesOfAstarothFansPage
Thank you for playing！

bluejetty:00175330:ios.description:
Introducing Flirtini – the perfect safe space to the people who share your interests. Chat with singles, flirt online & spice up your flirting game while adding a touch of fun to the mix. With Flirtini, you can:
- Scout for like-minded charmers using a diverse range of filters
- Spark a connection and slide into private chats with ease
- Breathe life into your profile by sharing Stories with flair
Want to chat with singles, meet new people, and connect with like-minded locals? Your next date could be just around the corner!
FLIRTINI FACTS
• 2 million downloads
• The majority of users are men and women aged 25+.
• Featured in Dating News as one of the “Top 10 Best AI-Integrated Dating Tools of 2024.”
• Recognized by Digital Trends as one of the “Best Dating Apps of 2023.”
UNIQUE FEATURES
- Personal AI Dating Assistant: Discover your ultimate dating companion. Our AI Assistant provides timely advice without taking control, ensuring your dating experience remains authentically human. It's like having a savvy wingman in your pocket, guiding your dating journey.
- Icebreaker: Our AI-assistant helps you conquer anonymous chats, ensuring you never run out of things to say. Enjoy a smooth conversation flow with tailored ice-breakers that are sure to grab attention.
- Flirty Mate: Our AI isn't just a companion, it's your key to sparking flirty banter and irresistible wordplay. Enjoy lively chats, playful teasing, and even virtual dates, all with a splash of flirtatious charm.
- Zodiac Compatibility: Our AI analyzes profiles and provides personalized zodiac synergy, revealing personality traits between you and your potential date.
- Updated Quiz from AI Assistant – Not sure how to start? Discover your dating style with our AI and get a personalized profile description, first message tips, and conversation starters! 
PREMIUM FEATURES
- Perfect match suggestion - For those who don’t want to spend hours scrolling, let our virtual assistant find matches that fit your vibe.
- Skip the waiting game and instantly chat with like-minded individuals. Make your move and stand out from the crowd.
- Personalized search filters - find your date faster by filtering matches based on interests.
- Accidentally skipped a profile? Bring it back with a simple rewind.
FOR YOUR CONVENIENCE
- Live Support: Our customer care team is at your service 24/7.
- Strict Security: We verify all users, so you can meet new people without worrying about fake profiles and scammers.
SUBSCRIPTION
The app is free to download and use, with optional subscription packages available. The subscription price varies by country and is subject to change. You can always find the exact price displayed in the app under Settings. Your Flirtini subscription will be automatically renewed if you do not deactivate your subscriptions a minimum of 24 hours before the end of your current subscription period. You may cancel the subscription anytime.
Please read our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use for more information:
https://www.flirtini.com/staticPage/privacypolicy
https://www.flirtini.com/staticPage/terms

bluejetty:00086967:ios.description:
Introducing Pikaslice, a comprehensive slicing solution for both Resin/MSLA and Filament/FFF 3D printers on the mobile platform. Effortlessly import your 3D models, adjust their orientation and layout, apply manual or automatic supports, examine your scene for islands, and export your work to an extensive range of supported Resin/MSLA and Filament/FFF 3D printers.

Please note that this app is compatible with a variety of resin MSLA, DLP, and FFF/Filament 3D printers (see the list within the app).

bluejetty:00024013:ios.description:
Spotlight is the latest HIT that brings stories to life through animation and unique storytelling gameplay. You can be an influencer with millions of fans, an Alpha king with magical powers, a vampire with a dark secret, or a queen with a grand agenda! Each character is equipped with unique personalities, stories, and abilities. Follow your heart, build friendships... or not, the decision is YOURS! Every decision lies in the palm of your hands. Choose how you interact with other characters, take control of your story, and be whoever you want!! 
With over 2000+ chapters and different stories for you to choose from. So get ready to dive into a world filled with romance, mystery, revenge, intense drama, and fantasy that will hook you! Make decisions through countless choices in every story, and find out how each choice will lead you to different paths!
Features:
• Check out our Hollywood and NYT bestseller writers on Spotlight originals!
• 2000+ chapters and weekly new stories so you'll never be bored!
• Collectable CG cards and mini games!
• Customize your character from head to toe with unique fashionable outfits, hairstyles, and decorate your own virtual room.
• Weekly updates and stories to binge on.
• Engage and chat directly with the user community!
Top Genres To Binge:
• Romance
• Vampires and Werewolves Supernatural
• Intense Drama
• Sexy Mystery & Thriller
• Young Adult
• Bad Boy & Mafia Adventures
• LGBTQ+
And so much More! Play now to find out.
Top Editors Pick & Community Popular Voted Stories:
Behind Closed Doors: It's your first year of college, surviving it won't be easy! Especially when Jake, a.k.a your best friend, roommate, and unrequited love of your life, gets a new girlfriend who hates you. But then you meet Zach Walker, the unbelievably hot son of your state senator…
Influencer Mansion: Welcome to INFLUENCER MANSION - where you're competing with 20 sexy influencers for a Hollywood contract! But you must find your own path - and followers - in order to win it all!!
Alpha Mates: You would do anything to find your wolf spirit— the one thing separating werewolves from humans. Without it, you face torment and even execution... until you meet Zach and Ace. The mysterious, brooding Alpha and kind, thoughtful Beta redefine what it means to be a wolf and show you more wonders than you thought existed. Will you overcome your struggles and reach your destiny? Or suffer the consequences of your dark secret?
Downright Delinquents: A brutal tragedy sends your once-perfect life spiraling out of control. In the last-ditch effort to put you on the right path, your uncle sends you to Downright High, a school for delinquents. There you meet a mysterious bad boy whose scorching good looks are as hot as his hellish temper. Will you manage to resist him or will your undeniable attraction consume you?
MAID FOR THREE: What happens when you pack up your bags and leave home for the big city?
A new place can be scary and struggling to find a job to make ends meet. Until you come across a job offer that seems too good to be true. Ecstatic, you jump into a binding contract with them, only to realize that you’ve been scammed!
Please note that Spotlight is an online game that requires an internet connection to play.

bluejetty:00128803:ios.description:
Dear little hero, Baby Panda's math world is destroyed by the devil king. It's your show time! Let's go and save the math world! 
Defeat the devil king
The devil king is coming for mischief! You need to dodge lightning and fly up into the sky to challenge the devil king. Watch out for its fireball attacks. 
Dear little hero, when the devil king runs out of energy, launch an attack quickly and defeat it! And then start your next adventure. 
Restore island
Explore puzzle world. Observe the shape of puzzle pieces and put them into the right places so as to restore candy island. 
Move rocks and wood to build road for treasure hunting. Go across the forest and the ocean to get colored gems so as to restore monster island. 
Decorate math island
Manage a farm, raise hens and cows for eggs and milk, and acquire meadows to expand math island. 
Grow crops, and pick fruits and flowers. Collect math energy and acquire treasure chest to decorate math island. 
The adventure to save the math world is going on! 
Dear little heroes, many more islands are available for you to restore at Baby Panda's math world. Come for adventure in the forest, the ocean, the farm, and dinosaur island.
About BabyBus
—————
At BabyBus, we dedicate ourselves to sparking kids' creativity, imagination and curiosity,and designing our products through the kids' perspective to help them explore the world on their own.
Now BabyBus offers a wide variety of products, videos and other educational content for over 400 million fans from ages 0-8 around the world! We have released over 200 children's educational apps, over 2500 episodes of nursery rhymes and animations of various themes spanning the Health, Language, Society, Science, Art and other fields.
—————
Contact us: ser@babybus.com
Visit us: https://app.babybus.com

bluejetty:00062556:ios.description:
Prepare for nursing school and pass your nursing exams with Picmonic! For FREE you can access our most popular Videos, Multiple Choice Quiz Questions, and Daily Quiz with Spaced Repetition for 5 days. Get full unlimited access with an affordable subscription.
Ridiculously efficient & effective. Make Studying Fun & Remember More in Less Time with Picmonic, the world’s best mnemonic video & spaced repetition quizzing study tool and app that’s research-proven to increase memory retention 331%!
14,000+ RN quiz & practice questions & 1,200+ entertaining mnemonic videos covering all major topics & subjects. Ditch boring textbook memorization, recall information faster & retain it longer to improve your grades to ace your nursing courses, clinicals & board certification exam with less study time using unforgettable images and stories.
• Program Options: Nursing RN, Nursing LPN, Nurse Practitioner
**MEDICAL/PA/PT/OT/RX & College students, click “Picmonic Developer” under this description for the Picmonic for Medicine App OR Picmonic for College (Paramedic, Medical Terms, MCAT, Biology, A&P, Psych).
• Nursing Topics & Courses: Fundamentals of Nursing, Physiology, Pharmacology, Pathophysiology, Med-Surg, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Anatomy, Critical Care, Peds & more
• Body System course organization & prep with the NCLEX Study Guide
• Textbook mappings: Elsevier & Lippincott books like Saunders NCLEX, Lewis, Pottery & Perry, Lilley, Lehne, Jarvis, Adams, Taylor, Brunner & Suddarth, Ignatavicius, Wong, Lowdermilk & Ricci!
**Nurse Practitioner Students
1,800 NP videos & 21,000 quiz questions for your FNP, ANP, GNP, or A-GNP courses & the AANP or ANCC board exam, you can even follow along with the Fitzgerald or Leik review books!
“I am so excited and HAPPY that I passed the ANCC Board examination for FNP!! I definitely feel that using Picmonic was SO HELPFUL to remember many of the facts that I needed to know!” Mary B. @ Chamberlain Nursing
**Nursing Students
Start memorizing Lab Values. Stop confusing acids & bases.
Pass the NCLEX® in 75 questions then go be a great nurse!
All the critical info you need to know as a nursing student is turned into 1,000 videos & 10,000 quiz questions preparing you for nursing school, HESI ATI Kaplan exams, and the NCLEX RN or NCLEX PN.
“I struggled in my Fundamentals class, then found Picmonic & made a 95 on my fluid and electrolytes exam! My first A ever in nursing school!” Rene S. @ Bevill State Nursing
“Pure memorization can be hard, but Picmonic has helped me ACE my pharmacology class in nursing school. 1000x thanks!” Michael B. @ Valencia Nursing
Use the tool starting day one to learn nursing smarter. Assigned reading, follow along by textbook chapter watching these cartoon mnemonics to show up to class prepared, then use the Daily Review Quiz that’s better than Quizlet or any pharm flashcards or Mosby flashcards to prep for that HESI or ATI Nursing exam. You’ll remember all the details and stop referencing Nursing Drug Handbooks / Scrub Cheats.
Get an NCLEX Qbank quiz question wrong in NCLEX RN Mastery, UWORLD NCLEX, NRSNG, Osmosis or Kaplan NCLEX Qbank? Hop back to Picmonic so it sticks! Our characters become your very own ATI Mentor and bond together to act as your Saunders NCLEX RN review book choir, singing you the sweet answers.
Premium Access: Upgrade for all features & content in your area of study. Monthly, semesterly & annual subscriptions are available, prices vary by product & location. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase & any unused portion of a free trial period will then be forfeited. Subscriptions automatically renew & your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, at the original subscription price, unless auto-renew is turned off thru iTunes Account Settings prior to being charged.

bluejetty:00120739:ios.name: Word Swipe Connect: Crossword
bluejetty:00120739:ios.summary: Immerse yourself in the ultimate anagram word puzzle experience with "Word Swipe Connect: Crossword"! Are you up for the challenge of solving thousands of intricate word puzzles? Prepare to engage your mind in a delightful blend of stimulat
bluejetty:00120739:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in the ultimate anagram word puzzle experience with "Word Swipe Connect: Crossword"! Are you up for the challenge of solving thousands of intricate word puzzles? Prepare to engage your mind in a delightful blend of stimulation and relaxation.
Bored of the same old word games? This innovative take combines the finest features of crossword puzzles, word searches, anagrams, scrambles, and text twists, offering a refreshing twist on the genre. With a vast collection of over 1800 free puzzles, each set against breathtakingly beautiful and serene backdrops, you're in for a journey that transports you away from the pressures of the real world.
Exercise your gray matter with an unlimited array of entertaining word puzzles that strike the perfect balance between invigorating challenge and soothing relaxation. Whether you're seeking a cerebral escape during a break or yearning for a calming activity to unwind, this game has you covered.
The allure of "Word Swipe Connect: Crossword" goes beyond its engaging gameplay. It's not just another word puzzle; it's a comprehensive experience. Here's what you can expect:
◆ Play: Dive into the captivating world of word puzzles. The game's accessibility makes it a fantastic choice for players of all ages.
◆ Easy to Pick Up, Too Addictive to Put Down: The intuitive gameplay mechanics ensure that you can start solving puzzles right away. But beware—the addictive nature of the challenges might keep you hooked for hours!
◆ Connect and Cross Words: With your finger as the guide, link letters to form words and weave a web of interconnected solutions on the grid. As words intersect and overlap, the puzzle takes shape before your eyes.
◆ Gradually Escalating Difficulty: Starting with puzzles designed to ease you in, the game gradually ups the ante, presenting increasingly intricate and demanding puzzles. This ensures that both newcomers and seasoned players find the gameplay rewarding and engaging.
◆ Over 1,800 Handcrafted Puzzles: Delve into a treasury of meticulously crafted puzzles, each meticulously designed to provide a unique challenge. Drawing from a dictionary containing over 200,000 distinct words, you'll encounter an array of linguistic gems.
◆ Bonus Words and Coins: Discover bonus words hidden within the puzzles to earn valuable coins. These coins come in handy when you need hints to overcome particularly stubborn challenges.
◆ Soothing Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in the serene atmosphere fostered by the game's soothing and inspiring soundtrack. Every puzzle-solving session becomes a tranquil retreat for your senses.
◆ Continuous Updates: The excitement never ends! The game keeps evolving with regular updates, introducing new themes, puzzles, music tracks, and additional content. This means there's always something fresh to look forward to.
If you're a connoisseur of word games, puzzle aficionado, or simply someone who enjoys flexing their mental muscles, "Word Swipe Connect: Crossword" has been tailored for your entertainment. It's more than just a game; it's a gateway to a realm of linguistic exploration and relaxation.
As you embark on this adventure of words, we encourage you to share your experiences. If the game manages to captivate your attention and bring a smile to your face, kindly consider leaving a positive review. Your feedback fuels our passion to create engaging experiences for players like you.
Thank you for choosing "Word Swipe Connect: Crossword" as your destination for wordy escapades. Your journey through the world of anagram puzzles has just begun, and we're thrilled to be part of it. Enjoy the puzzles, savor the relaxation, and embrace the challenge!
If you have any questions or suggestions please reach out to us at:
https://loyalfoundry.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1
Use is governed by the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy: https://www.loyalfoundry.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00186634:ios.description:
Join millions of learners worldwide that read, listen, write and speak a language with FunEasyLearn. It’s free, effective, and can be used offline. FunEasyLearn believes that everyone should have a chance to learn any language from their own mother tongue. That’s why we are continuously adding new languages for achieving this goal.
FunEasyLearn offers ample and complete courses divided into topics, subtopics, and difficulty levels. Each verb, noun, adjective, greeting, or useful phrase is related to everyday life. That’s why the app works well for both personal needs and travel purposes.
Why this app:
- 34 language courses.
- Contents: Alphabet + ALL Reading Rules + ALL Words (continuously updated) + 5,000 Phrases.
- Developed with native translators and professional voice actors.
- Colorful and engaging: great app for parents & kids to spend time together.
- No boring lessons, just fun.
Learn a language from your mother tongue. 
You can learn 34 languages: English, American English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Romanian, Russian, Arabic, Bulgarian, Catalan, Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese, Slovak, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian.
The above-listed languages can be learned from 61 mother tongues.
Change the way you learn languages forever. Use innovative strategies for learning and memorizing words and phrases while playing games. Feel the great satisfaction of finally speaking a foreign language. 
Track your progress, earn flowers & bees, and enjoy your learning. Use flowers as a payment for a FREE subscription.
Our artists crafted beautiful images just to make your learning enjoyable and effortless.
Join the biggest community of successful learners - kids, teenagers, pupils, students, mums, dads, grannies, tourists, and many-many others.
--------------------------------------------
While everything you learn in Learn Languages is free as you pay with the flowers earned in the app, we do offer a FunEasyLearn Premium Subscription to unlock all the courses. If you choose to purchase the FunEasyLearn Subscription, the payment will be charged to your iTunes account. The subscription renews automatically unless the auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. You can also turn off the auto-renewal at any time just by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after the purchase.
The FunEasyLearn Subscription price varies in different countries. If you choose not to purchase the FunEasyLearn Subscription, use it for free by paying with flowers.
Privacy Policy: https://www.funeasylearn.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.funeasylearn.com/terms

bluejetty:00180499:ios.description:
T3 is your ultimate guide to smarter living, bringing together the best in technology, design and innovation — all in one beautifully designed digital version for iPhone and iPad.
From the latest gadgets, phones, watches and TVs to cutting-edge auto tech, luxury gear and streaming essentials, T3 helps you make the smartest choices for how you travel, live, work and play. 
Inside each issue:
- Hands-on reviews of the hottest products
- Expert coverage of cars, tech and future trends
- Buyer’s guides for everything from gadgets to phones
- Home upgrades, automation tips & luxury lifestyle inspiration
- The best in entertainment, streaming and smart TV tech
Written by passionate experts and packed with stunning original photography, T3 is the magazine for those who love the future and want to live it now.
Download today and start your free trial. 
-------------------
Once you’ve downloaded our app, you will need to take a free trial or purchase a single issue or subscription to access our in-depth content. We also publish specials and guides - browse our publications, read what interests you most, and get inspired.
Back issues, specials, and future issues are available for purchase within the app. Subscriptions are available on various monthly and annual terms, and auto-renew until you decide to cancel it. Check inside the app for current pricing.
*** Please Note: Our digital edition is not printable and does not include the covermount items or supplements you would find with the print edition ***
• The free trial offer is only available to new subscribers. If you have previously subscribed then payment will be taken immediately.
• You can cancel at any time during the free trial period and you will not be charged. Simply turn off auto-renew in your Apple account subscriptions page at least 24 hours before the auto-renew is due.
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
• You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, for the same duration and at the current subscription rate for that product.
• You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase .
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. This does not affect your statutory rights.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
• We will be collecting information about your use of the app both when you are online and offline. To find out more please see our privacy policy.
The subscription will include the current issue if you don't already own it and subsequently published future issues for the duration of your subscription period.
-------------------
By purchasing a subscription or downloading an app you agree that you have read and accept Future Publishing Ltd's Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
www.futureplc.com/privacy-policy/
www.futureplc.com/terms-conditions/

bluejetty:00018232:ios.description:
Know why it feels good to get banked with Maya? You can experience next-level digital banking with the safety of a bank and convenience of a wallet.
With Maya, you can start saving money and earn up to 15% interest p.a. every day, loan up to P250,000 in seconds, enjoy instant rewards with your credit card, pay and shop with your Maya Credit and Wallet Card worldwide, and scan any QR Ph to pay for anything.
SAVE
• Why let your money burn when you can earn up to thousands in interest on Maya Savings?
• Start banking with just 1 valid ID, deposit your money, and enjoy up to 15% interest p.a. that's credited to you every day.
• That's literally free money every 24 hours to your savings account. Grow your money with Maya Bank now!
CREDIT CARDS
• Instant shopping rewards and next-level security – that's what you get with a Maya credit card.
• Apply for a Maya Black Credit Card and earn instant Maya Miles that can take you closer to your next trip, or get a Landers Cashback Everywhere Credit Card and earn up to 5% cashback that you can spend at any Landers Superstore.
• Credit card application and offer are subject to approval.
SHOP & PAY
• All the features you need to send money, shop online, pay your bills, and other banking and wallet transactions are right here, too.
• Get a Maya Wallet Card or Credit Card and use it worldwide or make transactions and shop at your favorite local shops.
• Scan any QR Ph to pay cash transactions conveniently from your wallet.
INVEST
• You’ve got plenty of ways to explore your money's potential through crypto and funds.
• Buy, sell, and trade Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other popular cryptocurrencies for as low as P1 or try Maya Funds and invest in world-famous companies for just P50.
BORROW
• When you're ready for some big life upgrades, get a Personal Loan of up to P250,000 instantly.
• Use Maya Easy Credit to loan up to P30,000 and use it to pay your bills, shop, or give your everyday money a boost.
Loan application is subject to credit evaluation. See below for loan terms:
• Credit limit amount: P15,000 - P250,000
• Monthly add-on interest rate: 0.77% - 2.57%
• Monthly effective interest rate: 1.4% - 4.25%
• Tenure: 6 - 24 months
• Max. annual APR: 30.78%
• Applicable DST and other fees: Waived
• Late fee (daily) on overdue principal: 0.17%
Sample computation
• Loan amount: P25,000
• Monthly add-on interest rate: 0.83%
• Tenure: 6 months
• DST/fees: P0
• Monthly installment amount: P4,374.17
• Total repayment amount: P26,239.19
• Daily penalty: 0.17%
Maya is a proudly licensed bank regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas. Deposits are insured by PDIC up to P1,000,000 per depositor. Terms and conditions apply.
For 24/7 assistance, visit the Help Center on the Maya app. You may also call us from 8 AM to 7 PM daily at (+632) 8845 7788 or toll-free at 1800 1084 57788.
Office Address: Launchpad Building, Sheridan St., Mandaluyong, Metro Manila, Philippines

bluejetty:00184673:ios.name: Tayasui Watercolor & Painting
bluejetty:00184673:ios.summary: Tayasui Watercolor and Painting is the ultimate watercolor-focused drawing tool, with realistic brushes and an easy-to-use interface. We’ve created tools that feel like real ones, ensuring your watercolor paintings and sketches always look
bluejetty:00184673:ios.description:
Tayasui Watercolor and Painting is the ultimate watercolor-focused drawing tool, with realistic brushes and an easy-to-use interface. We’ve created tools that feel like real ones, ensuring your watercolor paintings and sketches always look amazing.
Tools and Features
- Drawing Tools and Enhancements: With over 20 tools that mimic real-life drawing implements, Watercolor and Painting includes an array of options such as watercolor—featuring both dry and wet brushes that behave just like real paint on paper, pens, Rotring, felt pens, pen brushes, oil pastels, acrylic brushes, airbrushes
- Tracing Projector: allows users to project their sketches onto any surface, facilitating tracing. This tool significantly enhances the creative workflow by enabling broader applications of the artwork.
- Precision Tools: The application offers various rulers and magnetic shapes, including straight, arc, circle, and spline rulers, alongside symmetry and cutout shapes—perfect for laying out detailed watercolor compositions or adding structured elements within freeform washes.
- Color Management: The app includes a color eyedropper, mixer, and support for color palettes (.ase).
- Layer Management: With full layer support, users can build up watercolor paintings gradually, just like on paper. Export transparent PNGs or layered PSD files for further refinement in other software.
- Cloud Sync and Organization: All your watercolor projects are backed up and synchronized across devices. Sync settings can be managed per folder, and projects can be neatly organized into custom folders or digital sketchbooks, keeping your watercolor works easy to access and beautifully presented.
- Stylus and User Interface: Apple Pencil is fully supported, capturing pressure, tilt, and stroke width to simulate natural watercolor strokes. The minimalist interface stays out of your way while you paint, letting the focus remain on your watercolor expression.
With its advanced watercolor simulation and the unique tracing projector, Tayasui Watercolor and Painting stands out as a powerful and versatile tool for artists, illustrators, and creative professionals who want to bring watercolor to life in the digital world.

- Length: monthly, yearly
- Your payment will be charged to your iTunes Account as soon as you confirm your purchase
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase
- Your subscription will renew automatically, unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- The cost of renewal will be charged to your account in the 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
- When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription

bluejetty:00186411:ios.description:
It's a school day in My City, how exciting! Get ready for another adventure where you can create your own stories, teach your own class, roleplay in your very own school play and much much more! The school comes with 9 locations including Art and Science classrooms, New school friend characters you can use in all of our other My City games.
NEW FEATURES 
We have added some cool new features as requested by our fans.
Favorites - A favorite category allowing you to have quick access to your favorite characters.
Weather - Sun, Rain or Snow? you control the weather.
We hope you enjoy those, Make sure to rate us and send us a comment if you do.
EXPLORE
My City : High school has nine fun locations where you can create your very own stories and explore. Grab a seat at the principal's office, hear the latest gossip at the school cafeteria, conduct science experiments and discover all the hidden locations around the school.
Let you imagination run wild, easily move characters and items between our other games, after school fun activity with your new friends? you can do that!
Game Features
1. Your new high school has 9 locations to explore. Art class, Science class, Sports class, school hall, Principals room, yard, cafeteria and more!
2. Lots of new characters and school friends you can move between other My City games.
3. Hidden treasures and brain puzzles. Are you smart enough to discover everything?
4. Kids Safe - No 3rd party Ads and IAP. Pay once and get free updates forever
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Get privacy-related information at https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/

Welcome to Hashtag Dating, where you can finally date your way!
Join millions of singles who've already discovered the thrill of matching, chatting, and connecting with local people from California to Texas, New York and beyond! With over 10 million love stories, friendships, and fun flings sparked by #Dating, we'll show you how fun and exciting online dating can really be! 
READY TO SHAKE THINGS UP?
Wave goodbye to mindlessly swiping through dull profiles and awkward encounters with strangers. Here at #Dating, hashtags are your new best friend. They instantly reveal shared interests and passions, making it a breeze to meet new people online, discover friendships or dive headfirst into love.
Get ready to explore your interests in a whole new way! Enjoy the ride...
OUR BEST FREE FEATURES 
All the fun essentials are free! That includes chatting with people once you've both liked each other, plus:
Spice up your profile with unique hashtags to share your likes, hobbies, favorite foods, music preferences and much more
Let hashtags work their magic by revealing common interests, connecting you with like-minded daters who share your passions
Swipe right if you're vibing with someone. If they like you too, it's a match made in hashtag heaven
Explore International Swiping and enjoy an adventure from the comfort of your couch! Swipe around the world and meet singles from over 50 countries
Break the ice with the My Info feature that allows you to share more about yourself, from zodiac sign to height, and uncover what other daters are all about
Play fun games like This or That and Photo Duel to find out how compatible are you with your match and gain insights on how to improve your dating profile. Will it be burgers or sushi for your first date? Let the games begin!
UPGRADES TO ROCK YOUR WORLD
1. Unlock your Likes page with See Who Liked You - Now you’ll know who’s interested from the get-go and see who already swiped right on you. 
2. Wow them before you’ve even matched - Found a potential date and feeling lovestruck? Use Wow to message someone from your swipe queue before you've even matched! Send a personalized message to stand out and make sure they notice you.
3. Get up to 12x more matches and messages with #Dating Premium, which includes four different benefits:
• Unlimited Likes: At #Dating, we’re all about genuine connections, that’s why we have a daily swipe limit. However, if you don't want to rest until you’ve found the one, remove the swipe limit with Unlimited Likes!
• Message Highlight: Take your message to the top with Message Highlight. Now your messages will stand out in your match's inbox, boosting your chances of a reply.
• Priority Profile: Skip to the front of the swipe queue with Priority Profile and be seen by even more people. More people means more potential matches!
• Swipe Rewind: Maybe you changed your mind or were too quick to judge. So with Swipe Rewind, you can easily redo your last like or dislike.
Follow us on social media to stay in the loop:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/hashtagdating
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hashtagdatingofficial
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@hashtagdating

bluejetty:00179484:ios.description:
QR Reader is the best & fastest free QR code/barcode scanner & QR code creator for both iPhone and iPad! By using your phone's or pad's camera, QR reader will automatically scan and recognize the information of the QR code or barcode and supports all major barcode and QR code formats, even includes 2FA authenticator. With QR Reader app, you can also create & share unlimited QR codes anytime as you want.
【Key Features】
-Easy to Use
QR code reader and barcode scanner can automatically detect and scan any code. You can also scan the QR code or barcode in the image gallery. If you are in a low-light environment, the flashlight supports you to scan and read QR codes and barcode. QR reader supports full iOS 15, and iPhone XR/XS/XS Max/11/11 Pro.
-Create QR Code & Share
QR Reader app helps you create unlimited QR codes, such as Weblink, text, vcard, phone number, email adress, SMS, WIFI, Geo Location and Calendar, etc. You can share QR code reader and scanner results via WhatsApp, Facebook, Twitter, Gmail, WeChat, Line, E-mail, SMS, etc.
-Support Batch Scan
We provide a convenient and fast batch scanning function, if you have a lot of QR codes/barcodes to scan, you can use this function to improve the scanning speed.
-Provide 2FA Authenticator for All Your Accounts
Two Factor Authentication is a proven security guarantee against a wide range of cyber attacks. You can scan the QR code and get verification codes with our app for all your web accounts.
-Scan Multiple Types
Quickly and securely scan many types of QR codes and barcodes, such as Weblink, text, WiFi, contact, ISBN, and product, etc. If the result of scan is a Website link, you can click the URL to jump to the webpage. If it's a wifi QR code, this app will automatically connect to it without the password. If the result of scan is a product, you can choose to search and get some detail information. And you can also compare prices with online ones to save money.
-View and Retrieve Scan History
All your results of scan will be included in the scan history and sorted by category. Our app also supports iCloud backup. And these results of scan can also be exported as a CVS file. You can choose to turn on the history option, so that even if you change the phone, you can retrieve the scanned history.
-APP Lock
You can set a separate secure password for your own QR Code Reader app to protect your personal app security.
-Customize QR Code Color
Available to set different colors for your QR code.
Download QR reader to scan QR codes and barcodes!

bluejetty:00039435:ios.description:
Nutrisense: Enhance your glucose monitoring experience, log food and activities, personalized guidance from glucose-certified Registered Dietitians.
Turn your body’s data into actionable steps for reduced cravings, improved energy, and lasting weight loss.
Our offerings:
Bring Your Own Sensor - App for your own CGM.
Glucose Programs - Glucose tracking, interpret your glucose data with glucose-certified Registered Dietitians, nutrition coaching, health optimization.
Dietitian Video Calls - Nutrition coaching paid for by your insurance ($0 out-of-pocket if eligible). Work with Registered Dietitians with specialties in diabetes, weight loss, sports nutrition, menopause, PCOS, gut health, and more. Book a call with or without a CGM.
Unlock you full health potential with Nutrisense, the app that helps you connect the dots between your blood sugar levels with food and lifestyle choices. Our hardware and app are designed to help you make smarter food choices and achieve optimal health, all while keeping you motivated and on track.
Key Features:
Continuous Glucose Monitoring: Nutrisense is compatible with most popular glucose monitors, such as Stelo, Lingo, Dexcom G7, Dexcom G6, FreeStyle Libre 3, FreeStyle Libre 2 and FreeStyle Libre 14-day CGMs.
Advanced Analytics: Track your progress with in-depth analytics and glucose trends. Discover insights into how various diet and lifestyle choices impact your blood sugar levels. Identify patterns and make data-driven decisions to improve your health.
Log Meals, Sleep, Stress and Exercise: Easily track your food, nutrition, diet and activities to get real-time view into how they impact your blood sugar levels. Food tracking is made easy - simply take a photo of your meal or scan a bar code.
Registered Dietitian Support: Guidance from glucose-trained dietitians (real human, not bot!), who can help you analyze your CGM data and make personalized food and lifestyle recommendations based on your body's unique data. Hassle-free coverage, most pay $0-out-of-pocket. End-to-end insurance eligibility checks handled by us.
Personalized Meal Plans: Enjoy delicious and nutritious meals tailored to your goals, dietary preferences, and nutritional needs. Say goodbye to boring diets!
Thriving Community: Connect, share, and learn from a community of health enthusiasts, all striving for a healthier lifestyle. Participate in group challenges, share your achievements, and find the support you need to reach your goals.
Health App Integration: Nutrisense integrates with Apple Health to enrich your visibility into your health with exercise, sleep, and wellness logs
Self-Paced Learning: A self-guided, in-app learning program - learn the fundamentals of glucose and nutrition.
Whether you're striving to lose weight, manage a metabolic health condition, or simply improve your overall wellness, Nutrisense is the ultimate companion for your health journey. Download now and start making every bite count!
Join the Nutrisense community and discover the key to a healthier, happier you!

bluejetty:00184216:ios.summary:
The easiest, fastest bill manager in the App Store. A universal app for iPhone & iPad, with multitasking on iPad. Cloud sync works across all iOS devices plus Mac with the available Mac version.
If you pay bills, you need Chronicle.
Here'
bluejetty:00184216:ios.description:
The easiest, fastest bill manager in the App Store. A universal app for iPhone & iPad, with multitasking on iPad. Cloud sync works across all iOS devices plus Mac with the available Mac version.
If you pay bills, you need Chronicle.
Here's why: A single late payment can cost you $30 or more and cause your credit score to plummet by up to 100 points. 
Chronicle reminds you to pay your bills, so you can just enter them, and forget about them. 
Plus, Chronicle syncs with the available Mac version, so you can view and pay your bills everywhere.
In addition to reminding you to pay your bills, Chronicle keeps track of all your payment history, including confirmation numbers, so you always have proof of payments.
New to Chronicle is the Pro version. Available as an in-app purchase, Chronicle Pro gives you access to all new features of Chronicle as they are updated.
Currently available features in Chronicle Pro: 
Forecast View: See the future—see what will be due every month for a year in advance.
Amount to Save: Stop bills from sneaking up on you. Many bills don’t repeat every month: for these bills, Chronicle will calculate how much you need to set aside each month so that you have enough to pay it when it comes due. For example, you may have an auto insurance bill of $500 that is due every 6 months. Chronicle will calculate that you need to set aside $83.33 each month in order to have enough to pay the bill each time it is due.
Intelligent Estimated Amount Due: Helps you know how much will be due for bills that vary. Using the type of bill, your payment history, and the time of year, Chronicle will intelligently calculate an estimate of how much is due. For example, Chronicle will be able to learn if your electric bills are higher or lower in the winter, and estimate accordingly.
Chronicle Cloud: Backup your bills to the cloud, sync across all your iOS devices, and share with a partner, spouse or business associate.
Chronicle Pro is an auto-renewing subscription. Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours prior end of the subscription. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. You may cancel or disable your subscription by going to your App Store Account Settings after purchase. 
Chronicle Pro is subject to the terms of use shown here: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ 
You can find the privacy policy for Chronicle Pro here: http://chronicleapp.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00147506:ios.name: Clap to Find My Phone: Finder
bluejetty:00147506:ios.summary: Our app is a simple yet ingenious app designed to help you quickly locate your misplaced phone, saving you time and frustration. By leveraging sound recognition technology, the app listens for a distinct clapping sound and responds with a c
bluejetty:00147506:ios.description:
Our app is a simple yet ingenious app designed to help you quickly locate your misplaced phone, saving you time and frustration. By leveraging sound recognition technology, the app listens for a distinct clapping sound and responds with a customizable alert such as a loud ringtone, vibration, or flashlight activation—even if your phone is on silent mode.
Key Features:
- Quick Phone Finder: Just clap your hands, and the app triggers your phone’s alert to help you locate it instantly.
- Customizable Alerts: Choose from various sound tones, vibration patterns, or flashing light signals to suit your preferences.
- Works in Silent Mode: Even when your phone is muted, the app ensures it’s easy to find.
- Sensitivity Adjustment: Fine-tune the app’s clap detection sensitivity to match your environment and ensure accuracy.
- Battery-Friendly: The app is optimized for minimal battery usage, running quietly in the background until needed.
- User-Friendly Interface: Simple setup with clear instructions to get started in seconds.
Perfect for those prone to misplacing their phones, our app offers a fun, effective, and practical solution to a common problem. Never lose your phone again—just clap and retrieve!
After purchasing an auto-renewable subscription, you will gain access to all features, such as:
- Ad-Free Experience: Enjoy uninterrupted usage without ads.
- Enhanced Sensitivity Controls: Fine-tune clap detection with advanced precision.
- Custom Alerts: Access exclusive ringtones, vibration patterns, and flashlight effects.
Subscription Details:
Payment is charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions auto-renew unless you disable this option at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Renewal fees are charged 24 hours before the subscription period ends and will clearly indicate the cost. Manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings anytime.

Terms of Use: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ozZRk_FGwvBynYkCtveKWq9s5DfqQ7NtIBWkEFa_wvQ/edit?tab=t.0

bluejetty:00172280:ios.name: REI Co-op – Shop Outdoor Gear
bluejetty:00172280:ios.summary:
A life outdoors is a life well lived. Make the REI Co-op app your partner in adventure.
This free shopping app makes it fast and easy to shop at REI Co-op on the go. Ready for all trails, find the right gear from the best brands. Adventure
bluejetty:00172280:ios.description:
A life outdoors is a life well lived. Make the REI Co-op app your partner in adventure.
This free shopping app makes it fast and easy to shop at REI Co-op on the go. Ready for all trails, find the right gear from the best brands. Adventure comes in all shapes and sizes. Whatever stokes your love of the outdoors—hiking, kayaking, skiing, camping, cycling, snowboarding, paddling, running—enjoy it to the fullest with the co-op at your fingertips.
Download the REI Co-op app to:
– ACCESS DEALS: Get notified first about special offers, sales, coupons and discounts.
– SEE YOUR INFO: Save and access your wish lists, account information and purchase history.
– USE YOUR BENEFITS: Sign in as a REI Co-op Member to take advantage of your benefits and earn rewards.
– FIND GEAR FAST: Search, filter and buy gear and clothing right from your phone.
– CHECK OUT EFFICIENTLY: Store your REI gift cards and membership number—even add it to your Apple Wallet.
– PICK UP AT NEARBY REI STORES: Order online and pick up your items at an REI store location near you for free.
– ENHANCE IN-STORE SHOPPING: Scan barcodes at the store to read more product details and customer reviews.
REI Co-op fuels your passion to kayak, cycle, camp, hike, backpack, climb, run, travel and so much more. Whether exploring local trails or the wild blue yonder, outfit the whole family—kids, womens and mens clothing—even the dogs in your life. Whether you’re a backcountry hiker, desert backpacker, or snow lover, clothing apps like this make adventure gear and clothes shopping enjoyable. 
REI Co-op offers the latest outdoor sports and fitness gear, clothes, equipment and electronics from the best outdoor brands. Find great deals on brands we’re proud to sell, including Columbia, The North Face, Yeti, Arc’teryx, Stanley, Adidas, Cotopaxi and Patagonia. We also design and develop our own high-quality products via the REI Co-op Brand and Co-op Cycles.
What you buy needs to work—and last. You can trust that REI Co-op has put its bikes, bike gears, backpacks, tents, ski trackers, trail clothing and other quality products to the test—even our closeout online REI Outlet items. The co-op applies comprehensive product sustainability standards to every brand it sells. From seeking better ways of making goods, to advancing fair trade manufacturing practices, to putting our profits to good use, REI Co-op advocates for the natural places we all love and makes it easier for customers to shop their values.
REI Co-op was founded in 1938 when a group of 23 climbing friends, united by their love of nature, decided to source quality and affordable gear for their adventures. We’ve been your local outdoor outfitter ever since.
To get the best REI Co-op app experience, keep your device updated with the latest iOS version.
When you download or use an REI Co-op app, we collect information about you as described in our privacy policies, which can be found on our website.
Privacy Policy: https://www.rei.com/legal/privacy-policy
Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy: https://www.rei.com/legal/consumer-health-data-privacy-policy

bluejetty:00043903:ios.description:
The essential app for serious poultry people. Replace your spreadsheets, notebooks, and guesswork with one app built for breeders and keepers who need records they can trust.
Flockstar requires an active subscription to use. Two plans are available: Keeper, with complete flock, egg, and record keeping, and Breeder, which adds everything in the hatching and breeding section below. Choose an annual plan for the best value, or monthly for flexibility. Change or cancel anytime.
HATCHING & BREEDING (BREEDER PLAN ONLY)
• Track eggs from all your breeding pens in a single hatch run
• Per-source fertility and hatch rates so you know which pairings work
• Create chicks from completed runs with lineage pre-filled
• Save incubator presets and pen configurations
• Full lineage tracking: dam, sire, and offspring views
• Pedigree viewer spanning three generations, with shareable certificates
FLOCK MANAGEMENT
• Bulk create and update hundreds of birds at once
• Track breeds, traits, colors, weights, and photos
• Share bird profiles as branded cards via text, email, or social media
• Filter by flock, sex, breed, or custom traits
• Archive birds without losing historical data
PRODUCTION & ANALYTICS
• Daily egg logging by flock or individual layer
• Week-over-week trends and historical charts
• Identify your top producers instantly
BUSINESS TOOLS
• Expense and sales tracking with user-defined categories, and easy export to CSV for tax time
• See your actual profit and loss
• Task manager with reminders and recurring schedules
• Journal with photos and tags for health records, observations, and more
WORKS EVERYWHERE
• Data syncs automatically across all devices
• Log eggs from your pocket, review analytics from your laptop
Serious poultry software, actively developed and updated since 2022. Questions or feature requests? support@flockstar.com

Features

Flash light metronome mode
• If the sound of the metronome is hard to hear due to the speaker volume limit or loud background noise, use flash light metronome mode. In this mode, you can easily feel the beats with flashes of light. Project the flashlight to the wall, then the entire wall can flash the beats.
Large and simple button
• Start or stop the metronome with a big button whenever you want
More features
• Supports all instruments, such as active piano, guitar, ukulele, mandolin, violin, cello, viola, bass, drum, flute, harmonica, etc.
• Supports all kind of transposed instruments, including B-flat clarinet, F horn, E-flat saxophone, D-flat piccolo, and many others.
• Precise beats per minute (BPM) control
• BPM detector
• Practice time tracker
• High precision tuner
• Visual metronome mode using flash light of the camera
• Tuning fork, pitch pipe
About permissions
• Access to camera is required for flash light metronome, access to phone status is required to stop the metronome when a call is incoming, access to microphone is for recorder and tuner, and access to storage is for recorder.
In-app purchase
• We offer a free version with ads and in-app purchase for ads removal.

• Length of subscription (time period and content or services provided during each subscription period) is 1 month

bluejetty:00042382:ios.description:
You’ve meditated before. Did it work? Be honest…you don’t actually know. Equa does.
Equa is a meditation app that turns your practice into something you can measure. Using only the motion sensors in your phone, Equa tracks your breathing while you meditate and turns it into feedback on what actually changed during the session. No watch, no ring, and no headband needed.
Using your respiration data, you can now see how your practice went, and watch your meditation skills develop over days and weeks – so you can tell whether it’s working instead of guessing.
If you are new to Equa, you can try the app for free. After the trial, choose your own price on our sliding scale, or become an Equanaut and make Equa possible for someone else!
Equa needs no additional hardware. Simply rest your phone on your chest and let the sensors inside do the work.
How it works:
Meditation Insights
Equa reads your breathing from your phone’s accelerometer during a session and shows you what changed. You get your breath rate in breaths per minute, how it shifted from the start of the session to the end, and where that sits relative to your own baseline. The respiration algorithm was developed with researchers at Carnegie Mellon University.
Breath Rate
Breath rate is one of the clearest physical signals that a session is doing something, and Equa tracks it every time you sit.
Trends
Single sessions vary. Practice shows up over weeks. Equa charts your breath rate and session history over time so you can see your progress over time.
Science
We didn’t just make this up. Equa’s Chief Science Officer, Dr. David Creswell, runs the Health and Human Performance Lab at Carnegie Mellon University, where he’s spent two decades studying how mindfulness training actually changes the body’s biological stress outcomes. One study found mindfulness training reliably lowered cortisol and blood pressure under stress. But participants didn’t report feeling less stressed – they just were. “How do you feel” was never going to catch that. So we built something that does.
Training & Curriculum: 
Equa treats meditation the way a training program treats a physical capacity. Sessions ask you to stay with discomfort rather than escape it, because that is where stress resilience is built. The curriculum offers a structured path through Unified Mindfulness’s core skills: Concentration Power, Sensory Clarity, and Equanimity. Equa offers a science-backed framework for mindfulness training.
What else you can do in the Equa app:
Review any past session and its breathing data
Set practice reminders that fit your schedule
Follow guided sessions for stress, focus, and attention
Track and build on your practice
Equa provides products and services designed for general wellness and education purposes. Equa is not a medical device, is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease, and should not be used as a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Breath rate measurement provides feedback on your meditation practice and is not a diagnostic tool.
