bluejetty:00180515:ios.name: Leo's baby songs for toddlers
bluejetty:00180515:ios.summary: Welcome to the magical world of Leo the Truck and his friends! Our new, interactive music app develops the awareness, hearing, motor skills, intuitive reading, and spatial thinking of your child. Listen and sing songs with Leo the Truck and
bluejetty:00180515:ios.description:
Welcome to the magical world of Leo the Truck and his friends! Our new, interactive music app develops the awareness, hearing, motor skills, intuitive reading, and spatial thinking of your child. Listen and sing songs with Leo the Truck and cars!
Leo has prepared many interesting songs and task to study colors, objects, and numbers together. And, of course, he hasn’t forgotten about cartoons! Your child will explore Leo’s house, the playground, the kitchen, and the village with all its pets. After each story, your child will get to watch a wonderful cartoon about cars.
Hurry up and launch our music app! Leo the Truck and his friends have a lot to do!
Let’s start with the most important thing - a good rest! Together with a star, sing your favorite lullaby and help friends fall asleep. After waking up, we’ll go with Leo to the playground. Cute and harmless spiders are waiting there to help us learn colors and sing a song.
But this was only a warm-up. Our cars have a real mystery to solve. All the cookies are missing! Leo the Truck goes with his friends to look for them. Bulldozer, Robot, Lifty, and Roller start their search, and your child will help them. As we know from the cartoon, Skoop decided to throw a surprise, but the cars didn’t expect it!
Whoosh! Now we’re doing important things in the kitchen. Together with Forklift Lifty, we’ll pick vegetables and learn what items shouldn’t be in the kitchen. Singing along to fun songs makes remembering them so easy! Your child will help prepare a delicious soup, which the cars rush to try.
After lunch, Leo the Truck will go to the village to feed pets. We’ll get to learn which sounds each of them makes.
Each story is accompanied by a short song that your baby will love. Repeat the song, and soon the child will remember simple words and melodies. This app helps your child develop intuitive reading skills and expand vocabulary. Getting to know more about the world around you in a playful way is a fascinating chance to raise your child.
Features of our educational music app:
- Based on the popular “Leo the Truck” cartoon for kids
- Safe for children who have not yet fully developed fine motor skills
- By listening to songs, the child remembers the names for objects, animals, colors, and numbers
- This app is optimized with entertaining content that helps development
- 5 different locations allow you to explore familiar and interesting situations for children
- After each story, the child will eagerly await the fascinating cartoon about cars
- This app develops awareness, hearing, and fine motor skills
- Professional voice acting and the basics of intuitive reading
- This app helps develop your child’s spatial thinking
- Colorful graphics and intuitive interface
- For easy use, select one of the modes (listening or listening on repeat) 
This vibrant, educational interactive app will surely captivate fans of the Leo the Truck cartoon. Leo is a curious and cheerful character. In each cartoon, he teaches about interesting cars, shapes, letters, and colors. This educational cartoon is perfect for young children and toddlers.
Let’s sing fun songs with your favorite characters!
If you have questions or suggestions, you can always write to us at appsupport@projectfirst.ru. We love reading the messages you send us :)

bluejetty:00159755:ios.description:
Dice Rolls - Dreams Rewards – Daily Rolls, Quizzes & Memory Games
Welcome to Dice Rolls - Dreams Rewards, the ultimate companion app for dice game lovers. Discover daily roll reward links, test your knowledge with fun quizzes, and challenge your memory with unique mini-games – all designed to keep you entertained every day.
With our app, you’ll never miss out on daily rewards again. Our team carefully checks and updates links to make sure everything works smoothly, helping you enjoy uninterrupted gameplay and faster progress.
Key Features:
• Daily Updated Roll Reward Links – Access fresh and verified links every day to keep your dice rolling.
• Safe and Verified – Each reward link is tested before being added, ensuring only working and reliable ones are shared.
• One-Tap Claiming – Claim your daily rewards quickly with a simple, intuitive interface.
• Instant Notifications – Receive alerts as soon as new rewards become available so you never miss a chance to claim them.
• Tips and Tricks – Learn useful gameplay strategies to level up faster and play smarter.
• Crazy Quiz – A fun and interactive quiz section packed with interesting questions across different categories. Challenge yourself and see how many you can answer correctly.
• Quiz Records – Keep track of your quiz journey with a detailed record showing the date, category, correct, wrong, and total answers.
• Memory Matrix – Memorise numbers on the dice grid as they flash, then find the correct cell before time runs out. The better your memory, the higher your score.
• Pattern Builder – Watch flashing colors carefully and repeat the sequence by tapping blocks in the same order. Each level becomes faster and more challenging, testing your focus and memory.
At Dice Rolls - Dreams Rewards, we believe in combining fun, learning, and fair play. Our goal is to create a space where players can collect daily rewards, test their knowledge, and train their minds — all in one engaging app.
Disclaimer:
This is a fan-made app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any official game creators. All reward links are collected from publicly available sources.
Download Dice Rolls - Dreams Rewards today and experience the perfect balance of rewards, quizzes, and brain games — made for every dice enthusiast.

bluejetty:00016894:ios.description:
LIGHTS! COLORS! ACTION!
OnSwitch is the #1 rated companion app for Philips Hue smart lighting systems. Downloaded over 2.5 million times! 
OnSwitch for Philips Hue has a beautiful, simple user interface but it's also powerful. Your Hue lights come alive with a single click! 
• Holidays
• Party/Disco Lighting
• Sports, Including LIVE game-sync events
• Sunrise alarm and sunset sleep timer
• Fun kids content
• Accent Lighting
• Color flows
• Candle light
• Nature Scenes
• Lightning
• Fireworks
Our Hue app connects to your Philips Hue Bridge, creating immersive animated experiences with your Hue lights! 
Get the best Hue App, get OnSwitch!
UNLOCK EVERYTHING
With OnSwitch Premium subscription you can unlock our entire content library and more!
• Unlock ALL albums (300+ animated light scenes) 
• Unlimited SIRI Shortcuts
• Access exclusive LIVE events.
• Amazing NEW scenes added regularly.
HERO LIGHTING 
Our Hue light scenes have cinematic flair. Music sound tracks set the mood while our an animation engine delivers bursts of light and sound where anything can happen. Santa lands on your house! Zombies attack! You are in a spaceship battle!
Other light scenes transport you to a Lush Forest, Venice or even Deep Space to chill out in the Orion Nebula listening to superb ambient electronic music. 
CREATIVE LIGHTING
OnSwitch gives you smarter, clearer ways to control your smart lights. Instead of guessing what Hue's "Light Recipes" mean, our Everyday Lighting album presents gorgeous photos of antique and halogen bulbs or a skylight so it's clear what kind of light you are going to get. Our fluorescent tube even flickers on like the real thing! 
Want Color? Other apps make you drag a pin around a color wheel. OnSwitch makes it easy with curated Pastels and Accent colors. Warm and Cool color flows. And "Color Splat!" our exclusive color discovery feature that's always fun and a surprise.
SUNRISE ALARM & SUNSET SLEEP TIMER
Wake up with a beautiful sunrise and your favorite music! Go to sleep with a sunset, optimized for better sleep.
LIGHT GROUPS
Easily create and manage groups of bulbs. Control each group independently. OnSwitch manages groups on your Philips Hue Bridge so it will play nicely with your other apps!
IMPORTANT!
• You will need LIFX smart bulbs or a Philips Hue bridge and light bulbs to use this app.
• OnSwitch requires iOS10 or later to run.
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
OnSwitch Premium subscription unlocks all of the app's lighting content. You can preview all of the content for 3 days FREE before your subscription starts. 
If you choose to subscribe, you will be charged a per month subscription fee according to your country. The subscription fee will be shown in the app before you complete the payment. Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each subscription term, unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the term. Subscription renewals cost the same as the original subscription, and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal at any time after purchase by going to your iTunes Account Settings. Refunds will not be given for any unused portion of the term.
For additional information, please read:
•Terms of Service (https://www.getonswitch.com/terms) 
• Privacy Policy (https://www.getonswitch.com/privacy)

Sayably helps you prepare for everyday conversations when the wording matters. Make a request, say no, give feedback or disagree with more thought about what you mean and how you express it.
Start with a message in English. Choose your goal, then add the recipient's role, relevant facts or the result you want if they help explain the situation. Ask AI for a suggestion, compare it with your original and make your own edits before copying it. If an important detail is missing, Sayably may ask a clarification question. It can also tell you when your message is already clear. You decide which words to use.
Practice the conversations you actually have. Work through situations such as requests for files and revisions, extra tasks you need to decline, missed handoffs, interruptions and differences over priorities. Move from choosing a response to writing with guidance and trying your own words. Read the scenario's facts, use a hint when you need one and explore a worked example.
Look closely at your answer. Choice exercises explain why each response fits the situation more or less well. For your own writing, mark the criteria you think you met and decide what you would change. Optional AI feedback comments on specific phrases in your answer against the exercise criteria. Your self-review, the written example and AI comments stay distinct, so you can see where each piece of guidance comes from.
Return to earlier attempts. Your practice history keeps unfinished and completed work, including whether you used a hint or saw an example first. Compare two attempts from the same topic and consider both the wording and the circumstances. Completion records the practice you did; it is not a certified skill level or a prediction of how someone will respond.
Learn a technique you can use again. Short guides show before-and-after examples for naming an action, keeping a refusal clear, describing observable behavior and stating your view accurately. Each guide explains when it may help and its limits. Save useful techniques alongside messages you want to keep.
Keep a little context for yourself. Attach a photo of a written note or a conversation screenshot to a saved message using the camera or photo library. Open it later as a visual reference, replace it or remove it. Attached photos stay on your device and are never sent to AI.
AI features require an internet connection and your consent. The text and context needed for the request are sent to an external AI provider; local practice and saved items remain available without AI. Review suggestions for accuracy, tone and commitments, and avoid submitting confidential details. You can turn AI off and delete your local data. Sayably supports English and gives you space to rehearse before choosing what to say.

fedora-packages:bdsync/bdsync.name: bdsync
fedora-packages:bdsync/bdsync.description: Bdsync can be used to synchronize block devices over a network. It generates a "binary patchfile" in an efficient way by comparing MD5 checksums of 32k blocks of the local block device LOCDEV and the remote block device REMDEV. This binary patchfile can be sent to the remote machine and applied to its block device DSTDEV, after which the local blockdev LOCDEV and the remote block device REMDEV are synchronized. bdsync was built to do the only thing rsync isn't able to do: synchronize block devices.

firefox-addons:3019396.name: ZeroWebTools Companion
firefox-addons:3019396.summary: Offline developer utilities and secure local bridge enabling API testing and article extraction on zerowebtools.com.
firefox-addons:3019396.description:
ZeroWebTools Companion is a secure browser extension designed to extend the capabilities of the zerowebtools.com platform and bring a lightweight, 100% offline developer toolbelt right into your Firefox toolbar. 
All data transformations and formats are executed locally in your browser context. No data is ever sent to external servers, making it a safe choice for corporate developers handling sensitive API credentials, production logs, tokens, or proprietary code blocks.
🚀 Six Essential Offline Utilities in One Popup:
 JSON Formatter & Tree Explorer: Paste raw JSON to validate it, pretty-print it (with collapsible arrays and objects), or minify it instantly.
 Side-by-Side Diff Checker: Compare two blocks of code or text files inline to highlight additions, deletions, and line-level changes.
 JWT Debugger & Decoder: Instantly inspect JSON Web Tokens. Decode headers, payload claims, and signatures securely offline.
 Case Converter: Transform naming conventions between camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, and PascalCase.
 Base64 Cipher: Encode strings to Base64 or decode hashes back to readable plain text.
 URL Encoder/Decoder: Clean percent-encoding from URL parameter strings and format query parameters.
🔗 Secure Platform Bridge for Advanced Tools:
Unlocks advanced capabilities on zerowebtools.com by routing permissions securely through your local browser context:
- CORS Bypass: Execute requests in the online REST API Client directly from your local browser context, eliminating the need for proxy servers.
- Local Web Scraping: Extracts clean text nodes locally for the Smart Article Reader and YouTube Transcriber without intermediate database logging.
🔒 Privacy-First Design:
 Runs completely offline in your browser's sandbox memory.
 Zero telemetry, tracking scripts, or analytical cookies.
 Zero server communication.
Check out our full catalog of 57+ free client-side tools (including PDF compilers, HEIC photo converters, and financial models) at:
👉 https://zerowebtools.com/
